name: 碳排放
summary: 评估企业运营的碳强度，以及企业管理气候相关风险与机遇的努力，包括减排举措、目标与绩效表现。
intro: Carbon Emissions is a Key Issue in the Environmental Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on the carbon intensity of their operations and their efforts to manage climate-related risks and opportunities.
risks: Increased costs linked to carbon pricing or trading.
Facility retrofit costs or operational disruptions due to regulatory caps.
risksCn: 碳定价或碳交易带来的成本增加。
因监管上限导致的设施改造费用或运营中断。

indicators.name: Use of cleaner sources of energy
indicators.nameCn: 使用更清洁的能源
indicators.definition: Assesses how aggressively the company has sought to mitigate its carbon emissions through the use of cleaner sources of energy such as solar, wind, geothermal, co-generation, or natural gas in place of oil or coal.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司通过使用更清洁的能源（如太阳能、风能、地热能、热电联产或天然气替代石油或煤炭）来减排其碳排放的积极程度。

indicators.name: Efforts to capture GHG emissions
indicators.nameCn: 捕获温室气体排放的举措
indicators.definition: Assesses the aggressiveness of a company’s efforts to use greenhouse gas (GHG) capture and storage/sequestration of its operational emissions.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司对运营排放采用温室气体（GHG）捕集与封存/固存的积极程度。

indicators.name: Energy Consumption Management & Operational Efficiency
indicators.nameCn: 能源消耗管理与运营效率
indicators.definition: This data point indicates our assessment of how aggressively the company has sought to mitigate its carbon emissions by managing energy consumption and improving the energy efficiency of its operations. Possible values are: 'Aggressive efforts' (best); 'Some efforts'; 'Limited efforts/information'; 'No efforts' (worst)
indicators.definitionCn: 该数据点反映我们对公司通过管理能源消耗和提高运营能效来减排其碳排放的积极程度的评估。可能取值为：'积极举措'（最佳）；'部分举措'；'有限举措/信息'；'无举措'（最差）

indicators.name: Efforts to reduce customer energy consumption (demand-side management)
indicators.nameCn: 减少客户能源消耗的举措（需求侧管理）
indicators.definition: Indicates MSCI ESG Research's assessment of the aggressiveness of a company's efforts to reduce future energy consumption through energy efficiency or demand response programs. This indicator is specifically relevant for energy companies and utilities.
indicators.definitionCn: 反映 MSCI ESG Research 对公司通过能效或需求响应方案来减少未来能源消耗的积极程度的评估。该指标与能源公司和公用事业尤为相关。

indicators.name: Other efforts to reduce carbon emissions
indicators.nameCn: 其他减少碳排放的举措
indicators.definition: Assesses how aggressively the company has sought to mitigate its operational and/or value chain carbon emissions through other efforts (including purchasing carbon offsets, but excluding energy efficiency, clean energy use, carbon capture or demand-side management). The assessment is based on industry-specific criteria.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司通过其他举措（包括购买碳抵消，但不包括能效、清洁能源使用、碳捕集或需求侧管理）来减排其运营和/或价值链碳排放的积极程度。评估基于行业特定标准。

indicators.name: Carbon emissions target comprehensiveness
indicators.nameCn: 碳排放目标的全面性
indicators.definition: Assesses the extent to which the company has established quantitative climate targets that are comprehensive in scope and complete in coverage. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating comprehensive targets.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司所建立的定量气候目标在范围上的全面性和覆盖上的完整性。以 0-10 分表示，10 分表示目标全面。

indicators.name: Carbon emissions target footprint coverage (%)
indicators.definition: Assesses the extent to which the company’s emission reduction targets cover its total reported emissions. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates that the targets comprehensively cover all relevant emissions.
indicators.parent: Carbon emissions target comprehensiveness
indicators.nameCn: 碳减排目标排放足迹覆盖率（%）
indicators.definitionCn: 评估企业减排目标覆盖其报告排放总量的程度。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示目标全面覆盖所有相关排放。
indicators.parentCn: 碳排放目标的全面性

indicators.name: Carbon emissions target relevant scope score
indicators.definition: Assesses whether the company’s emission reduction targets include all financially material scopes. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates full coverage of financially material emission scopes.
indicators.parent: Carbon emissions target comprehensiveness
indicators.nameCn: 碳减排目标相关排放范围得分
indicators.definitionCn: 评估企业减排目标是否包括所有具有财务重要性的排放范围。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示全面覆盖具有财务重要性的排放范围。
indicators.parentCn: 碳排放目标的全面性

indicators.name: Carbon emissions target progress
indicators.nameCn: 碳排放目标的进展
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s progress toward active environmental targets, as well as its historical track record in meeting previously stated targets. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong progress towards targets
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司在现行环境目标上的进展，以及其在实现此前所设定目标方面的历史记录。以 0-10 分表示，10 分表示目标进展强劲。

indicators.name: Carbon emissions ongoing target progress
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s progress toward achieving its emission reduction targets based on current performance. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 all its targets are on track to meet stated targets.
indicators.parent: Carbon emissions target progress
indicators.nameCn: 正在执行的碳减排目标进展
indicators.definitionCn: 根据当前绩效评估企业实现减排目标的进度。以 0–10 分表示；原文对 10 分的表述为所有目标均按计划朝既定目标推进。
indicators.parentCn: 碳排放目标的进展

indicators.name: Carbon emissions target track record
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s historical performance in achieving or maintaining sustainability or environmental targets. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.parent: Carbon emissions target progress
indicators.nameCn: 碳减排目标历史实现记录
indicators.definitionCn: 评估企业实现或维持可持续发展或环境目标的历史表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
indicators.parentCn: 碳排放目标的进展

indicators.name: Carbon emissions target verification
indicators.nameCn: 碳排放目标的核验
indicators.definition: Assesses whether the company’s disclosed targets are supported by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi), where applicable. Expressed as either NULL or 10 score, with 10 indicating presence of verification.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司所披露的目标在适用情况下是否得到科学碳目标倡议（SBTi）的支持。以 NULL 或 10 分表示，10 分表示存在核验。

indicators.name: SBTi long-term target status
indicators.definition: Indicates the status of the company’s Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) long-term target, aligned with net-zero or long-term decarbonization goals.
indicators.parent: Carbon emissions target verification
indicators.nameCn: SBTi 长期目标状态
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业科学碳目标倡议（SBTi）长期目标的状态，该目标与净零或长期脱碳目标相一致。
indicators.parentCn: 碳排放目标的核验

indicators.name: SBTi near-term target status
indicators.definition: Indicates the status of the company’s Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) near-term target, aligned with short-to medium-term emissions reduction goals.
indicators.parent: Carbon emissions target verification
indicators.nameCn: SBTi 近期目标状态
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业科学碳目标倡议（SBTi）近期目标的状态，该目标与短期至中期减排目标相一致。
indicators.parentCn: 碳排放目标的核验

indicators.name: Carbon emissions performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 碳排放绩效的相对同业表现
indicators.definition: Assesses the company's performance on greenhouse gas [GHG] emissions intensity (normalized by sales or by units of production), and trend in GHG emissions intensity, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司在温室气体[GHG]排放强度（按销售额或产量单位标准化）及 GHG 排放强度趋势方面相对于同业的表现。以 0-10 分表示，10 分表示表现强劲。

indicators.name: Carbon emissions intensity industry relative score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company's performance on greenhouse gas [GHG] emissions intensity (normalized by sales or by units of production), relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.parent: Carbon emissions performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 碳排放强度行业相对得分
indicators.definitionCn: 相对于同业，评估企业温室气体（GHG）排放强度的表现；强度以销售额或产量为分母。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
indicators.parentCn: 碳排放绩效的相对同业表现

indicators.name: Three-year average carbon emissions intensity (sales based)
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average greenhouse-gas emissions per unit of sales over the defined period.
indicators.parent: Carbon emissions intensity industry relative score
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均碳排放强度（按销售额）
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量企业在规定期间内每单位销售额温室气体排放的三年平均值。
indicators.parentCn: 碳排放强度行业相对得分

indicators.name: Three-year average carbon emissions intensity (production based)
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average greenhouse-gas emissions per unit production (megawatt-hour generated, or ton cement produced or revenue passenger kilometer, based on industry).
indicators.parent: Carbon emissions intensity industry relative score
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均碳排放强度（按产量）
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量企业单位产量温室气体排放的三年平均值；分母视行业采用发电兆瓦时、每吨水泥或收入客运公里。
indicators.parentCn: 碳排放强度行业相对得分

indicators.name: Carbon emissions intensity industry relative trend score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on the three-year average of year-over-year carbon-emissions intensity trend (normalized by sales or by units of production), relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.parent: Carbon emissions performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 碳排放强度行业相对趋势得分
indicators.definitionCn: 相对于同业，评估企业碳排放强度同比变化趋势的三年平均表现；强度以销售额或产量为分母。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
indicators.parentCn: 碳排放绩效的相对同业表现

indicators.name: Three-year average year-over-year carbon emissions intensity trend (sales based)
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average of year-over-year greenhouse-gas emissions (per unit of sales) trend.
indicators.parent: Carbon emissions intensity industry relative trend score
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均碳排放强度同比趋势（按销售额）
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量企业每单位销售额温室气体排放同比变化趋势的三年平均值。
indicators.parentCn: 碳排放强度行业相对趋势得分

indicators.name: Three-year average year-over-year carbon emissions intensity trend (production based)
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average year-over-year greenhouse-gas emissions per unit production (megawatt-hour generated, or ton cement produced or revenue passenger kilometer based on industry) trend.
indicators.parent: Carbon emissions intensity industry relative trend score
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均碳排放强度同比趋势（按产量）
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量企业单位产量温室气体排放同比变化趋势的三年平均值；分母视行业采用发电兆瓦时、每吨水泥或收入客运公里。
indicators.parentCn: 碳排放强度行业相对趋势得分

scoringNote: 风险型议题将风险敞口与风险管理得分通过总方法论的映射组合，不是两者直接相乘。管理评估可包含实践、绩效、目标及争议扣分；具体组件和行业适用性见本议题 PDF。

name: 气候变化脆弱性
summary: 针对保险公司，评估气候变化对其承保资产或人群可能造成的物理风险敞口。
intro: Climate Change Vulnerability is a Key Issue in the Environmental Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Insurance companies are assessed on the physical risk that climate change may pose to insured assets or individuals.
risks: Climate model risk: inadequate climate risk modelling may underestimate or misrepresent future climate-related losses and reserving assumptions.
Liquidity and solvency risk: timing and size of claims impact cash flows and solvency.
Catastrophe risk: increase in frequency and severity and decrease in predictability of catastrophe losses.
risksCn: 气候模型风险：气候风险建模不充分可能低估或错误反映未来气候相关损失以及准备金假设。
流动性与偿付能力风险：索赔的时间和规模会影响现金流与偿付能力。
巨灾风险：巨灾损失的频率和严重程度上升，可预测性下降。

indicators.name: Recognition that physical risk of climate change may increase underwriting risks
indicators.nameCn: 认识到气候变化的物理风险可能增加承保风险
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company recognizes that the physical risk of climate change may increase underwriting risks.
indicators.definitionCn: 说明公司是否认识到气候变化的物理风险可能增加承保风险。

indicators.name: Research or exercise to quantify the impact of physical risk on insurance underwriting
indicators.nameCn: 量化物理风险对保险承保影响的研究或分析
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company conducts research or exercises to quantify the impact of physical risk on insurance underwriting, either directly (via primary research) or indirectly (through an industry consortium).
indicators.definitionCn: 说明公司是否开展研究或分析以量化物理风险对保险承保的影响，方式可以是直接开展（通过一手研究）或间接开展（通过行业联盟）。

indicators.name: Evidence of using climate change models
indicators.nameCn: 使用气候变化模型的证据
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company uses climate change models to inform underwriting decisions.
indicators.definitionCn: 说明公司是否使用气候变化模型为承保决策提供依据。

indicators.name: Underwriting performance based on combined ratio
indicators.nameCn: 基于综合成本率的承保绩效
indicators.definition: Assesses the company's underwriting performance, based on its three-year average combined ratio. The combined ratio measures an insurer’s underwriting profitability by comparing total claims and expenses to earned premiums.
indicators.definitionCn: 根据公司三年平均综合成本率评估其承保绩效。综合成本率通过比较总赔款及费用与已赚保费，衡量保险公司的承保盈利能力。

scoringNote: 风险型议题将风险敞口与风险管理得分通过总方法论的映射组合，不是两者直接相乘。管理评估可包含实践、绩效、目标及争议扣分；具体组件和行业适用性见本议题 PDF。

name: 融资的环境影响
summary: 针对金融机构，评估其贷款与承销活动中的环境风险，以及把握绿色金融机遇的能力。
intro: Financing Environmental Impact is a Key Issue in the Environmental Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Financial institutions are evaluated on the environmental risks of their lending and underwriting activities and their ability to capitalize on opportunities related to green finance.
risks: Increased credit defaults from borrowers that suffer losses related to a range of environmental concerns, including operational disruption, loss of market access, liabilities and asset impairment.
Damage to corporate reputation from financing environmentally harmful projects.
risksCn: 借款人因一系列环境问题（包括运营中断、市场准入丧失、负债及资产减值）遭受损失，导致信用违约增加。
为环境有害项目提供融资而损害企业声誉。

indicators.name: Formal management systems to assess ESG risks in financing activities
indicators.nameCn: 用于评估融资活动中 ESG 风险的正式管理体系
indicators.definition: Describes the company's management system to assess ESG risks in financing activities. Best practice includes ESG factors systematically embedded in credit assessment, supported by a documented, end-to-end framework that sets out the risk management process.
indicators.definitionCn: 描述公司评估融资活动中 ESG 风险的管理体系。最佳实践包括将 ESG 因素系统性地嵌入信贷评估，并由一套记录的、端到端的框架予以支持，该框架明确了风险管理流程。

indicators.name: Scope of management system to assess ESG risks in financing activities
indicators.nameCn: 评估融资活动中 ESG 风险的管理体系覆盖范围
indicators.definition: The scope of a company’s formal management systems to assess ESG risks in financing activities. Best practice is to include all credit and investment banking operations.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司评估融资活动中 ESG 风险的正式管理体系的覆盖范围。最佳实践是将所有信贷和投资银行业务纳入其中。

indicators.name: Involvement of group credit risk in ESG due diligence
indicators.nameCn: 集团信用风险部门参与 ESG 尽职调查的程度
indicators.definition: The extent to which the group responsible for credit risk management is directly involved in ESG due diligence.
indicators.definitionCn: 负责信用风险管理的集团直接参与 ESG 尽职调查的程度。

indicators.name: ESG due diligence triggers and risk-escalation process clearly defined
indicators.nameCn: ESG 尽职调查触发条件与风险升级流程的明确定义情况
indicators.definition: The level of transparency provided around the escalation process for triggering credit evaluations based on ESG risks. Best practices are to clearly define the ESG risk escalation process, provide details on thresholds for triggering escalation, and provide examples of extra due diligence where necessary.
indicators.definitionCn: 围绕基于 ESG 风险触发信贷评估的升级流程所提供信息的透明程度。最佳实践是明确定义 ESG 风险升级流程、提供触发升级的阈值细节，并在必要时提供额外尽职调查的示例。

indicators.name: Oversight of ESG risk management in financing activities
indicators.nameCn: 对融资活动中 ESG 风险管理的监督
indicators.definition: The group or individual that has ultimate responsibility over the integration of ESG considerations in financing and investment activities.
indicators.definitionCn: 对在融资和投资活动中整合 ESG 考量承担最终责任的集团或个人。

indicators.name: Conducts climate-related risk analysis
indicators.nameCn: 开展气候相关风险分析
indicators.definition: The company’s initiatives to assess the business risks associated with climate change. Best practice is to integrate climate change risk analysis in financing decisions.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司评估与气候变化相关业务风险的举措。最佳实践是将气候变化风险分析纳入融资决策。

indicators.name: Environmental credit policy score
indicators.nameCn: 环境信贷政策评分
indicators.definition: Assesses the scope and strength of a financial institution implementing environmental credit policy across five sectors and themes: agriculture, power utilities, mining, oil & gas, biodiversity. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates binding environmental credit policies applied across all five sectors and themes.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估金融机构在五个行业和主题——农业、电力公用事业、采矿、石油天然气、生物多样性——实施环境信贷政策的范围和力度。以 0–10 分表示，10 分表示在全部五个行业和主题均应用具有约束力的环境信贷政策。

indicators.name: Credit policy related to agriculture
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has developed binding or non-binding environmental credit policies, or has adopted voluntary standards, related to agriculture industry financing.
indicators.parent: Environmental credit policy score
indicators.nameCn: 农业相关信贷政策
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业是否针对农业融资制定了具有约束力或不具有约束力的环境信贷政策，或采用了自愿性标准。
indicators.parentCn: 环境信贷政策评分

indicators.name: Credit policy related to power utilities
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has developed binding or non-binding environmental credit policies, or has adopted voluntary standards, related to power industry financing.
indicators.parent: Environmental credit policy score
indicators.nameCn: 电力公用事业相关信贷政策
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业是否针对电力行业融资制定了具有约束力或不具有约束力的环境信贷政策，或采用了自愿性标准。
indicators.parentCn: 环境信贷政策评分

indicators.name: Credit policy related to mining
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has developed binding or non-binding environmental credit policies, or has adopted voluntary standards, related to mining industry financing.
indicators.parent: Environmental credit policy score
indicators.nameCn: 采矿相关信贷政策
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业是否针对采矿业融资制定了具有约束力或不具有约束力的环境信贷政策，或采用了自愿性标准。
indicators.parentCn: 环境信贷政策评分

indicators.name: Credit policy related to oil and gas
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has developed binding or non-binding environmental credit policies, or has adopted voluntary standards, related to oil and gas industry financing.
indicators.parent: Environmental credit policy score
indicators.nameCn: 油气相关信贷政策
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业是否针对油气行业融资制定了具有约束力或不具有约束力的环境信贷政策，或采用了自愿性标准。
indicators.parentCn: 环境信贷政策评分

indicators.name: Credit policy related to biodiversity
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has developed binding or non-binding environmental credit policies, or has adopted voluntary standards, related to biodiversity.
indicators.parent: Environmental credit policy score
indicators.nameCn: 生物多样性相关信贷政策
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业是否制定了与生物多样性相关、具有约束力或不具有约束力的环境信贷政策，或采用了自愿性标准。
indicators.parentCn: 环境信贷政策评分

indicators.name: Involvement in green financing and securities
indicators.nameCn: 参与绿色融资和绿色证券的程度
indicators.definition: The extent to which a company invests in green securities or is involved in the structuring of green financing.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司投资绿色证券或参与绿色融资结构设计的程度。

indicators.name: Sustainability-related financial product development
indicators.nameCn: 可持续相关金融产品开发
indicators.definition: The extent to which a company has integrated sustainability factors into its financial products, either through pricing mechanisms or other related green financing methods.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司将可持续因素通过定价机制或其他相关绿色融资方式纳入其金融产品的程度。

indicators.componentCn: 担保债券发行人专用评分
indicators.name: Financing environmental impact practices score for covered bonds issuers
indicators.nameCn: 担保债券发行人的融资环境影响实践评分
indicators.definition: Indicates the strength of ESG risk management practices affecting the assets in the cover pool, proxied by the average practices of loan originators in the country of domicile. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong practices.
indicators.definitionCn: 表示影响担保资产池中资产的 ESG 风险管理实践的力度，以注册国贷款发放机构的平均实践作为代理指标。以 0–10 分表示，10 分表示实践力度强。

scoringNote: 风险型议题将风险敞口与风险管理得分通过总方法论的映射组合，不是两者直接相乘。管理评估可包含实践、绩效、目标及争议扣分；具体组件和行业适用性见本议题 PDF。

name: 产品碳足迹
summary: 评估企业产品的碳强度，以及其在供应链或产品与服务使用环节降低碳足迹的能力。
intro: Product Carbon Footprint is a Key Issue in the Environmental Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on the carbon intensity of their products and their ability to reduce the carbon footprint in their supply chains or in the use of their products and services.
risks: Increased costs from higher and more volatile energy prices upstream in the value chain (affecting raw materials, input, and distribution costs).
Regulatory risks associated with downstream emissions, e.g., penalties resulting from vehicle fleet emissions standards in the automobile industry.
risksCn: 因价值链上游能源价格走高且波动加剧而导致的成本增加（影响原材料、投入品和分销成本）。
与下游排放相关的监管风险，例如汽车行业车辆车队排放标准导致的处罚。

indicators.name: Assessment of energy consumption and/or carbon emissions of suppliers
indicators.nameCn: 对供应商能耗和/或碳排放的评估
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company assesses the carbon emissions and/or energy consumption of its suppliers.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否评估其供应商的碳排放和/或能耗。

indicators.name: Extent of product carbon footprint assessments
indicators.nameCn: 产品碳足迹评估的范围
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company assesses the downstream carbon emissions of its products and services.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否评估其产品和服务在下游的碳排放。

indicators.name: Targets to reduce Scope 3 upstream carbon emissions
indicators.nameCn: 减少Scope 3上游碳排放的目标
indicators.definition: Indicates whether there is evidence the company has quantitative and time-bound targets to reduce Scope 3 upstream carbon emissions. This may include targets regarding the company’s supply chain.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明是否有证据显示公司设有量化且有时限的减少Scope 3上游碳排放的目标。这可能包括与公司供应链相关的目标。

indicators.name: Energy consumption or carbon emissions assessment of distribution and store operations
indicators.nameCn: 对分销和门店运营的能耗或碳排放评估
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company assesses the carbon emissions or energy consumption of its distribution centers and store operations.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否评估其配送中心和门店运营的碳排放或能耗。

indicators.name: Energy consumption or carbon emissions assessment of manufacturing operations (including suppliers)
indicators.nameCn: 对生产运营（含供应商）的能耗或碳排放评估
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company assesses the carbon emissions or energy consumption of its manufacturing operations, including suppliers’ operations.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否评估其生产运营（包括供应商的运营）的碳排放或能耗。

indicators.name: Energy consumption or carbon emissions assessment of raw materials sourcing
indicators.nameCn: 对原材料采购的能耗或碳排放评估
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company assesses the upstream carbon emissions or energy consumption involved in the production of raw materials.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否评估原材料生产过程中涉及的上游碳排放或能耗。

indicators.name: Energy consumption or carbon emissions assessment of transportation and logistics
indicators.nameCn: 对运输和物流的能耗或碳排放评估
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company assesses the carbon emissions or energy consumption of its transportation and logistics operations.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否评估其运输和物流运营的碳排放或能耗。

indicators.name: Extent of energy consumption or carbon emissions reduction programs in distribution centers or store operations
indicators.nameCn: 分销中心或门店运营能耗或碳排放减排方案覆盖程度
indicators.definition: The extent of the company’s carbon emissions or energy reduction programs in its distribution centers or store operations. Best practice includes programs in all distribution centers or store operations.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司在配送中心或门店运营中的碳排放或节能方案的范围。最佳实践包括覆盖所有配送中心或门店运营的方案。

indicators.name: Extent of energy consumption or carbon emissions reduction programs in manufacturing operations (including suppliers)
indicators.nameCn: 生产运营（含供应商）能耗或碳排放减排方案覆盖程度
indicators.definition: The extent of the company’s carbon emissions or energy reduction programs in its manufacturing operations, including suppliers’ operations. Best practice includes programs covering all core production facilities.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司在生产运营（包括供应商的运营）中的碳排放或节能方案的范围。最佳实践包括覆盖所有核心生产设施的方案。

indicators.name: Extent of energy consumption or carbon emissions reduction programs in raw materials sourcing
indicators.nameCn: 原材料采购能耗或碳排放减排方案覆盖程度
indicators.definition: The extent of the company’s carbon emissions or energy reduction programs in the sourcing of raw materials, including those sourced by suppliers. Best practice includes programs covering all core products.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司在原材料采购（包括供应商采购的原材料）中的碳排放或节能方案的范围。最佳实践包括覆盖所有核心产品的方案。

indicators.name: Extent of energy consumption or carbon emissions reduction programs in transportation and logistics
indicators.nameCn: 运输与物流能耗或碳排放减排方案覆盖程度
indicators.definition: The extent of the company’s carbon emissions or energy reduction programs in the transportation and logistics stages. Best practice includes improvements in fleet efficiency combined with improvements in load/packaging optimization.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司在运输与物流阶段开展碳排放或能源减量方案的程度。最佳实践包括提升车队效率，并改进载荷／包装优化。

indicators.name: Tailpipe fleet emission performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 相对于同业组的尾气车队排放绩效
indicators.definition: Assesses the company's estimated global volume-weighted tailpipe fleet emission performance in comparison to industry peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating lowest fleet emissions, relative to peers.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司相对于行业同业组的估计全球销量加权尾气车队排放绩效。以0-10分表示，10分表示相对于同业组车队排放最低。

indicators.name: Product Carbon Footprint industry relative score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company's performance on estimated global volume-weighted tailpipe fleet emission, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates lowest fleet emissions relative to peers.
indicators.parent: Tailpipe fleet emission performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 产品碳足迹行业相对得分
indicators.definitionCn: 相对于同业，评估企业估计的全球销量加权车队尾气排放表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示相对于同业车队排放最低。
indicators.parentCn: 相对于同业组的尾气车队排放绩效

indicators.name: Product Carbon Footprint industry relative trend score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on the three-year average of year-over-year estimated global volume-weighted tailpipe fleet emission trend, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates highest decline in fleet emissions, relative to peers.
indicators.parent: Tailpipe fleet emission performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 产品碳足迹行业相对趋势得分
indicators.definitionCn: 相对于同业，评估企业估计的全球销量加权车队尾气排放同比变化趋势的三年平均表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示相对于同业车队排放降幅最大。
indicators.parentCn: 相对于同业组的尾气车队排放绩效

indicators.name: Carbon emissions target comprehensiveness
indicators.nameCn: 碳排放目标的全面性
indicators.definition: Assesses the extent to which the company has established quantitative climate targets that are comprehensive in scope and complete in coverage. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating comprehensive targets.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司建立的定量气候目标在范围上的全面性和覆盖上的完整性。以 0–10 分表示，10 分表示目标全面。

indicators.name: Carbon emissions target footprint coverage (%)
indicators.definition: Assesses the extent to which the company’s emission reduction targets cover its total reported emissions. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates that the targets comprehensively cover all relevant emissions.
indicators.parent: Carbon emissions target comprehensiveness
indicators.nameCn: 碳减排目标排放足迹覆盖率（%）
indicators.definitionCn: 评估企业减排目标覆盖其报告排放总量的程度。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示目标全面覆盖所有相关排放。
indicators.parentCn: 碳排放目标的全面性

indicators.name: Carbon emissions target relevant scope score
indicators.definition: Assesses whether the company’s emission reduction targets include all financially material scopes. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates full coverage of financially material emission scopes.
indicators.parent: Carbon emissions target comprehensiveness
indicators.nameCn: 碳减排目标相关排放范围得分
indicators.definitionCn: 评估企业减排目标是否包括所有具有财务重要性的排放范围。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示全面覆盖具有财务重要性的排放范围。
indicators.parentCn: 碳排放目标的全面性

indicators.name: Carbon emissions target progress
indicators.nameCn: 碳排放目标进展
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s progress toward active environmental targets, as well as its historical track record in meeting previously stated targets. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong progress towards targets
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司在现行环境目标方面的进展，以及其在实现此前既定目标方面的历史记录。以 0-10 分表示，10 分表示在实现既定目标方面进展强劲。

indicators.name: Carbon emissions ongoing target progress
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s progress toward achieving its emission reduction targets based on current performance. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 all its targets are on track to meet stated targets.
indicators.parent: Carbon emissions target progress
indicators.nameCn: 正在执行的碳减排目标进展
indicators.definitionCn: 根据当前绩效评估企业实现减排目标的进度。以 0–10 分表示；原文对 10 分的表述为所有目标均按计划朝既定目标推进。
indicators.parentCn: 碳排放目标进展

indicators.name: Carbon emissions target track record
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s historical performance in achieving or maintaining sustainability or environmental targets. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.parent: Carbon emissions target progress
indicators.nameCn: 碳减排目标历史实现记录
indicators.definitionCn: 评估企业实现或维持可持续发展或环境目标的历史表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
indicators.parentCn: 碳排放目标进展

indicators.name: Carbon emissions target verification
indicators.nameCn: 碳排放目标核验
indicators.definition: Assesses whether the company’s disclosed targets are supported by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi), where applicable. Expressed as either NULL or 10 score, with 10 indicating presence of verification.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司所披露的目标是否（在适用情况下）获得科学碳目标倡议（SBTi）的支持。以NULL或10分表示，10分表示存在核验。

indicators.name: SBTi long-term target status
indicators.definition: Indicates the status of the company’s Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) long-term target, aligned with net-zero or long-term decarbonization goals.
indicators.parent: Carbon emissions target verification
indicators.nameCn: SBTi 长期目标状态
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业科学碳目标倡议（SBTi）长期目标的状态，该目标与净零或长期脱碳目标相一致。
indicators.parentCn: 碳排放目标核验

indicators.name: SBTi near-term target status
indicators.definition: Indicates the status of the company’s Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) near-term target, aligned with short-to medium-term emissions reduction goals.
indicators.parent: Carbon emissions target verification
indicators.nameCn: SBTi 近期目标状态
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业科学碳目标倡议（SBTi）近期目标的状态，该目标与短期至中期减排目标相一致。
indicators.parentCn: 碳排放目标核验

scoringNote: 风险型议题将风险敞口与风险管理得分通过总方法论的映射组合，不是两者直接相乘。管理评估可包含实践、绩效、目标及争议扣分；具体组件和行业适用性见本议题 PDF。

name: 清洁技术机遇
summary: 评估企业把握具有环境效益产品市场需求的产品与业务定位。
intro: Opportunities in Clean Tech is a Key Issue in the Environmental Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on their positioning to meet market demand for products with environmental benefits.

indicators.name: Targets to increase investment in clean tech
indicators.nameCn: 增加清洁技术投资的目标
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has disclosed quantitative targets to increase investment in clean technology.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否披露了增加清洁技术投资的定量目标。

indicators.name: Strategic focus on clean technology development
indicators.nameCn: 对清洁技术开发的战略重点
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s strategic commitment to clean technology as part of its core business focus and growth plans. Highest performance reflects clean technology being a core business line or a primary focus for future R&D and innovation. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司将清洁技术作为其核心业务重点和增长计划一部分的战略承诺。最高绩效反映清洁技术是核心业务线或是未来研发与创新的首要重点。以 0–10 分表示，其中 10 表示最高绩效水平。

indicators.name: Research and development intensity (as percentage of sales) score
indicators.nameCn: 研发强度（占销售额百分比）得分
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on R&D intensity metrics (including R&D intensity normalized by sales, and trend in R&D intensity) relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司相对于同业组在研发强度指标（包括以销售额标准化的研发强度，以及研发强度趋势）上的绩效。以 0–10 分表示，其中 10 表示最高绩效水平。

indicators.name: R&D intensity(% of sales) industry relative score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on R&D intensity (as a percentage of sales) relative to its industry peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.parent: Research and development intensity (as percentage of sales) score
indicators.nameCn: 研发强度（占销售额百分比）行业相对得分
indicators.definitionCn: 相对于行业同业，评估企业研发强度（占销售额百分比）的表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
indicators.parentCn: 研发强度（占销售额百分比）得分

indicators.name: Three-year average R&D intensity(% of sales)
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average R&D intensity (as a percentage of sales).
indicators.parent: R&D intensity(% of sales) industry relative score
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均研发强度（占销售额百分比）
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量企业研发强度（占销售额百分比）的三年平均值。
indicators.parentCn: 研发强度（占销售额百分比）行业相对得分

indicators.name: R&D intensity (% of sales) industry relative trend score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s three-year average of year-over-year R&D intensity (as a percentage of sales) trend, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.parent: Research and development intensity (as percentage of sales) score
indicators.nameCn: 研发强度（占销售额百分比）行业相对趋势得分
indicators.definitionCn: 相对于同业，评估企业研发强度（占销售额百分比）同比变化趋势的三年平均表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
indicators.parentCn: 研发强度（占销售额百分比）得分

indicators.name: Three-year average R&D intensity trend (% of sales)
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average of year-over-year R&D intensity (as a percentage of sales) trend.
indicators.parent: R&D intensity (% of sales) industry relative trend score
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均研发强度趋势（占销售额百分比）
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量企业研发强度（占销售额百分比）同比变化趋势的三年平均值。
indicators.parentCn: 研发强度（占销售额百分比）行业相对趋势得分

indicators.name: Clean tech revenue score
indicators.nameCn: 清洁技术收入得分
indicators.definition: The percentage of the company's revenue from clean tech activities. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates that the company derives more than 50% of its revenue from clean technology products and services.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司来自清洁技术活动的收入百分比。以 0-10 分表示，其中 10 表示公司超过 50% 的收入来自清洁技术产品与服务。

scoringNote: 机遇型议题根据机遇敞口与把握机遇的管理能力进行非线性映射。下表是源 PDF 列出的管理指标与子指标；仅凭这些指标不能复算完整官方得分。

name: 绿色建筑机遇
summary: 评估企业物业资产的资源消耗与碳强度、面临绿色建筑法规的敞口，以及把握绿色建筑需求的定位。
intro: Opportunities in Green Building is a Key Issue in the Environmental Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated based on the resource consumption and carbon intensity of their property assets, their potential exposure to environmental building regulations and their efforts to improve the environmental performance of their real estate assets.

indicators.name: Extent of green building certification commitments in portfolio or development pipeline
indicators.nameCn: 投资组合或开发项目中绿色建筑认证承诺的程度
indicators.definition: The portion of the company’s portfolio or development projects that are covered by its green building commitments. Applies to real estate companies only.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司投资组合或开发项目中受其绿色建筑承诺覆盖的部分。仅适用于房地产公司。

indicators.name: Extent of commercial arrangements to improve or maintain property environmental performance
indicators.nameCn: 改善或维持物业环境绩效的商业安排程度
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company provides evidence of implementing commercial agreements to incentivize tenants and property managers to improve property environmental performance. Applies to real estate companies only.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否提供证据，证明其已实施商业协议以激励租户和物业管理方改善物业环境绩效。仅适用于房地产公司。

indicators.name: Use of green or triple-net leases
indicators.nameCn: 绿色租赁或三重净租赁的使用
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company provides evidence of implementing green leases or triple-net leases in its tenancies. Applies to real estate companies only.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否提供证据，证明其租赁业务中实施了绿色租赁或三重净租赁。仅适用于房地产公司。

indicators.name: Green certification commitments related to greenfield developments
indicators.nameCn: 与绿地开发相关的绿色认证承诺
indicators.definition: The company’s green building strategy for greenfield sites, including whether there is a clear statement on avoiding greenfield sites, the company only develops green-certified properties on greenfield developments, or we found no evidence of green certification for greenfield developments. Applies to real estate companies only.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司针对绿地的绿色建筑战略，包括是否明确声明避免绿地开发、公司仅在绿地开发中建设获得绿色认证的物业，或我们未发现绿地开发获得绿色认证的证据。仅适用于房地产公司。

indicators.name: Evidence of flexible or mixed-use properties in portfolio
indicators.nameCn: 投资组合中灵活用途或混合用途物业的证据
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company provides evidence of flexible or mixed-use properties in its property portfolio. Applies to real estate companies only.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否提供证据，证明其物业投资组合中存在灵活用途或混合用途物业。仅适用于房地产公司。

indicators.name: Evidence of urban revitalization developments
indicators.nameCn: 城市更新开发的证据
indicators.definition: The level of urban redevelopment that the company undertakes. Best practice is urban revitalization. Applies to real estate companies only.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司开展的城市再开发程度。最佳实践为城市更新。仅适用于房地产公司。

indicators.name: Green building commitment extends to existing buildings in portfolio (in addition to new buildings)
indicators.nameCn: 绿色建筑承诺延伸至投资组合中的既有建筑（除新建建筑外）
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company renovates or redevelops its existing properties with either green building initiatives or green building certifications. Applies to real estate companies only.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否通过绿色建筑举措或绿色建筑认证对其既有物业进行翻新或再开发。仅适用于房地产公司。

indicators.name: Green building certification score
indicators.nameCn: 绿色建筑认证得分
indicators.definition: Assesses the extent of certified spaces or buildings under selected green building standards. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating highest level of certification coverage across the portfolio.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估在选定绿色建筑标准下获得认证的空间或建筑的程度。以 0-10 分表示，10 表示投资组合中认证覆盖率最高。

indicators.name: Score of green certified buildings as % of total
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on the share of green-certified buildings within its real estate portfolio, calculated as the percentage of total buildings that hold recognized green building certifications. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
indicators.parent: Green building certification score
indicators.nameCn: 绿色认证建筑数量占比得分
indicators.definitionCn: 评估企业房地产组合中绿色认证建筑的占比，按获得认可绿色建筑认证的建筑数量占全部建筑数量的百分比计算。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示最高绩效水平。
indicators.parentCn: 绿色建筑认证得分

indicators.name: Score of green certified space as % of total
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on the share of green-certified space within its real estate portfolio, calculated as the percentage of total floor area that holds recognized green building certifications. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
indicators.parent: Green building certification score
indicators.nameCn: 绿色认证建筑面积占比得分
indicators.definitionCn: 评估企业房地产组合中绿色认证面积的占比，按获得认可绿色建筑认证的建筑面积占总建筑面积的百分比计算。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示最高绩效水平。
indicators.parentCn: 绿色建筑认证得分

indicators.name: Evidence of green certified buildings in real estate portfolio
indicators.definition: Assesses the extent to which the company provides verifiable evidence of green-certified buildings within its real estate portfolio, based on the availability and quality of supporting documentation such as certification records or third-party registries. Expressed as a 0–5 score, where 10 indicates comprehensive and verifiable evidence.
indicators.parent: Green building certification score
indicators.nameCn: 房地产组合中绿色认证建筑的证据
indicators.definitionCn: 根据认证记录、第三方名录等支持文件的可获得性与质量，评估企业提供房地产组合中绿色认证建筑可核实证据的程度。原文写为 0–5 分，同时称 10 表示证据全面且可核实；两者存在冲突，需核对原文。
indicators.parentCn: 绿色建筑认证得分
indicators.sourceNote: 原文同时写 0–5 分与“10 分表示全面披露”，存在标尺冲突；保留原文，未擅自修改范围。

indicators.name: Carbon emissions performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 相对同业组的碳排放绩效
indicators.definition: Assesses the company's performance on greenhouse gas [GHG] emissions intensity (normalized by sales or by units of production), and trend in GHG emissions intensity, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司相对同业组的温室气体[GHG]排放强度（按销售额或产量单位标准化）绩效及温室气体排放强度趋势。以 0-10 分表示，10 表示最高绩效水平。

scoringNote: 机遇型议题根据机遇敞口与把握机遇的管理能力进行非线性映射。下表是源 PDF 列出的管理指标与子指标；仅凭这些指标不能复算完整官方得分。

name: 可再生能源机遇
summary: 评估企业通过新增装机与网络扩张把握可再生能源电力市场需求的定位。
intro: Opportunities in Renewable Energy is a Key Issue in the Environmental Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on their positioning to meet market demand for renewable power through capacity additions and network expansion.

indicators.name: Targets to increase renewable capacity
indicators.nameCn: 提高可再生能源装机容量的目标
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has disclosed quantitative targets to increase renewable energy capacity. Includes targets referring to owned capacity only, i.e., excluding purchasing agreements. Applies to companies with an electricity generation business only.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否披露了提高可再生能源装机容量的定量目标。仅包括针对自有装机容量的目标，即不包括购电协议。仅适用于拥有发电业务的公司。

indicators.name: Internal structures to develop renewable capacity
indicators.nameCn: 发展可再生能源装机容量的内部架构
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s established internal structures related to developing renewable capacity. Best practice is to have a dedicated renewable energy subsidiary or be wholly involved in renewables. Applies to companies with an electricity generation business only.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司与发展可再生能源装机容量相关的既定内部架构。最佳实践是设有专门的可再生能源子公司或完全从事可再生能源业务。仅适用于拥有发电业务的公司。

indicators.name: Investments to increase connection of renewable power to electric grid
indicators.nameCn: 增加可再生电力并网的投资
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has made investments related to the increased connection of renewable power to the electric grid. Applies to companies with an electricity transmission or distribution business only.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否进行了与增加可再生电力并网相关的投资。仅适用于拥有输电或配电业务的公司。

indicators.name: Score of planned additional renewable electricity generation relative to current total capacity
indicators.nameCn: 计划新增可再生能源发电量相对当前总量的得分
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on ratio of planned additional renewable electricity generation to current total capacity. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司在计划新增可再生能源发电量与当前总装机容量之比方面的表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 分表示表现最高。当前总装机容量（MW）

indicators.name: Current Total Installed Capacity (MW)
indicators.definition: The current amount of installed capacity for power generation in megawatts (MW).
indicators.parent: Score of planned additional renewable electricity generation relative to current total capacity
indicators.nameCn: 当前总装机容量（MW）
indicators.definitionCn: 当前发电装机容量，以兆瓦（MW）计。
indicators.parentCn: 计划新增可再生能源发电量相对当前总量的得分

indicators.name: Additional renewable capacity (MW)
indicators.definition: The amount of capacity in megawatts (MW) that an issuer has disclosed as planned additions which are renewables.
indicators.parent: Score of planned additional renewable electricity generation relative to current total capacity
indicators.nameCn: 新增可再生能源装机容量（MW）
indicators.definitionCn: 发行人已披露计划新增、且属于可再生能源的装机容量，以兆瓦（MW）计。
indicators.parentCn: 计划新增可再生能源发电量相对当前总量的得分

indicators.name: Commercializes renewable power equipment
indicators.nameCn: 商业化可再生电力设备
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company implements programs that involve the installation of equipment used in renewable energy generation.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否实施涉及安装可再生能源发电所用设备的方案。

indicators.name: Offers customers a green power option
indicators.nameCn: 为客户提供绿色电力选项
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company offers its customers the option to purchase power from renewable generation sources. Applies to companies with an electricity supply business only.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否为客户提供从可再生能源发电来源购电的选项。仅适用于拥有供电业务的公司。

indicators.name: Renewable power capacity performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 可再生电力装机容量绩效的相对同业表现
indicators.definition: Assesses the company's performance on total renewable energy power capacity (as a percentage of total installed capacity), and trend in renewable energy power capacity, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司在可再生能源总装机容量（占总装机容量的百分比）及可再生能源装机容量趋势方面相对于同业的表现。以 0-10 分表示，10 分表示表现最高。

indicators.name: Renewable power capacity (% of total installed capacity) score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on installed renewable power capacity expressed (as a percentage of total installed capacity). Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.parent: Renewable power capacity performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 可再生能源装机占总装机容量百分比得分
indicators.definitionCn: 评估企业已安装可再生能源装机容量占总装机容量百分比的表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
indicators.parentCn: 可再生电力装机容量绩效的相对同业表现

indicators.name: Three-year average renewable power capacity (% of total installed capacity)
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average installed renewable capacity (as a percentage of total installed capacity).
indicators.parent: Renewable power capacity (% of total installed capacity) score
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均可再生能源装机占总装机容量百分比
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量企业已安装可再生能源装机容量占总装机容量百分比的三年平均值。
indicators.parentCn: 可再生能源装机占总装机容量百分比得分

indicators.name: Renewable power capacity (% of total installed capacity) industry relative trend score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s three-year average of year-over-year installed renewable power capacity (as a percentage of total installed capacity) trend, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.parent: Renewable power capacity performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 可再生能源装机占总装机容量百分比行业相对趋势得分
indicators.definitionCn: 相对于同业，评估企业已安装可再生能源装机占总装机容量百分比同比变化趋势的三年平均表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
indicators.parentCn: 可再生电力装机容量绩效的相对同业表现

indicators.name: Three-year average renewable power capacity trend (% of total installed capacity)
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average of year-over-year installed renewable capacity (as a percentage of total installed capacity) trend.
indicators.parent: Renewable power capacity (% of total installed capacity) industry relative trend score
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均可再生能源装机占总装机容量百分比趋势
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量企业已安装可再生能源装机占总装机容量百分比同比变化趋势的三年平均值。
indicators.parentCn: 可再生能源装机占总装机容量百分比行业相对趋势得分

scoringNote: 机遇型议题根据机遇敞口与把握机遇的管理能力进行非线性映射。下表是源 PDF 列出的管理指标与子指标；仅凭这些指标不能复算完整官方得分。

name: 生物多样性与土地利用
summary: 评估企业运营对其所在区域生物多样性的潜在影响，以及其管理运营环境影响的举措。
intro: Biodiversity & Land Use is a Key Issue in the Environmental Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. MSCI S&C evaluates companies on the potential impact of their operations on biodiversity in their areas of operation and their efforts to manage the environmental impact of their operations.
risks: Loss of formal and social license to operate.
Litigation by landowners and other affected parties.
Increased costs of land protection and reclamation.
risksCn: 失去正式运营许可与社会运营许可。
土地所有者及其他受影响方提起诉讼。
土地保护与复垦成本增加。

indicators.name: Involvement with external stakeholder groups to address the biodiversity impacts of its operations
indicators.nameCn: 与外部利益相关方团体合作以应对其生物多样性影响
indicators.definition: Indicates whether there are external stakeholder groups that work with the company to address the biodiversity impacts of its operations.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明是否存在与公司合作以应对其运营生物多样性影响的外部利益相关方团体。

indicators.name: Scope of third-party engagement or standard to address the biodiversity impacts of operations
indicators.nameCn: 应对生物多样性影响的第三方参与或标准的范围
indicators.definition: The estimated share of operations with ecosystem protection programs certified or assured by an external stakeholder group.
indicators.definitionCn: 获得外部利益相关方团体认证或鉴证的生态系统保护项目所覆盖的运营估计占比。

indicators.name: Commitment to minimize disturbances on biodiversity
indicators.nameCn: 尽量减少对生物多样性干扰的承诺
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has disclosed an explicit commitment to minimize disturbances on biodiversity, for example following the mitigation hierarchy of “avoid, minimize, restore and offset.”
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否披露了尽量减少对生物多样性干扰的明确承诺，例如遵循“避免、减少、恢复和补偿”的减缓层级。

indicators.name: Commitment to reclaim habitat on disturbed land
indicators.nameCn: 复垦受干扰土地栖息地的承诺
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has disclosed an explicit policy to eventually reclaim the habitat of all disturbed land.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否披露了最终复垦所有受干扰土地栖息地的明确政策。

indicators.name: Scope of biodiversity and land reclamation policy
indicators.nameCn: 生物多样性与土地复垦政策的范围
indicators.definition: The scope of operations covered by the company’s disclosed biodiversity and land reclamation policy, where applicable (i.e., all operations including its supply chain, all direct operations, or partial operations).
indicators.definitionCn: 公司所披露的生物多样性与土地复垦政策所覆盖的运营范围（如适用），即包括供应链在内的所有运营、所有直接运营或部分运营。

indicators.name: Extent of programs to protect ecosystems
indicators.nameCn: 生态系统保护方案的程度
indicators.definition: Assesses the comprehensiveness of the company’s steps to protect ecosystems, for example, whether the company creates ecosystem reserves vs. isolated initiatives to protect single species, and whether such practices apply to all major sites or only selected operations.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司保护生态系统措施的全面性，例如公司是建立生态系统保护区还是仅采取保护单一物种的孤立举措，以及此类实践适用于所有主要场所还是仅适用于部分运营。

indicators.name: Conducts biodiversity impact assessments
indicators.nameCn: 开展生物多样性影响评估
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company conducts biodiversity impact assessments prior to settling in new areas.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司在进入新区域之前是否开展生物多样性影响评估。

indicators.name: Oil spills performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 相对同业组的溢油绩效
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on oil spills intensity (normalized by sales), and trend in oil spills intensity, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司相对同业组的溢油强度（按销售额标准化）绩效及溢油强度趋势。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示最高绩效水平。

indicators.name: Oil spill intensity industry relative score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on oil spill intensity metrics (total volume of oil spilled normalized by sales) relative to its industry peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.parent: Oil spills performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 溢油强度行业相对得分
indicators.definitionCn: 相对于行业同业，评估企业溢油强度指标（溢油总量除以销售额）的表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
indicators.parentCn: 相对同业组的溢油绩效

indicators.name: Three-year average oil spill intensity (sales based)
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average oil spill intensity, calculated as total oil spill volume per unit of sales.
indicators.parent: Oil spill intensity industry relative score
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均溢油强度（按销售额）
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量企业溢油总量除以每单位销售额所得溢油强度的三年平均值。
indicators.parentCn: 溢油强度行业相对得分

indicators.name: Oil spill intensity industry relative trend score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on the three-year trend in oil spill intensity (year-over-year change in oil spill volume normalized by sales) relative to its industry peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.parent: Oil spills performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 溢油强度行业相对趋势得分
indicators.definitionCn: 相对于行业同业，评估企业溢油强度的三年趋势，即以销售额为分母的溢油量同比变化。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
indicators.parentCn: 相对同业组的溢油绩效

indicators.name: Three-year average year-over-year oil spill intensity trend (sales based)
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year trend in oil spill intensity.
indicators.parent: Oil spill intensity industry relative trend score
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均溢油强度同比趋势（按销售额）
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量企业溢油强度的三年趋势。
indicators.parentCn: 溢油强度行业相对趋势得分

scoringNote: 风险型议题将风险敞口与风险管理得分通过总方法论的映射组合，不是两者直接相乘。管理评估可包含实践、绩效、目标及争议扣分；具体组件和行业适用性见本议题 PDF。

name: 原材料采购
summary: 评估产品所用原材料的环境影响，以及企业在供应链可追溯性与认证方面的努力。
intro: Raw Material Sourcing is a Key Issue in the Environmental Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on the environmental impacts of the raw materials used in their products and their efforts around supply-chain traceability and certification.
risks: Loss of market access.
Increased cost of goods sold or additional compliance costs.
Regulatory penalties, fines, confiscation of product, or loss of access to government contracts.
Damage to brand value.
Failure to meet consumer demand for more environmentally sound products.
risksCn: 市场准入丧失。
销售成本增加或额外的合规成本。
监管处罚、罚款、产品没收，或丧失政府合同准入资格。
品牌价值受损。
未能满足消费者对更环保产品的需求。

indicators.name: Commitments towards responsible beef and/or dairy sourcing
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has an explicit policy to sustainably source beef and/or dairy (e.g., zero-deforestation beef policy) or whether it belongs to an industry group with such a policy (e.g., the Global Roundtable on Responsible Beef).
indicators.nameCn: 负责任牛肉及乳制品采购承诺
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业是否具有明确的牛肉及乳制品可持续采购政策（例如牛肉零毁林政策），或加入了具有此类政策的行业组织（例如全球可持续牛肉圆桌组织）。

indicators.name: Percentage of beef and/or dairy third-party certified to an environmental sustainability standard
indicators.nameCn: 牛肉和/或乳制品获第三方环境可持续认证的比例
indicators.definition: The estimated share of beef and/or dairy externally certified to sustainable standards (e.g., organic certification).
indicators.definitionCn: 牛肉和/或乳制品经外部可持续标准（如有机认证）认证的估计比例。

indicators.name: Extent of beef and/or dairy certification against the most stringent sustainable criteria
indicators.nameCn: 牛肉和/或乳制品按最严格可持续标准认证的程度
indicators.definition: The estimated share of the company’s supply of beef and/or dairy externally certified to the most stringent sustainable standards (e.g., Rainforest Alliance).
indicators.definitionCn: 公司牛肉和/或乳制品供应经外部最严格可持续标准（如 Rainforest Alliance）认证的估计比例。

indicators.name: Extent of beef and/or dairy traceability to place of origin
indicators.nameCn: 牛肉和/或乳制品追溯至原产地的程度
indicators.definition: The estimated level of traceability of beef and/or dairy up to the plantation/farm level. Best practice is for all products to be traceable.
indicators.definitionCn: 牛肉和/或乳制品追溯至种植园/农场层级的估计程度。最佳实践是所有产品均可追溯。

indicators.name: Extent of supply chain initiatives to address impacts of beef and/or dairy production
indicators.nameCn: 应对牛肉和/或乳制品生产影响的供应链举措程度
indicators.definition: The extent of the company’s initiatives to develop sustainable practices within its beef and/or dairy supply chain, e.g., sustainable land management program, methane reduction program, implementation of specific sustainable requirements for suppliers and verification of compliance.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司在牛肉和/或乳制品供应链内发展可持续实践的举措程度，例如可持续土地管理方案、甲烷减排方案、对供应商实施特定可持续要求并核查合规情况。

indicators.name: Future targets for beef and/or dairy sourcing

indicators.name: Commitments towards responsible leather sourcing

scoringNote: 风险型议题将风险敞口与风险管理得分通过总方法论的映射组合，不是两者直接相乘。管理评估可包含实践、绩效、目标及争议扣分；具体组件和行业适用性见本议题 PDF。

name: 水资源压力
summary: 评估企业运营的水资源强度、运营地区的水资源压力，以及其管理水资源相关风险的举措。
intro: Water Stress is a Key Issue in the Environmental Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on the water intensity of their operations, the water stress in their areas of operations, and their efforts to manage water-related risks.
risks: Operational disruptions to production processes requiring water as a critical input.
Loss of access to markets through community opposition and heightened regulatory hurdles.
Increased costs to comply with more stringent regulations and install equipment and systems to reduce water use.
Higher water use costs.
risksCn: 以水作为关键投入的生产流程发生运营中断。
因社区反对和监管障碍加剧而失去市场准入。
为遵守更严格的法规以及安装减少用水量的设备和系统而增加的成本。
更高的用水成本。

indicators.name: Use of alternative water
indicators.nameCn: 替代水源的使用
indicators.definition: Assesses the company's use of water from non-freshwater sources. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating higher usage from non-freshwater sources.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司对非淡水来源水的使用。以 0-10 分表示，10 表示非淡水来源使用比例更高。

indicators.name: Evidence of using alternative water sources
indicators.definition: Indicates whether there is evidence that the company uses some alternative water sources, but a percentage is not available. Alternative water sources include seawater, brackish water, gray water and rainwater.
indicators.parent: Use of alternative water
indicators.nameCn: 使用替代水源的证据
indicators.definitionCn: 说明是否有证据表明企业使用部分替代水源，但未提供百分比。替代水源包括海水、半咸水、灰水和雨水。
indicators.parentCn: 替代水源的使用

indicators.name: Percentage of water use from alternative water sources
indicators.definition: The amount of water that the company obtains from alternative sources. Alternative water sources include seawater, brackish water, gray water, and rainwater.
indicators.parent: Use of alternative water
indicators.nameCn: 替代水源用水占比
indicators.definitionCn: 企业从替代水源取得的水量。替代水源包括海水、半咸水、灰水和雨水。
indicators.parentCn: 替代水源的使用

indicators.name: Scope of water reduction programs at own operations
indicators.nameCn: 自有运营中节水方案的范围
indicators.definition: Assesses the extent to which the company has implemented water reduction measures at its direct operations.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司在直接运营中实施节水措施的程度。

indicators.name: Programs to reduce water use in value chains
indicators.nameCn: 减少价值链用水量的方案
indicators.definition: Assesses the extent to which the company has implemented or supported operational programs aimed at reducing water use in its value chain.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司实施或支持旨在减少其价值链用水量的运营方案的程度。

indicators.name: Water recycling rate score
indicators.nameCn: 水回收利用率得分
indicators.definition: Assesses the company's water recycling rate based on the company's reported value. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating a higher recycling rate.
indicators.definitionCn: 根据公司报告数值评估其水回收利用率。以 0-10 分表示，10 表示回收利用率更高。

indicators.name: Water recycling rate
indicators.definition: The percentage of recycled or recirculated water of total water usage.
indicators.parent: Water recycling rate score
indicators.nameCn: 水循环利用率
indicators.definitionCn: 循环利用或回用水量占总用水量的百分比。
indicators.parentCn: 水回收利用率得分

indicators.name: Executive body responsible for water management strategy and performance
indicators.nameCn: 负责水管理战略与绩效的执行机构
indicators.definition: Assesses the governing level of water strategy and performance oversight assigned to dedicated individuals or a committee. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating CEO or board-level oversight.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估负责水战略与绩效监督的专职人员或委员会的治理层级。以 0-10 分表示，10 表示首席执行官或董事会层面的监督。

indicators.name: CEO is responsible for water management strategy and performance
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the CEO is responsible for water management strategy and performance.
indicators.parent: Executive body responsible for water management strategy and performance
indicators.nameCn: CEO 负责水管理战略与绩效
indicators.definitionCn: 说明 CEO 是否负责水管理战略与绩效。
indicators.parentCn: 负责水管理战略与绩效的执行机构

indicators.name: CSR or sustainability committee is responsible for water management strategy and performance
indicators.definition: Indicates whether corporate social responsibility or sustainability committees are responsible for water management strategy and performance.
indicators.parent: Executive body responsible for water management strategy and performance
indicators.nameCn: 企业社会责任或可持续发展委员会负责水管理战略与绩效
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业社会责任或可持续发展委员会是否负责水管理战略与绩效。
indicators.parentCn: 负责水管理战略与绩效的执行机构

indicators.name: Non-executive- or non-committee-level task force is responsible for water management strategy and performance
indicators.definition: Indicates whether responsibility for water management strategy and performance is with a nonexecutive-or non-committee-level task force or risk officer.
indicators.parent: Executive body responsible for water management strategy and performance
indicators.nameCn: 非执行人员或非委员会层级工作组负责水管理战略与绩效
indicators.definitionCn: 说明水管理战略与绩效是否由非执行人员或非委员会层级工作组或风险负责人负责。
indicators.parentCn: 负责水管理战略与绩效的执行机构

indicators.name: Senior executive or executive committee is responsible for water management strategy and performance
indicators.definition: Indicates whether a senior executive or executive committee are responsible for water management strategy and performance.
indicators.parent: Executive body responsible for water management strategy and performance
indicators.nameCn: 高级管理人员或执行委员会负责水管理战略与绩效
indicators.definitionCn: 说明高级管理人员或执行委员会是否负责水管理战略与绩效。
indicators.parentCn: 负责水管理战略与绩效的执行机构

indicators.name: Water stress target comprehensiveness
indicators.nameCn: 水资源压力目标的全面性
indicators.definition: Assesses the extent to which a company has established measurable water-related targets that are comprehensive in operational scope. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating a quantitative target that covers all relevant segments.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司建立的可衡量水资源相关目标在运营范围上的全面程度。以 0-10 分表示，10 表示覆盖所有相关业务板块的定量目标。

indicators.name: Evidence of ongoing Water Stress target
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has disclosed an ongoing target addressing water stress or water resource management.
indicators.parent: Water stress target comprehensiveness
indicators.nameCn: 正在执行的水资源压力目标的证据
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业是否披露了正在执行、针对水资源压力或水资源管理的目标。
indicators.parentCn: 水资源压力目标的全面性

indicators.name: Scope of ongoing Water Stress target
indicators.definition: Describes the scope and coverage of the company’s ongoing target related to water stress management.
indicators.parent: Water stress target comprehensiveness
indicators.nameCn: 正在执行的水资源压力目标覆盖范围
indicators.definitionCn: 描述企业正在执行的水资源压力管理目标的范围和覆盖程度。
indicators.parentCn: 水资源压力目标的全面性

indicators.name: Water stress target progress
indicators.nameCn: 水资源压力目标进展
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s progress toward any ongoing water reduction targets or track record of progress toward historical targets. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating higher progress towards targets.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司在任何正在进行的节水目标上的进展，或实现历史目标的过往记录。以 0-10 分表示，10 表示目标进展更高。

indicators.name: Status of ongoing Water Stress target
indicators.definition: Measures the current implementation status of the company’s ongoing target related to water stress management or reduction.
indicators.parent: Water stress target progress
indicators.nameCn: 正在执行的水资源压力目标状态
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量企业正在执行的水资源压力管理或降低目标目前的实施状态。
indicators.parentCn: 水资源压力目标进展

indicators.name: Status of historical Water Stress target
indicators.definition: Measures the achievement or completion status of the company’s historical target related to water stress management or reduction.
indicators.parent: Water stress target progress
indicators.nameCn: 历史水资源压力目标状态

indicators.name: Freshwater consumption intensity industry relative score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on freshwater consumption intensity (per unit of sales or output), relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.parent: Freshwater consumption performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 淡水消耗强度行业相对得分
indicators.definitionCn: 相对于同业，评估企业淡水消耗强度（每单位销售额或产出）的表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。

indicators.name: Three-year average freshwater consumption intensity (sales based)

indicators.parentCn: 相对同业组的淡水消耗绩效

indicators.parentCn: 淡水消耗强度行业相对趋势得分

indicators.parentCn: 淡水消耗强度行业相对趋势得分

indicators.definition: Assesses the company's performance on freshwater withdrawal intensity (normalized by sales or by units of production), and trend in freshwater withdrawal intensity, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司相对同业组的淡水取水强度（按销售额或产量单位标准化）绩效及淡水取水强度趋势。以 0-10 分表示，10 表示绩效强劲。

indicators.nameCn: 淡水取水强度行业相对得分

indicators.definition: Assesses the company's performance on leakage rates, and trend in leakage rates, relative to industry peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance. Applicable to water utility issuers only.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司相对行业同业组的漏水率绩效及漏水率趋势。以 0-10 分表示，10 表示绩效强劲。仅适用于供水公用事业发行人。
