name: 电子废弃物
summary: 评估企业产生的电子废弃物、面临的电子废弃物法规敞口，以及产品回收与循环利用的努力。
intro: Electronic Waste is a Key Issue in the Environmental Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on their production of electronic waste, their potential exposure to electronic waste regulations and their efforts at product collection and recycling.
risks: Loss of access to markets due to regulatory change.
Loss of revenue due to changing consumer demand.
Increased costs due to compliance with producer responsibility regulations.
risksCn: 因法规变化而丧失市场准入。
因消费者需求变化而导致收入损失。
因遵守生产者责任法规而导致成本增加。

indicators.name: Scope of the electronic waste take-back program by product type
indicators.nameCn: 按产品类型划分的电子废弃物回收计划范围
indicators.definition: The scope of products that are eligible for collection and recycling under the company’s electronic waste product recycling program.
indicators.definitionCn: 在公司电子废弃物产品回收计划下，符合收集和回收条件的产品范围。

indicators.name: Scope of the electronic waste take-back program by location
indicators.nameCn: 按地点划分的电子废弃物回收计划范围
indicators.definition: The geographic scope of the company’s product collection and electronic waste recycling program.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司产品收集和电子废弃物回收计划的地理范围。

indicators.name: Scope of electronic waste take-back programs
indicators.nameCn: 电子废弃物回收计划的范围
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s return channels for end-of-life products - drop-off, mail-in, and pick-up. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong initiatives.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司针对报废产品的回收渠道——投放点、邮寄回收和上门取件。以0-10分表示，10分表示举措有力。

indicators.name: Electronic waste take-back programs include drop-off of end-of-life products
indicators.definition: Indicates whether channels for consumers to return end-of-life electronics to the company include drop-off options (at a store or designated drop-off locations).
indicators.parent: Scope of electronic waste take-back programs
indicators.nameCn: 电子废弃物回收计划包括终寿产品送交渠道
indicators.definitionCn: 说明消费者将终寿电子产品退回企业的渠道是否包括送交方式（门店或指定交回地点）。
indicators.parentCn: 电子废弃物回收计划的范围

indicators.name: Electronic waste take-back programs include mail-in of end-of-life products
indicators.definition: Indicates whether available channels for consumers to return end-of-life electronics to the company include mail-in options.
indicators.parent: Scope of electronic waste take-back programs
indicators.nameCn: 电子废弃物回收计划包括终寿产品邮寄渠道
indicators.definitionCn: 说明消费者将终寿电子产品退回企业的可用渠道是否包括邮寄方式。
indicators.parentCn: 电子废弃物回收计划的范围

indicators.name: Electronic waste take-back programs include pick-up of end-of-life products
indicators.definition: Indicates whether available channels for consumers to return end-of-life electronics to the company include pick-up options.
indicators.parent: Scope of electronic waste take-back programs
indicators.nameCn: 电子废弃物回收计划包括终寿产品上门收取渠道
indicators.definitionCn: 说明消费者将终寿电子产品退回企业的可用渠道是否包括上门收取方式。
indicators.parentCn: 电子废弃物回收计划的范围

indicators.name: Electronic waste take-back program exists but no details given
indicators.definition: Indicates whether channels exist for consumers to return end-of-life electronics to the company, but details are not provided.
indicators.parent: Scope of electronic waste take-back programs
indicators.nameCn: 存在电子废弃物回收计划但未提供详情
indicators.definitionCn: 说明是否存在消费者将终寿电子产品退回企业的渠道，但未提供具体信息。
indicators.parentCn: 电子废弃物回收计划的范围

indicators.name: Facilities that handle recycling of collected electronics
indicators.nameCn: 处理所收集电子产品回收的设施
indicators.definition: Assesses company efforts in managing electronic waste through recycling. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong initiatives.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司通过回收管理电子废弃物的努力。以0-10分表示，10分表示举措有力。

indicators.name: Company-operated electronic waste recycling facilities
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company operates its own electronic waste recycling facilities. The company may also use vendors or participate in recycling management organizations for electronic waste recycling.
indicators.parent: Facilities that handle recycling of collected electronics
indicators.nameCn: 企业自营电子废弃物回收设施
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业是否运营自有电子废弃物回收设施。企业也可能使用服务商或参加回收管理组织进行电子废弃物回收。
indicators.parentCn: 处理所收集电子产品回收的设施

indicators.name: Participation in electronic waste recycling programs
indicators.definition: Indicates that the company participates in electronic waste (e-waste) recycling management organizations (or recycling consortia/network) that support or operate recycling facilities. The company may also operate its own facilities or use vendors for e-waste recycling.
indicators.parent: Facilities that handle recycling of collected electronics
indicators.nameCn: 参加电子废弃物回收计划
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业参加支持或运营回收设施的电子废弃物回收管理组织、联合体或网络。企业也可能运营自有设施或使用服务商回收电子废弃物。
indicators.parentCn: 处理所收集电子产品回收的设施

indicators.name: Vendor-operated electronic waste recycling facilities
indicators.definition: Indicates that the company uses designated vendors that operate electronic waste (e-waste) recycling facilities. The company may also operate its own facilities or participate in recycling management organizations for e-waste recycling. Moreover, indicates whether these vendors audited or certified by the company or third-party audit programs (including but not limited to R2, e-stewards and WEEELABEX).
indicators.parent: Facilities that handle recycling of collected electronics
indicators.nameCn: 服务商运营的电子废弃物回收设施
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业使用指定服务商运营的电子废弃物回收设施。企业也可能运营自有设施或参加电子废弃物回收管理组织。此外，说明这些服务商是否接受企业或第三方审计项目的审计或认证，包括但不限于 R2、e-stewards 和 WEEELABEX。
indicators.parentCn: 处理所收集电子产品回收的设施

indicators.name: Unspecified electronic waste recycling activities
indicators.definition: Indicates that the company has a general statement on recycling electronic waste (e-waste) with no further details regarding the facilities, vendors or organizations that handle recycling of collected e-waste.
indicators.parent: Facilities that handle recycling of collected electronics
indicators.nameCn: 未具体说明的电子废弃物回收活动
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业对电子废弃物回收有一般性声明，但未进一步说明负责所收集电子废弃物回收的设施、服务商或组织。
indicators.parentCn: 处理所收集电子产品回收的设施

indicators.name: Explicit ban on electronic waste exports to non-OECD countries
indicators.nameCn: 明确禁止向非OECD国家出口电子废弃物
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company explicitly bans electronic waste exports from OECD member countries to non-OECD member countries for disposal and recovery, in accordance with the Basel Ban Amendment to the Basel Convention.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否依据《巴塞尔公约》的《巴塞尔禁令修正案》，明确禁止将电子废弃物从OECD成员国出口至非OECD成员国进行处置和回收。

indicators.name: End of life electronic waste recycling
indicators.nameCn: 报废电子废弃物回收
indicators.definition: Assesses the company's performance on the share of electronic waste that is recovered and subsequently recycled by the company. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong performance.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司在被其回收并随后进行再生利用的电子废弃物占比方面的绩效。以0-10分表示，10分表示绩效强劲。

indicators.name: Percentage of electronic waste recycled – Reported
indicators.definition: Indicates the proportion of collected end-of-life electronic waste that is successfully recycled and repurposed relative to the total end-of-life products and e-waste recovered.
indicators.parent: End of life electronic waste recycling
indicators.nameCn: 电子废弃物回收比例（已报告）
indicators.definitionCn: 说明所收集终寿电子废弃物中成功回收并再利用的部分，占全部回收终寿产品和电子废弃物的比例。
indicators.parentCn: 报废电子废弃物回收

scoringNote: 风险型议题将风险敞口与风险管理得分通过总方法论的映射组合，不是两者直接相乘。管理评估可包含实践、绩效、目标及争议扣分；具体组件和行业适用性见本议题 PDF。

name: 包装材料与废弃物
summary: 评估企业对包装材料的生产或依赖、面临的废弃物管理与包装法规敞口，以及降低包装环境影响的做法。
intro: Packaging Material & Waste is a Key Issue in the Environmental Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on their production of or reliance upon packaging materials, their potential exposure to waste management and packaging regulations, as well as their efforts to reduce the environmental impact of packaging materials.
risks: Loss of access to markets due to reform of regulations governing packaging material and waste.
Loss of revenue due to changing consumer preferences.
Increased costs to reformulate packaging and comply with producer responsibility regulations.
risksCn: 因包装材料及废弃物相关法规改革而失去市场准入。
因消费者偏好变化而损失收入。
因重新设计包装及遵守生产者责任法规而导致成本增加。

indicators.name: Disclosure of packaging material mix
indicators.nameCn: 包装材料构成的披露
indicators.definition: How transparent the company is about the type of materials used in its packaging. Best practice is full disclosure.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司在包装所用材料类型方面的透明度。最佳实践是完整披露。

indicators.name: Scope of consumer programs to reduce waste
indicators.nameCn: 减少废弃物的消费者方案的覆盖范围
indicators.definition: The scope of the company’s consumer education programs on recycling (e.g., take-back locations) or recycling instructions.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司关于回收的消费者教育方案（如回收点）或回收指引的覆盖范围。

indicators.name: Scope of recycling programs where not mandated by law
indicators.nameCn: 法律未强制要求的回收方案的覆盖范围
indicators.definition: The extent of the company’s involvement in recycling or recovery of packaging materials in locations or circumstances where packaging waste recycling is not mandated by law. Best practice is to have an overarching packaging waste strategy.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司在法律未强制要求包装废弃物回收的地区或情形下参与包装材料回收或再生利用的程度。最佳实践是制定一项总体性的包装废弃物战略。

indicators.name: Strategy to reduce the environmental impact of packaging
indicators.nameCn: 降低包装环境影响的战略
indicators.definition: The comprehensiveness of the company’s strategy to reduce the environmental impact of its packaging, such as through waste elimination, packaging redesign, and engagement with suppliers or customers. Best practice is to have specific initiatives that reduce the environmental impact of packaging.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司降低其包装环境影响的战略的全面性，例如通过减少废弃物、重新设计包装以及与供应商或客户互动。最佳实践是制定减少包装环境影响的具体举措。

indicators.name: Targets related to packaging content
indicators.nameCn: 与包装成分相关的目标
indicators.definition: Assesses the company's targets and their scope focused on recycled material content of packaging. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong initiatives.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司针对包装再生材料成分的目标及其范围。以 0-10 分表示，10 分表示举措强。

indicators.name: Scope of targets to increase recycled material content of packaging
indicators.definition: Indicates the scope of a company's target to incorporate postconsumer recycled materials into its packaging.
indicators.parent: Targets related to packaging content
indicators.nameCn: 提高包装再生材料含量目标的覆盖范围
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业在包装中使用消费后再生材料目标的覆盖范围。
indicators.parentCn: 与包装成分相关的目标

indicators.name: Targets to increase recycled or renewable material content of packaging
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has specific targets for improving packaging content, such as increasing recycled content, renewable content, or eliminating problematic or hard-to-recycle plastic content.
indicators.parent: Targets related to packaging content
indicators.nameCn: 提高包装再生或可再生材料含量的目标
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业是否设有改善包装成分的具体目标，例如增加再生材料或可再生材料含量，或去除有问题、难回收的塑料成分。
indicators.parentCn: 与包装成分相关的目标

indicators.name: Targets related to packaging material circularity or waste elimination
indicators.nameCn: 与包装材料循环利用或减少废弃物相关的目标
indicators.definition: Assesses the company's targets and their scope focused on packaging material circularity or waste elimination. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong initiatives.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司针对包装材料循环利用或减少废弃物的目标及其范围。以 0-10 分表示，10 分表示举措强。

indicators.name: Scope of targets for packaging material circularity or waste elimination
indicators.definition: Indicates the scope of environmental targets related to material recovery or waste elimination in packaging.
indicators.parent: Targets related to packaging material circularity or waste elimination
indicators.nameCn: 包装材料循环性或消除废弃物目标的覆盖范围
indicators.definitionCn: 说明包装中与材料回收或消除废弃物相关的环境目标的覆盖范围。
indicators.parentCn: 与包装材料循环利用或减少废弃物相关的目标

indicators.name: Targets for packaging material circularity or waste elimination
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has specific targets related to improving product recovery through packaging.
indicators.parent: Targets related to packaging material circularity or waste elimination
indicators.nameCn: 包装材料循环性或消除废弃物目标
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业是否设有通过包装改善产品回收的具体目标。
indicators.parentCn: 与包装材料循环利用或减少废弃物相关的目标

indicators.name: Scope of environmental improvements in packaging
indicators.nameCn: 包装环境改善措施的覆盖范围
indicators.definition: Assesses the company's achievements on packaging content (e.g. light-weighted, recycled content).
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司在包装成分方面（如轻量化、再生材料含量）的成果。

indicators.name: Scope of product or packaging recovery
indicators.nameCn: 产品或包装回收的覆盖范围
indicators.definition: Assesses the company's achievements on product or packaging recovery.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司在产品或包装回收方面的成果。

scoringNote: 风险型议题将风险敞口与风险管理得分通过总方法论的映射组合，不是两者直接相乘。管理评估可包含实践、绩效、目标及争议扣分；具体组件和行业适用性见本议题 PDF。

name: 有毒排放与废弃物
summary: 评估企业运营可能造成的环境污染与有毒或致癌排放，以及其环境管理体系的强度。
intro: Toxic Emissions & Waste is a Key Issue in the Environmental Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on the potential environmental contamination and toxic or carcinogenic emissions arising from their operations and the strength of their environmental management systems.
risks: Increased costs from liabilities associated with damaging health, property.
Loss of access to markets through community opposition, heightened regulatory hurdles.
Increased costs to meet compliance standards and install equipment and systems to contain pollution.
risksCn: 因损害健康、财产而产生的责任导致成本增加。
因社区反对、监管门槛提高而失去市场准入。
为满足合规标准以及安装控制污染的设备与系统而增加的成本。

indicators.name: Scope and frequency of environmental impact audits
indicators.nameCn: 环境影响审核的范围与频率
indicators.definition: Assesses whether the company conducts regular audits to assess and manage environmental risks and impacts. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong initiatives.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司是否开展定期审核以评估和管理环境风险与影响。以 0-10 分表示，其中 10 表示举措有力。

indicators.name: Evidence of environmental impact audits
indicators.definition: Indicates whether there is evidence that the company conducts internal and/or external environmental audits of its relevant operations. This could include, for example, an EMS certified to ISO 14001 or a similar framework, which requires regular audits.
indicators.parent: Scope and frequency of environmental impact audits
indicators.nameCn: 环境影响审计的证据
indicators.definitionCn: 说明是否有证据表明企业对相关运营开展内部及外部环境审计。例如，获得 ISO 14001 或类似框架认证的环境管理体系（EMS）要求定期审计。
indicators.parentCn: 环境影响审核的范围与频率

indicators.name: Evidence of audits across all locations of operations
indicators.definition: Indicates whether there is evidence of environmental audits across all locations of operations.
indicators.parent: Scope and frequency of environmental impact audits
indicators.nameCn: 所有运营地点审计的证据
indicators.definitionCn: 说明是否有证据表明环境审计覆盖所有运营地点。
indicators.parentCn: 环境影响审核的范围与频率

indicators.name: Evidence of annual environmental impact audits
indicators.definition: Indicates whether there is evidence that the company carries out annual environmental impact audits.
indicators.parent: Scope and frequency of environmental impact audits
indicators.nameCn: 每年环境影响审计的证据
indicators.definitionCn: 说明是否有证据表明企业每年开展环境影响审计。
indicators.parentCn: 环境影响审核的范围与频率

indicators.name: Existence of environmental management system
indicators.nameCn: 环境管理体系的存在
indicators.definition: Indicates whether there is evidence that the company has an Environmental Management System (EMS) in place across all or selected relevant operations. This could include, for example, an EMS certified to ISO 14001, registration under EMAS, or a similar framework.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明是否有证据显示公司在全部或选定的相关运营中建立了环境管理体系（EMS）。例如，可能包括通过 ISO 14001 认证的环境管理体系、在 EMAS 下的注册，或类似的框架。

indicators.name: Extent of programs to reduce toxic emissions of supply chain
indicators.nameCn: 减少供应链有毒排放的方案覆盖程度
indicators.definition: Indicates the extent to which the company has established programs to reduce toxic emissions within its supply chain. Best practice is for suppliers’ environmental management to be subject to screening and audits.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司在多大程度上建立了减少其供应链内有毒排放的方案。最佳实践是供应商的环境管理接受筛查和审核。

indicators.name: Scope of policies to address environmental impacts
indicators.nameCn: 应对环境影响的政策范围
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has formal policies in place to address environmental impacts such as air emissions, water discharges, and waste.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否制定了正式政策以应对诸如大气排放、废水排放和废弃物等环境影响。

indicators.name: Certified environmental system score
indicators.nameCn: 认证环境体系得分
indicators.definition: Assesses the extent of the company's sites with an environmental management system certified to ISO 14001 or similar. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating the highest degree of certification.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司有多少场所拥有通过 ISO 14001 或类似标准认证的环境管理体系。以 0-10 分表示，其中 10 表示认证程度最高。

indicators.name: Percentage of operations with an environmental management system certified to ISO 14001 or HAZWOPER
indicators.definition: The percentage of sites with hazardous waste guidance that follow ISO 14001 or HAZWOPER certification for waste management.
indicators.parent: Certified environmental system score
indicators.nameCn: 环境管理体系获得 ISO 14001 或 HAZWOPER 认证的运营占比
indicators.definitionCn: 具有危险废弃物管理指引、并遵循 ISO 14001 或 HAZWOPER 废弃物管理认证的场所占比。
indicators.parentCn: 认证环境体系得分

indicators.name: Toxic emissions & waste target comprehensiveness
indicators.nameCn: 有毒排放与废弃物目标的全面性
indicators.definition: Assesses the extent to which a company has established toxic waste reduction targets that have a measurable reduction scope and are complete in coverage. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating a quantitative target that covers all segments.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司在多大程度上建立了具有可衡量减排范围且覆盖完整的有毒废物减排目标。以 0-10 分表示，其中 10 表示覆盖所有业务板块的定量目标。

indicators.name: Evidence of ongoing Toxic Emissions & Waste target
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has an ongoing toxic emissions and/or waste reduction target.
indicators.parent: Toxic emissions & waste target comprehensiveness
indicators.nameCn: 正在执行的有毒排放与废弃物目标的证据
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业是否具有正在执行的有毒排放或废弃物减少目标。
indicators.parentCn: 有毒排放与废弃物目标的全面性

indicators.name: Scope of ongoing Toxic Emissions & Waste target
indicators.definition: Assess the scope of coverage of the ongoing toxic emissions and/or waste target. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates that the target covers all relevant segments of the company's operations.
indicators.parent: Toxic emissions & waste target comprehensiveness
indicators.nameCn: 正在执行的有毒排放与废弃物目标覆盖范围
indicators.definitionCn: 评估正在执行的有毒排放或废弃物目标的覆盖范围。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示目标涵盖企业运营的所有相关部分。
indicators.parentCn: 有毒排放与废弃物目标的全面性

indicators.name: Toxic emissions & waste target progress
indicators.nameCn: 有毒排放与废弃物目标进展
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s to-date progress on active toxic emissions & waste targets, as well as its historical track record in meeting previously stated targets. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating achievement of stated target.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司当前有毒排放与废弃物目标的迄今进展，以及其在实现此前公布目标方面的历史记录。以 0-10 分表示，其中 10 表示已实现公布的目标。

indicators.name: Status of ongoing Toxic Emissions & Waste target
indicators.definition: Measures the current implementation status of the company’s ongoing target on toxic emissions and/or waste management, by assessing the current progress against the target.
indicators.parent: Toxic emissions & waste target progress
indicators.nameCn: 正在执行的有毒排放与废弃物目标状态
indicators.definitionCn: 通过评估相对于目标的当前进展，衡量企业正在执行的有毒排放或废弃物管理目标目前的实施状态。
indicators.parentCn: 有毒排放与废弃物目标进展

indicators.name: Status of historical Toxic Emissions & Waste target
indicators.definition: Measures the achievement or completion status of the company’s historical target on toxic emissions and/or waste management, by assessing whether the stated target was achieved or not.
indicators.parent: Toxic emissions & waste target progress
indicators.nameCn: 历史有毒排放与废弃物目标状态
indicators.definitionCn: 通过评估既定目标是否实现，衡量企业历史有毒排放或废弃物管理目标的实现或完成状态。
indicators.parentCn: 有毒排放与废弃物目标进展

indicators.name: NOx emissions performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 相对同业的氮氧化物排放绩效
indicators.definition: Assesses the company's performance on nitrogen oxides (NOx) emissions intensity (normalized by sales or by units of production), and trend in NOx emissions intensity, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司相对于同业组在氮氧化物（NOx）排放强度（以销售额或产量单位标准化）以及 NOx 排放强度趋势上的绩效。以 0-10 分表示，其中 10 表示绩效强劲。

indicators.name: NOx emissions intensity industry relative score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on nitrogen oxide (NOx) emissions intensity (emissions per unit of sales or production), relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.parent: NOx emissions performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: NOx 排放强度行业相对得分
indicators.definitionCn: 相对于同业，评估企业氮氧化物（NOx）排放强度（每单位销售额或产量排放量）的表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
indicators.parentCn: 相对同业的氮氧化物排放绩效

indicators.name: Three-year average NOx emissions intensity (sales based)
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average NOx emissions (per unit of sales).
indicators.parent: NOx emissions intensity industry relative score
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均 NOx 排放强度（按销售额）
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量企业每单位销售额 NOx 排放量的三年平均值。
indicators.parentCn: NOx 排放强度行业相对得分

indicators.name: Three-year average NOx emissions intensity (production based)
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average NOx emissions (per megawatt-hour generated).
indicators.parent: NOx emissions intensity industry relative score
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均 NOx 排放强度（按产量）
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量企业每发电兆瓦时 NOx 排放量的三年平均值。
indicators.parentCn: NOx 排放强度行业相对得分

indicators.name: NOx emissions intensity industry relative trend score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on the three-year average of year-over-year NOx emissions (per unit of sales or production) trend, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.parent: NOx emissions performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: NOx 排放强度行业相对趋势得分
indicators.definitionCn: 相对于同业，评估企业 NOx 排放量（每单位销售额或产量）同比变化趋势的三年平均表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
indicators.parentCn: 相对同业的氮氧化物排放绩效

indicators.name: Three-year average NOx emissions intensity trend (sales based)
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average of year-over-year NOx emissions (per unit of sales) trend.
indicators.parent: NOx emissions intensity industry relative trend score
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均 NOx 排放强度趋势（按销售额）
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量企业每单位销售额 NOx 排放量同比变化趋势的三年平均值。
indicators.parentCn: NOx 排放强度行业相对趋势得分

indicators.name: Three-year average NOx emissions intensity trend (production based)
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average of year-over-year NOx emissions (per megawatt-hour generated) trend.
indicators.parent: NOx emissions intensity industry relative trend score
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均 NOx 排放强度趋势（按产量）
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量企业每发电兆瓦时 NOx 排放量同比变化趋势的三年平均值。
indicators.parentCn: NOx 排放强度行业相对趋势得分

indicators.definitionCn: 相对于同业，评估企业硫氧化物（SOx）排放强度（每单位销售额或产量排放量）的表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。

indicators.definition: Assesses the company's performance on volatile organic compounds (VOC) emissions intensity (normalized by sales), and trend in VOC emissions intensity, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司相对于同业组在挥发性有机物（VOC）排放强度（以销售额标准化）以及 VOC 排放强度趋势上的绩效。以 0-10 分表示，其中 10 表示绩效强劲。

name: 健康与安全
summary: 评估企业的工作场所安全管理，以及其所在行业与地区的工作场所安全标准。
intro: Health & Safety is a Key Issue in the Social Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on their management of workplace safety and the workplace safety standards in the industries and regions in which they operate.
risks: Decreased operational efficiency, production disruptions.
Increased costs from litigation, penalties and fines.
Loss of access to markets or growth opportunities from negative reputational effects.
risksCn: 运营效率下降、生产中断。
诉讼、处罚和罚款带来的成本增加。
负面声誉影响导致的市场准入或增长机会丧失。

indicators.name: Scope of health and safety policy
indicators.nameCn: 健康与安全政策的适用范围
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company’s health and safety policy applies to all operations or select operations.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司的健康与安全政策适用于所有运营还是部分运营。

indicators.name: Applicability of health and safety policy to contractors
indicators.nameCn: 健康与安全政策对承包商的适用性
indicators.definition: Indicates whether contractors are held to the same health and safety policies as employees.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明承包商是否须遵守与员工相同的健康与安全政策。

indicators.name: Health and safety policy and practices are audited
indicators.nameCn: 健康与安全政策及实践经过审计
indicators.definition: Indicates whether there is evidence that the company conducts internal and/or external audits of its health & safety policy and practices. This could include, for example, certification to ISO 45001 or a similar framework, which requires regular audits.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明是否有证据显示公司对其健康与安全政策及实践进行内部和/或外部审计。这可能包括例如获得 ISO 45001 或类似框架的认证，此类认证要求定期审计。

indicators.name: Health and safety performance is a factor in CEO compensation
indicators.nameCn: 健康与安全绩效是 CEO 薪酬的考量因素
indicators.definition: Indicates whether CEO compensation is linked to health and safety performance.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明 CEO 薪酬是否与健康与安全绩效挂钩。

indicators.name: Body responsible for health & safety strategy and performance
indicators.nameCn: 负责健康与安全战略与绩效的机构
indicators.definition: Assesses whether the health & safety strategy and performance oversight is assigned to a dedicated individual, team, or committee. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating that the CEO is responsible for these practices.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估健康与安全战略及绩效监督是否分配给专门的个人、团队或委员会。以 0-10 分表示，10 分表示 CEO 负责这些实践。

indicators.name: CEO is responsible for health and safety strategy
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company’s CEO has explicit responsibility for oversight of the company’s health and safety strategy and performance.
indicators.parent: Body responsible for health & safety strategy and performance

indicators.name: Senior executive or executive committee are responsible for health and safety strategy

indicators.parent: Body responsible for health & safety strategy and performance
indicators.nameCn: 高级管理人员或执行委员会负责健康与安全战略

indicators.parentCn: 负责健康与安全战略与绩效的机构

indicators.parentCn: 负责健康与安全战略与绩效的机构

indicators.name: Percentage of operations having health and safety management systems certified to recognized standard

indicators.name: Target to improve health and safety performance

indicators.definition: The type of target set by the company to reduce employee accidents and fatalities. Best practice is to set a quantifiable (non-zero) accident reduction target that includes contractors and employees.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司为减少员工事故和死亡而设定的目标类型。最佳实践是设定包含承包商和员工的、可量化（非零）的事故减少目标。

indicators.nameCn: 总可记录伤害率（每百万工时）行业相对得分
indicators.definitionCn: 相对于行业同业，评估企业总可记录伤害率，即每百万工时可记录伤害数量。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
indicators.parentCn: 总可记录伤害率绩效的相对同业表现

indicators.name: Three-year average Total recordable injury rate (per million hours worked)
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均总可记录伤害率（每百万工时）
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average Total Recordable Injury Rate (per million hours worked).
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量公司三年平均总可记录伤害率（每百万工时）。总可记录伤害率（每百万工时）
indicators.parent: Total recordable injury rate (per million hours worked) industry relative score
indicators.parentCn: 总可记录伤害率（每百万工时）行业相对得分

indicators.name: Total recordable injury rate (per million hours worked) industry relative trend score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on the three-year average of year-over-year Total Recordable Injury Rate (per million hours worked) trend, relative to its industry peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.parent: Total recordable injury rate performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 总可记录伤害率（每百万工时）行业相对趋势得分
indicators.definitionCn: 相对于同业，评估企业总可记录伤害率（每百万工时）同比变化趋势的三年平均表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
indicators.parentCn: 总可记录伤害率绩效的相对同业表现

indicators.name: Three-year average Total recordable injury rate trend (per million hours worked)
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均总可记录伤害率趋势（每百万工时）
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average of year-over-year Total recordable injury rate (per million hours worked) trend.
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量公司总可记录伤害率（每百万工时）同比趋势的三年平均值。
indicators.parent: Total recordable injury rate (per million hours worked) industry relative trend score
indicators.parentCn: 总可记录伤害率（每百万工时）行业相对趋势得分

indicators.name: Fatality intensity performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 死亡强度绩效的相对同业表现
indicators.definition: Assesses the company's performance on fatalities intensity (normalized by number of employees and/or by sales), relative to industry peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating zero fatalities.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司在死亡强度（按员工人数和/或销售额标准化）方面相对于行业同业的表现。以 0-10 分表示，10 分表示零死亡。

indicators.name: Fatalities industry relative score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on fatalities normalized per 100,000 employees and/or sales, relative to its industry peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.parent: Fatality intensity performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 死亡事故行业相对得分
indicators.definitionCn: 相对于同业，评估以每 100,000 名员工或销售额为分母的死亡人数表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
indicators.parentCn: 死亡强度绩效的相对同业表现

indicators.name: Three-year average fatalities (per 100,000 employees)
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均死亡人数（每 100,000 名员工）
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average fatalities per 100,000 employees.
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量公司每 100,000 名员工的三年平均死亡人数。
indicators.parent: Fatalities industry relative score
indicators.parentCn: 死亡事故行业相对得分

indicators.name: Three-year average fatalities per million USD in sales
indicators.nameCn: 每百万美元销售额的三年平均死亡人数
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average fatalities per million USD in sales.
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量公司每百万美元销售额的三年平均死亡人数。
indicators.parent: Fatalities industry relative score
indicators.parentCn: 死亡事故行业相对得分

scoringNote: 风险型议题将风险敞口与风险管理得分通过总方法论的映射组合，不是两者直接相乘。管理评估可包含实践、绩效、目标及争议扣分；具体组件和行业适用性见本议题 PDF。

name: 人力资本发展
summary: 评估企业的人才需求，以及其吸引、留住和培养高技能劳动力的能力。
intro: Human Capital Development is a Key Issue in the Social Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on their workforce talent requirements and their ability to attract, retain and develop a highly skilled workforce.
risks: Inability to attract skilled talent to fill role requirements, loss of competitiveness.
Loss of intellectual and human capital through attrition, key-person risk.
Increased costs associated with high employee turnover (e.g., recruitment, training).
Low workforce productivity.
risksCn: 无法吸引熟练人才以满足岗位要求，丧失竞争力。
因人员流失而损失智力资本和人力资本，关键人员风险。
与员工高流动率相关的成本增加（如招聘、培训）。
劳动力生产率低下。

indicators.name: Extent of human resource-related grievance reporting or escalation procedures
indicators.nameCn: 与人力资源相关的申诉报告或上报程序的程度
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has an internal reporting channel or escalation procedures for employees to report human resource-related grievances.
indicators.definitionCn: 说明公司是否有内部报告渠道或上报程序，供员工报告与人力资源相关的申诉。

indicators.name: Employee satisfaction survey frequency
indicators.nameCn: 员工满意度调查频率
indicators.definition: The frequency of employee satisfaction surveys. Best practice is at least annually.
indicators.definitionCn: 员工满意度调查的频率。最佳实践是至少每年一次。

indicators.name: Formal talent pipeline development strategy
indicators.nameCn: 正式的人才梯队培养战略
indicators.definition: Indicates whether a company has a formal talent pipeline development strategy in place, evidenced through structured recruitment programs (such as graduate traineeships, internships, or apprenticeships) and explicit statements linking talent pipeline development to the company’s long-term business or workforce strategy.
indicators.definitionCn: 说明公司是否制定了正式的人才梯队培养战略，其证据包括结构化的招聘项目（如毕业生培训计划、实习或学徒制）以及将人才梯队培养与公司长期业务或劳动力战略相联系的明确表述。

indicators.name: Employee equity programs
indicators.nameCn: 员工股权方案
indicators.definition: The extent of eligibility for an employee stock ownership plan and/or an employee stock purchase plan. Best practice is for all permanent employees to have access to such programs to participate.
indicators.definitionCn: 员工持股计划和/或员工购股计划的资格覆盖程度。最佳实践是所有正式员工均可参与此类方案。

indicators.name: Variable performance-based component to pay
indicators.nameCn: 薪酬中基于绩效的可变部分
indicators.definition: Indicates whether non-officer and non-sales staff are eligible for variable performance-based pay, such as bonuses.
indicators.definitionCn: 说明非管理人员和非销售员工是否有资格获得基于绩效的可变薪酬，如奖金。

indicators.name: Workforce eligible for paid parental leave policy
indicators.nameCn: 有资格享受带薪育儿假政策的员工范围
indicators.definition: Assesses the extent to which the company’s workforce is eligible for material non-pay benefits, evaluated through the company’s paid parental leave policies, considering both the duration of paid leave and the scope of employee coverage based on publicly available information. The industry-leading practice is when a company’s paid parental leave policies cover all employees across its global operations.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司员工有资格享受实质性非现金福利的程度，通过公司的带薪育儿假政策进行评估，同时考虑带薪假的时长和员工覆盖范围（基于公开可得信息）。行业领先实践是公司的带薪育儿假政策覆盖其全球业务中的所有员工。

indicators.name: Regular performance appraisals and feedback processes
indicators.nameCn: 定期的绩效评估和反馈流程
indicators.definition: Indicates whether and to what extent the company undertakes programs for employee professional development, such as performance reviews, goal setting and review, or similar. Best practice is for such programs to be provided to all permanent employees.
indicators.definitionCn: 说明公司是否开展以及开展程度如何的员工职业发展项目，如绩效评估、目标设定与回顾等。最佳实践是此类项目提供给所有正式员工。

indicators.name: Skills and knowledge development training
indicators.nameCn: 技能与知识发展培训
indicators.definition: The extent of managerial/leadership development training. Best practice is a training program in which all employees participate.
indicators.definitionCn: 管理/领导力发展培训的程度。最佳实践是全体员工参与培训项目。

indicators.name: Employee turnover rate performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 相对于同业组的员工流动率绩效
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on reported employee turnover rate, and trend in employee turnover rate, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司在所报告的员工流动率以及员工流动率趋势方面相对于同业组的表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 分表示绩效强。

indicators.name: Employee turnover rate industry relative score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on employee turnover rate relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.parent: Employee turnover rate performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 员工流失率行业相对得分
indicators.definitionCn: 相对于同业，评估企业员工流失率的表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
indicators.parentCn: 相对于同业组的员工流动率绩效

indicators.name: Three-year average employee turnover rate
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均员工流动率
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average employee turnover rate.
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量公司的三年平均员工流动率。
indicators.parent: Employee turnover rate industry relative score
indicators.parentCn: 员工流失率行业相对得分

indicators.name: Employee turnover rate industry relative trend score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on the three-year average of year-over-year trend in employee turnover rate, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.parent: Employee turnover rate performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 员工流失率行业相对趋势得分
indicators.definitionCn: 相对于同业，评估企业员工流失率同比变化趋势的三年平均表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
indicators.parentCn: 相对于同业组的员工流动率绩效

indicators.name: Three-year average employee turnover rate trend
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均员工流动率趋势
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average of year-over-year employee turnover rate trend.
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量公司三年平均的同比员工流动率趋势。
indicators.parent: Employee turnover rate industry relative trend score
indicators.parentCn: 员工流失率行业相对趋势得分

indicators.name: External recognition as employer of choice (last three years)
indicators.nameCn: 作为理想雇主的外部认可（最近三年）
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company received external recognition as an employer of choice in the last three years.
indicators.definitionCn: 说明公司在最近三年是否获得作为理想雇主的外部认可。

name: 劳工管理
summary: 结合劳动力规模、劳动强度与地理分布，评估企业吸引、激励和发展庞大复杂劳动力队伍的能力。
intro: Labor Management is a Key Issue in the Social Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on their ability to engage, incentivize, and develop a large and complex workforce, taking into account workforce size, labor intensity, and geographic footprint.
risks: Production delays due to labor unrest.
Reduced productivity and product quality.
Loss of growth opportunities, market share or pricing power due to damage to brand value.
risksCn: 因劳工动荡而导致的生产延误。
生产率和产品质量下降。
因品牌价值受损而丧失增长机会、市场份额或定价能力。

indicators.name: Employee equity programs
indicators.nameCn: 员工股权方案
indicators.definition: The extent of eligibility for an employee stock ownership plan and/or an employee stock purchase plan. Best practice is for all permanent employees to have access to such programs to participate.
indicators.definitionCn: 员工持股计划和/或员工购股计划的适用资格范围。最佳实践是让所有正式员工都能参与此类方案。

indicators.name: Workforce eligible for paid parental leave policy
indicators.nameCn: 符合带薪育儿假政策资格的员工
indicators.definition: Assesses the extent to which the company’s workforce is eligible for material non-pay benefits, evaluated through the company’s paid parental leave policies, considering both the duration of paid leave and the scope of employee coverage based on publicly available information. The industry-leading practice is when a company’s paid parental leave policies cover all employees across its global operations.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司员工符合实质性非薪酬福利资格的程度，通过公司的带薪育儿假政策进行评估，同时考虑带薪假期时长和基于公开信息可得的员工覆盖范围。行业领先实践是公司的带薪育儿假政策覆盖其全球运营中的所有员工。

indicators.name: Scope of workforce eligibility for variable performance-based component to pay
indicators.nameCn: 浮动绩效薪酬组件适用的员工范围
indicators.definition: Indicates whether non-officer staff are eligible for variable performance-based pay, such as bonuses, and considers the scope of employees eligible for performance-based pay.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明非高管员工是否有资格获得浮动绩效薪酬（如奖金），并考虑符合绩效薪酬资格的员工范围。

indicators.name: Employee satisfaction survey frequency
indicators.nameCn: 员工满意度调查频率
indicators.definition: The frequency of employee satisfaction surveys. Best practice is at least annually.
indicators.definitionCn: 员工满意度调查的频率。最佳实践是至少每年一次。

indicators.name: Restructuring policies and programs
indicators.nameCn: 重组政策与方案
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has established clear policies for employees following a restructuring or layoff, such as offering severance pay or assistance with outplacement, reemployment or retraining.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否在重组或裁员后为员工制定了明确的政策，例如提供遣散费或再就业安置、重新就业或再培训方面的协助。

indicators.name: Skills and knowledge development training
indicators.nameCn: 技能与知识发展培训
indicators.definition: The extent of managerial/leadership development training. Best practice is a training program in which all employees participate.
indicators.definitionCn: 管理/领导力发展培训的范围。最佳实践是所有员工都参与的培训计划。

indicators.name: Support for degree programs or certifications for employees
indicators.nameCn: 对员工学位项目或认证的支持
indicators.definition: The scope of the company's workforce eligible for support in pursuing degree programs or new certifications through tuition or fees reimbursement, etc.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司员工有资格通过学费或费用报销等方式获得攻读学位项目或获取新认证支持的范围。

scoringNote: 风险型议题将风险敞口与风险管理得分通过总方法论的映射组合，不是两者直接相乘。管理评估可包含实践、绩效、目标及争议扣分；具体组件和行业适用性见本议题 PDF。

name: 供应链劳工标准
summary: 评估企业供应链的管理与透明度，以及其供应商所在地区的劳动标准状况。
intro: Supply Chain Labor Standards is a Key Issue in the Social Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on the management and transparency of their supply chain and the working standards in the regions in which their suppliers are located.
risks: Production delays due to labor unrest in supply chains.
Reduced productivity and product quality.
Loss of growth opportunities, market share or pricing power due to negative publicity and damage to brand value.
risksCn: 因供应链中的劳工骚乱导致生产延误。
生产率和产品质量下降。
因负面报道和品牌价值受损而丧失增长机会、市场份额或定价能力。

indicators.name: Scope of supplier code of conduct
indicators.nameCn: 供应商行为准则的覆盖范围
indicators.definition: Assesses inclusion of key labor standards in supplier code of conduct such as wages, working hours and worker protections. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong initiatives.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估供应商行为准则中对关键劳工标准的纳入情况，如工资、工作时间和劳动者保护。以 0-10 分表示，10 分表示举措强。

indicators.name: Supply chain code of conduct covers anti-discrimination
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company’s supply chain code of conduct sets forth requirements forbidding suppliers from engaging in discrimination regarding their employees.
indicators.parent: Scope of supplier code of conduct
indicators.nameCn: 供应链行为准则涵盖反歧视
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业供应链行为准则是否规定了禁止供应商歧视其员工的要求。
indicators.parentCn: 供应商行为准则的覆盖范围

indicators.name: Supply chain code of conduct covers child labor
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company’s supply chain code of conduct forbids suppliers to use underage labor.
indicators.parent: Scope of supplier code of conduct
indicators.nameCn: 供应链行为准则涵盖童工
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业供应链行为准则是否禁止供应商使用未成年劳工。
indicators.parentCn: 供应商行为准则的覆盖范围

indicators.name: Supply chain code of conduct covers forced labor
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company’s supply chain code of conduct forbids suppliers to use forced labor.
indicators.parent: Scope of supplier code of conduct
indicators.nameCn: 供应链行为准则涵盖强迫劳动
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业供应链行为准则是否禁止供应商使用强迫劳动。
indicators.parentCn: 供应商行为准则的覆盖范围

indicators.name: Supply chain code of conduct covers freedom of association
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company’s supply chain code of conduct sets forth requirements that suppliers respect freedom of association and allow workers to unionize if desired.
indicators.parent: Scope of supplier code of conduct
indicators.nameCn: 供应链行为准则涵盖结社自由
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业供应链行为准则是否要求供应商尊重结社自由，并允许有意愿的工人加入工会。
indicators.parentCn: 供应商行为准则的覆盖范围

indicators.name: Supply chain code of conduct covers health and safety
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company’s supply chain code of conduct sets forth requirements regarding health and safety working conditions at supplier factories.
indicators.parent: Scope of supplier code of conduct
indicators.nameCn: 供应链行为准则涵盖健康与安全
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业供应链行为准则是否对供应商工厂的健康与安全工作条件作出要求。
indicators.parentCn: 供应商行为准则的覆盖范围

indicators.name: Supply chain code of conduct covers minimum wage
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company’s supply chain code of conduct sets forth requirements regarding the minimum wages that suppliers must pay their employees.
indicators.parent: Scope of supplier code of conduct
indicators.nameCn: 供应链行为准则涵盖最低工资
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业供应链行为准则是否对供应商必须支付给员工的最低工资作出要求。
indicators.parentCn: 供应商行为准则的覆盖范围

indicators.name: Supply chain code of conduct covers paid overtime
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company’s supply chain code of conduct sets forth requirements that suppliers pay overtime wages when employees must work overtime hours.
indicators.parent: Scope of supplier code of conduct
indicators.nameCn: 供应链行为准则涵盖加班报酬
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业供应链行为准则是否要求供应商在员工必须加班时支付加班工资。
indicators.parentCn: 供应商行为准则的覆盖范围

indicators.name: Supply chain code of conduct covers working hours
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company’s supply chain code of conduct sets forth requirements limiting the amount of hours suppliers’ employees may be required to work in a day or a week.
indicators.parent: Scope of supplier code of conduct
indicators.nameCn: 供应链行为准则涵盖工作时间
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业供应链行为准则是否限制供应商每日或每周可要求员工工作的时数。
indicators.parentCn: 供应商行为准则的覆盖范围

indicators.name: Trains suppliers on labor related social issues
indicators.nameCn: 就劳工相关社会议题培训供应商
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has specific training programs in place with its suppliers on its supplier code of conduct or specific labor-related issues.
indicators.definitionCn: 说明公司是否有针对其供应商行为准则或特定劳工相关议题的具体培训项目。

indicators.name: Supplier selection based on labor management performance
indicators.nameCn: 基于劳工管理绩效的供应商选择
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company considers suppliers’ performance in allocating or renewing contracts, and/or placing further orders.
indicators.definitionCn: 说明公司在分配或续签合同，和/或下达进一步订单时是否考虑供应商的绩效。

indicators.name: Evidence of supplier audits
indicators.nameCn: 供应商审计的证据
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company conducts internal and/or external audits across its supply chain.
indicators.definitionCn: 说明公司是否在其供应链中开展内部和/或外部审计。

indicators.name: Action taken to address supplier misconduct
indicators.nameCn: 针对供应商不当行为采取的行动
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company provides evidence of developing a remediation action plan when incidents of noncompliance with its code of conduct are found.
indicators.definitionCn: 说明公司是否提供证据，表明在发现违反其行为准则的事件时会制定整改行动计划。

indicators.name: Extent of disclosure on instances of supplier misconduct
indicators.nameCn: 对供应商不当行为事件的披露程度
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company discloses the frequency and type of noncompliance incidents found in its supply chain.
indicators.definitionCn: 说明公司是否披露在其供应链中发现的不合规事件的频率和类型。

indicators.name: Scope of supplier audits
indicators.nameCn: 供应商审计的覆盖范围
indicators.definition: Assesses the extent of audits conducted across the company's supply chains. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong initiatives.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司供应链中开展的审计程度。以 0-10 分表示，10 分表示举措强。

indicators.name: Tier 1 supplier audits (direct suppliers)
indicators.definition: Indicates whether some or all Tier 1 suppliers (i.e., direct suppliers) are covered by the social audit program of the company.
indicators.parent: Scope of supplier audits
indicators.nameCn: 一级供应商审计（直接供应商）
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业社会审计计划是否覆盖部分或全部一级供应商（即直接供应商）。
indicators.parentCn: 供应商审计的覆盖范围

indicators.name: Tier 2 suppliers audits (components)
indicators.definition: Indicates whether some or all Tier 2 suppliers (i.e., components) are covered by the social audit program of the company.
indicators.parent: Scope of supplier audits
indicators.nameCn: 二级供应商审计（零部件）
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业社会审计计划是否覆盖部分或全部二级供应商（即零部件供应商）。
indicators.parentCn: 供应商审计的覆盖范围

indicators.name: Tier 3 suppliers audits (raw materials)
indicators.definition: Indicates whether some or all Tier 3 suppliers (i.e., raw materials) are covered by the social audit program of the company.
indicators.parent: Scope of supplier audits
indicators.nameCn: 三级供应商审计（原材料）
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业社会审计计划是否覆盖部分或全部三级供应商（即原材料供应商）。
indicators.parentCn: 供应商审计的覆盖范围

indicators.name: Effectiveness of grievance mechanisms
indicators.nameCn: 申诉机制的有效性
indicators.definition: Assesses the effectiveness of grievance mechanisms for supply chain workers.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估供应链工人申诉机制的有效性。

indicators.name: Commitment to pay living wage for workers in supply chains
indicators.nameCn: 为供应链工人支付生活工资的承诺
indicators.definition: Assesses the company's commitment to pay a living wage to its supply chain workers.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司向供应链工人支付生活工资的承诺。

scoringNote: 风险型议题将风险敞口与风险管理得分通过总方法论的映射组合，不是两者直接相乘。管理评估可包含实践、绩效、目标及争议扣分；具体组件和行业适用性见本议题 PDF。

name: 化学品安全
summary: 评估企业产品组合中可能存在的有害化学品、面临的化学品法规收紧或待定敞口，以及开发低害替代品的努力。
intro: Chemical Safety is a Key Issue in the Social Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on the possible presence of harmful chemicals in their product portfolio, their potential exposure to strengthening or pending chemical regulations and their efforts to develop less- harmful alternatives.
risks: Loss of access to markets due to regulatory reform.
Loss of revenue due to supply disruptions and changing consumer demand.
Increased costs from reformulating products.
risksCn: 因监管改革而丧失市场准入。
因供应中断和消费者需求变化而导致收入损失。
因重新配制产品而导致的成本增加。

indicators.name: Scope of chemical phase-out plan
indicators.nameCn: 化学品淘汰计划的范围
indicators.definition: The scope of products or chemicals of concern that the company is targeting to phase out.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司计划淘汰的关注产品或关注化学品的范围。

indicators.name: Level of efforts to identify substances for regulatory risk
indicators.nameCn: 识别监管风险物质的工作力度
indicators.definition: The level of identification of chemicals that are regulated or have the potential to be regulated in the company’s products. Best practice is to identify all chemicals.
indicators.definitionCn: 对公司产品中受监管或有可能受监管的化学品的识别程度。最佳实践是识别所有化学品。

indicators.name: Scope of disclosure of registration and use of regulated substances
indicators.nameCn: 受监管物质注册与使用情况的披露范围
indicators.definition: The level of disclosure around substances that fall within regulatory registration requirements. Best practice is to disclose all regulatory registrations and use.
indicators.definitionCn: 对属于法规注册要求的物质的披露程度。最佳实践是披露所有法规注册和使用情况。

indicators.name: Environmental and health standards in new product design
indicators.nameCn: 新产品设计中的环境和健康标准
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has a formal process to apply environmental and health standards in new product design.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否有正式流程在新产品设计中应用环境和健康标准。

indicators.name: Demonstrated track record of reducing reliance on substances of concern
indicators.nameCn: 减少对关注物质依赖的既往实绩
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has demonstrated a track record of introducing viable alternatives to high-concern substances. Applies specifically to chemical producers.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否有引入高关注物质可行替代品的既往实绩。专门适用于化学品生产商。

indicators.name: Demonstrated track record of phasing out and/or reformulating products with chemicals of concern
indicators.nameCn: 逐步淘汰和／或重新配制含受关注化学品产品的既往实绩
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has demonstrated a track record of introducing viable alternatives to high-concern substances. Applies specifically to product manufacturers other than chemical producers.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否有引入高关注物质可行替代品的既往实绩。专门适用于化学品生产商以外的产品制造商。

indicators.name: Initiatives to improve consumer awareness on product chemical content
indicators.nameCn: 提升消费者对产品化学成分认知的举措
indicators.definition: The level of initiatives to improve consumer awareness on product chemical content through channels that are easy for consumers to access. Best practice is to provide information regarding product chemical content and usage to consumers. Applies specifically to product manufacturers.
indicators.definitionCn: 通过消费者易于获取的渠道提升其对产品化学成分认知的举措力度。最佳实践是向消费者提供有关产品化学成分和使用的信息。专门适用于产品制造商。

indicators.name: Extent of substances or products that a company conducts hazard assessments
indicators.nameCn: 公司开展危害评估的物质或产品范围
indicators.definition: Describes the extent of substances or products on which the company conducts a chemical safety hazard assessment. Applies specifically to chemical producers.
indicators.definitionCn: 描述公司开展化学品安全危害评估的物质或产品范围。专门适用于化学品生产商。

scoringNote: 风险型议题将风险敞口与风险管理得分通过总方法论的映射组合，不是两者直接相乘。管理评估可包含实践、绩效、目标及争议扣分；具体组件和行业适用性见本议题 PDF。

name: 消费者金融保护
summary: 针对金融机构，评估其产品管理与透明度，包括缓释不道德信贷行为或销售行为带来的声誉与监管风险。
intro: Consumer Financial Protection is a Key Issue in the Social Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Financial institutions are evaluated on product stewardship and transparency, including efforts to mitigate potential reputational and regulatory risks arising from unethical lending practices or mis-selling financial products to consumers.
risks: Unanticipated credit losses due to non-transparent or unsustainable products.
Loss of market access due to regulatory change.
Increased costs from litigation or regulatory penalties.
risksCn: 因不透明或不可持续的产品而产生的意外信用损失。
因监管变化而失去市场准入。
因诉讼或监管处罚而增加的成本。

indicators.name: Debt collection policy
indicators.nameCn: 债务催收政策
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has a formal debt collection policy supported by training of relevant employees.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否制定了正式的债务催收政策，并以对相关员工的培训为支持。

indicators.name: Employee training on consumer financial protection
indicators.nameCn: 消费者金融保护方面的员工培训
indicators.definition: The scope of employee training programs related to consumer financial protection, including financial literacy and ethical selling practices.
indicators.definitionCn: 与消费者金融保护相关的员工培训方案的范围，包括金融素养和合乎道德的销售实践。

indicators.name: Fair advertising policy
indicators.nameCn: 公平广告政策
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has a policy on fair marketing practices supported by an oversight committee or training of relevant employees.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否制定了关于公平营销实践的政策，并以监督委员会或对相关员工的培训为支持。

indicators.name: Financial education initiatives and stakeholder outreach
indicators.nameCn: 金融教育举措与利益相关方沟通
indicators.definition: The extent of programs to improve financial literacy, either through formal partnerships with financial education organizations, targeted initiatives for specific demographics or general outreach programs.
indicators.definitionCn: 提升金融素养的方案覆盖程度，方式包括与金融教育组织建立正式合作、针对特定人群的定向举措或一般性沟通方案。

indicators.name: Company offers loan modification options
indicators.nameCn: 公司提供贷款重组选项
indicators.definition: Indicates whether loan modification options are available to retail customers, including income-based repayment plans and access to escalation options.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明是否向零售客户提供贷款重组选项，包括基于收入的还款计划和升级选项的获取途径。

indicators.name: Oversight of complaint resolution process
indicators.nameCn: 投诉解决流程的监督
indicators.definition: Indicates whether there is board-level oversight, management-level committee oversight, or a formal monitoring group for customer complaints.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明是否存在针对客户投诉的董事会层面监督、管理层委员会监督或正式监督小组。

indicators.name: Financial product complaint handling process
indicators.nameCn: 金融产品投诉处理流程
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has a formal process to handle customer complaints through a customer ombudsman, an internal complaint review body or a complaint hotline.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否通过客户申诉专员、内部投诉审查机构或投诉热线建立了处理客户投诉的正式流程。

indicators.name: Oversight of financial product or service reviews
indicators.nameCn: 金融产品或服务审查的监督
indicators.definition: Indicates whether there is board-level oversight, management-level committee oversight or another internal review body that is responsible for reviewing products and services.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明是否存在负责审查产品和服务的董事会层面监督、管理层委员会监督或其他内部审查机构。

indicators.name: Evidence of offering high-risk lending products
indicators.nameCn: 提供高风险贷款产品的证据
indicators.definition: Indicates whether there is evidence the company offers high-risk lending products. High risk lending products includes, but is not limited to, payday, pawn, doorstep, title, logbook, tax refund anticipation, and loans with predatory interest rates or fees.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明是否有证据显示公司提供高风险贷款产品。高风险贷款产品包括但不限于发薪日贷款、典当贷款、上门贷款、产权贷款、车辆登记证贷款、退税预期贷款，以及具有掠夺性利率或费用的贷款。

indicators.name: Complaints growth (three-year rolling average)
indicators.nameCn: 投诉增长（三年滚动平均）
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the customer complaints against the company are increasing, stable, or decreasing based on a three-year rolling average.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明基于三年滚动平均，针对公司的客户投诉是在增加、稳定还是减少。

indicators.name: Consumer financial protection practices score for covered bond issuers
indicators.nameCn: 担保债券发行人的消费者金融保护实践得分
indicators.definition: Indicates the strength of consumer financial protection practices relevant to the assets in the cover pool, proxied by the average practices of loan originators in the country of domicile. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong practices.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明与担保池中资产相关的消费者金融保护实践的强度，以公司注册国贷款发放机构的平均实践作为代理。以 0–10 分表示，其中 10 表示实践有力。

indicators.name: Consumer financial protection performance score for covered bond issuers
indicators.nameCn: 担保债券发行人的消费者金融保护绩效得分
indicators.definition: Indicates performance on consumer financial protection metrics relevant to the assets in the cover pool, proxied by the average performance of loan originators in the country of domicile. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明与担保池中资产相关的消费者金融保护指标上的绩效，以公司注册国贷款发放机构的平均绩效作为代理。以 0–10 分表示，其中 10 表示绩效强劲。

scoringNote: 风险型议题将风险敞口与风险管理得分通过总方法论的映射组合，不是两者直接相乘。管理评估可包含实践、绩效、目标及争议扣分；具体组件和行业适用性见本议题 PDF。

name: 隐私与数据安全
summary: 评估企业收集个人数据的规模、面临的隐私法规演变与收紧敞口、潜在数据泄露风险，以及个人数据保护体系。
intro: Privacy & Data Security is a Key Issue in the Social Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on the amount of personal data they collect, their exposure to evolving or increasing privacy regulations, their vulnerability to potential data breaches, and their systems for protecting personal data.
risks: Loss of revenue or unanticipated remediation and litigation costs in the event of a data breach or misuse.
Damage to reputation in the event of a breach or controversy over how data is used.
Loss of significant market or forced change in business model if regulatory action restricts how companies may use data.
Increased costs to comply with new or evolving regulations.
risksCn: 在发生数据泄露或数据滥用时，收入损失或意外的补救与诉讼成本。
在发生泄露或就数据使用方式产生争议时，声誉受损。
若监管行动限制公司使用数据的方式，将失去重要市场或被迫改变业务模式。
为遵守新的或不断演变的法规而增加的成本。

indicators.name: Scope of employee training on privacy and data security
indicators.nameCn: 隐私与数据安全员工培训的范围
indicators.definition: The coverage of privacy and data security training across the workforce. Best practice is for training to be provided to all employees, including contractors.
indicators.definitionCn: 隐私与数据安全培训在全体员工中的覆盖范围。最佳实践是向所有员工（包括承包商）提供培训。

indicators.name: Responsibility for privacy and data security
indicators.nameCn: 隐私与数据安全的责任归属
indicators.definition: The group (board-level committee, C-suite or executive committee, or special task force or risk officer) responsible for the company’s privacy and data security risk and strategy.
indicators.definitionCn: 负责公司隐私与数据安全风险及战略的团队（董事会层面委员会、最高管理层或执行委员会，或特别工作组或风险官）。

indicators.name: Measures to address data breaches
indicators.nameCn: 应对数据泄露的措施
indicators.definition: The scope of the data breach or incident response plan the company has in place, including whether the plan is proactive, reactive or limited in scope.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司已建立的数据泄露或事件响应计划的范围，包括该计划是主动型、被动型还是范围有限。

indicators.name: Frequency of audits of information security system
indicators.nameCn: 信息安全系统审核的频率
indicators.definition: The frequency with which the company audits its information security policies and systems.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司审核其信息安全政策与系统的频率。

indicators.name: Rights provided to consumers regarding the control of their data
indicators.nameCn: 就数据控制向消费者提供的权利
indicators.definition: The extent of the rights provided by the company to individuals regarding the access, rectification and deletion of individuals’ data.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司就个人数据的访问、更正和删除向个人提供的权利范围。

indicators.name: Scope of data protection policy
indicators.nameCn: 数据保护政策的范围
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company’s data protection policy governs all or selected business lines. A data protection policy must contain at least the following basic provisions: (1) clarifying collection purposes, (2) clarifying the means by which the company collects data, and (3) clarifying whether third parties have access to data and for what purposes.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司的数据保护政策是涵盖全部还是选定的业务线。数据保护政策必须至少包含以下基本条款：(1) 明确收集目的，(2) 明确公司收集数据的方式，(3) 明确第三方是否可以访问数据及其目的。

indicators.name: Scope of information security management system certifications
indicators.nameCn: 信息安全管理体系认证的范围
indicators.definition: The scope of the company’s information security management system certification to widely recognized standards. Best practice is for most (over 80%) of owned operations to be certified to widely recognized standards, such as ISO 27001, TRUSTe, Privacy Mark and SSAE16 soc2.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司信息安全管理体系按广泛认可标准进行认证的范围。最佳实践是大部分（超过 80%）自有运营通过广泛认可标准的认证，如 ISO 27001、TRUSTe、Privacy Mark 和 SSAE16 soc2。

indicators.name: Privacy enhancing technologies and initiatives
indicators.nameCn: 隐私增强技术与举措
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s practice on integrating privacy-enhancing technologies and initiatives into its products or services. Best practices include systematically applying the privacy-by-design principle during product or service development, and conducting privacy impact assessments on existing offerings before introducing new ones.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司将隐私增强技术与举措整合进其产品或服务的实践。最佳实践包括在产品或服务开发过程中系统性地应用隐私设计（privacy-by-design）原则，并在推出新产品之前对现有产品进行隐私影响评估。

indicators.name: Consent policy for use of consumer data for secondary purposes
indicators.nameCn: 将消费者数据用于次要目的的同意政策
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s policy or practice regarding the processing customer data for secondary purposes and the consent options provided to customers, such as opt-in or opt-out mechanisms.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司关于为次要目的处理客户数据的政策或实践，以及向客户提供的同意选项，例如选择加入（opt-in）或选择退出（opt-out）机制。

indicators.name: Data protection programs covering suppliers and business partners
indicators.nameCn: 涵盖供应商与业务伙伴的数据保护方案
indicators.definition: The extent of the company’s data protection or privacy programs covering suppliers and business partners that handle the company’s data or have access to the company’s network. Best practice is for them to be required to have data protection policies or abide by the company’s policy and for inspections to be conducted to verify their compliance.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司覆盖处理其数据或可访问其网络的供应商与业务伙伴的数据保护或隐私方案的范围。最佳实践是要求他们制定数据保护政策或遵守公司的政策，并进行检查以核实其合规情况。

scoringNote: 风险型议题将风险敞口与风险管理得分通过总方法论的映射组合，不是两者直接相乘。管理评估可包含实践、绩效、目标及争议扣分；具体组件和行业适用性见本议题 PDF。

name: 产品安全与质量
summary: 评估企业面临的召回或产品安全风险敞口、供应链与采购体系强度、制造质量管理努力及召回应对记录。
intro: Product Safety & Quality is a Key Issue in the Social Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on their exposure to possible recalls or product safety concerns, the strength of their supply chain and sourcing systems, their quality management efforts in manufacturing and their responsible marketing practices.
risks: Damage to brand value from loss of consumer trust or negative publicity.
Increased costs to comply with additional regulatory requirements or litigation.
Increased costs of implementing large-scale product recalls or to fulfill warranties.
risksCn: 因消费者信任丧失或负面报道对品牌价值造成的损害。
为遵守额外监管要求或应对诉讼而增加的成本。
实施大规模产品召回或履行保修而增加的成本。

indicators.name: Existence of contingency plans/mitigation control systems to ensure that products are in stock, reliable and safe
indicators.nameCn: 确保产品库存充足、可靠和安全的应急预案/减缓控制系统的存在
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has contingency plans/mitigation control systems to ensure that products are in stock, reliable, and safe.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否制定应急预案/减缓控制系统，以确保产品库存充足、可靠和安全。

indicators.name: Measures and reports quantitative indicators related to service quality performance or customer protection
indicators.nameCn: 衡量并报告与服务质量绩效或客户保护相关的定量指标
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company measures and reports quantitative indicators related to service quality performance or customer protection (e.g., clinical quality reports, customer surveys).
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否衡量并报告与服务质量绩效或客户保护相关的定量指标（例如临床质量报告、客户调查）。

indicators.name: Certification to product safety or quality standard
indicators.nameCn: 产品安全或质量标准认证
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company's products are certified to internationally recognized safety and quality standards. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong initiatives.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司产品是否获得国际公认的安全与质量标准认证。以 0-10 分表示，10 表示举措有力。

indicators.name: Extent of certification to a widely accepted product safety/quality standard
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company certifies its own operations with a widely accepted product safety/quality standard (e.g., HACCP, ISO 9001, ISO/TS 16949, ISO 13485 or equivalent).
indicators.parent: Certification to product safety or quality standard
indicators.nameCn: 广泛认可的产品安全与质量标准认证范围
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业是否为自有运营取得广泛认可的产品安全与质量标准认证，例如 HACCP、ISO 9001、ISO/TS 16949、ISO 13485 或同等标准。
indicators.parentCn: 产品安全或质量标准认证

indicators.name: Extent of certification to an internally developed product safety/quality standard
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company certifies its own operations with an internally developed product safety/quality standard.
indicators.parent: Certification to product safety or quality standard
indicators.nameCn: 内部制定的产品安全与质量标准认证范围
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业是否为自有运营取得内部制定的产品安全与质量标准认证。
indicators.parentCn: 产品安全或质量标准认证

indicators.name: Scope of employee training on product quality
indicators.nameCn: 员工产品质量培训范围
indicators.definition: The scope of the company’s employee training on product safety and quality. Best practice is for all employees to receive training on product quality standards.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司员工产品安全与质量培训的范围。最佳实践为所有员工均接受产品质量标准培训。

indicators.name: Extent of product testing capacity
indicators.nameCn: 产品检测能力的程度
indicators.definition: The extent of the company’s product testing capacity, e.g., third-party or in-house testing.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司产品检测能力的程度，例如第三方或内部检测。

indicators.name: Audit/control procedures on responsible marketing
indicators.nameCn: 负责任营销的审计/控制程序
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company conducts audits or control procedures to assess compliance with its responsible marketing policies.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否开展审计或控制程序，以评估其对负责任营销政策的遵守情况。

indicators.name: Policy on responsible marketing, advertising and sales
indicators.nameCn: 负责任营销、广告与销售政策
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has explicitly stated a policy on responsible marketing, advertising and sales.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否明确制定了负责任营销、广告与销售政策。

indicators.name: Membership in recognized industry-wide partnership(s) on supply chain risk evaluation and mitigation
indicators.nameCn: 加入公认的供应链风险评估与减缓行业范围伙伴关系
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company is a member of industry initiatives or partnerships that evaluate supply chain risk and undertake relevant mitigation programs.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否为评估供应链风险并开展相关减缓方案的行业倡议或伙伴关系的成员。

indicators.name: Supplier certification level
indicators.nameCn: 供应商认证水平
indicators.definition: Assesses whether suppliers at each level (e.g., Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3) possess relevant safety, and quality certifications. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong initiatives.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估各层级供应商（例如一级、二级、三级）是否具备相关的安全与质量认证。以 0-10 分表示，10 表示举措有力。

indicators.name: General statement on supplier certification of quality procedures
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company makes general statements regarding the certification or oversight of its supply chain quality, without providing further detail on certification at specific levels of its supply chain
indicators.parent: Supplier certification level
indicators.nameCn: 供应商质量程序认证的一般性声明
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业是否对供应链质量认证或监督作出一般性声明，但未进一步提供供应链具体层级的认证详情。
indicators.parentCn: 供应商认证水平

indicators.name: Tier 1 - Direct supplier facilities and processes certified by company employees or third-party auditors
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company oversees the quality processes of its direct supplier (Tier 1) facilities and processes through certification or audits by a third party or by company employees.
indicators.parent: Supplier certification level
indicators.nameCn: 一级直接供应商设施与流程由企业员工或第三方审计人员认证
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业是否通过第三方或企业员工开展认证或审计，监督直接供应商（一级供应商）设施与流程的质量程序。
indicators.parentCn: 供应商认证水平

indicators.name: Tier 2 - Indirect/sub supplier facilities and processes certified by company employees or third-party auditors
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company oversees the quality processes of its indirect/sub-supplier (Tier 2) facilities and processes through certification or audits by a third party or by company employees.
indicators.parent: Supplier certification level
indicators.nameCn: 二级间接或次级供应商设施与流程由企业员工或第三方审计人员认证
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业是否通过第三方或企业员工开展认证或审计，监督间接或次级供应商（二级供应商）设施与流程的质量程序。
indicators.parentCn: 供应商认证水平

indicators.name: Tier 3 - Ingredients/raw materials checked for quality on a regular basis
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company oversees the quality processes of its ingredients/raw materials (Tier 3) through certification or audits by a third party or by company employees.
indicators.parent: Supplier certification level
indicators.nameCn: 三级配料或原材料的质量定期检查
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业是否通过第三方或企业员工开展认证或审计，监督配料或原材料（三级供应商）的质量程序。
indicators.parentCn: 供应商认证水平

indicators.name: Scope of supplier training on quality standards
indicators.nameCn: 供应商质量标准培训范围
indicators.definition: The extent to which the company trains suppliers on quality standards, requirements, and processes. Best practice is to train all suppliers.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司就质量标准、要求和流程对供应商开展培训的程度。最佳实践为培训所有供应商。

indicators.name: Product responsibility & integrity
indicators.nameCn: 产品责任与诚信
indicators.definition: Assesses how responsibly and ethically a company designs, delivers and promotes its products and services. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong initiatives.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司在设计、交付和推广其产品与服务方面的负责任与道德程度。以 0-10 分表示，10 表示举措有力。

indicators.name: Medical Loss Ratio (MLR) performance score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s Medical Loss Ratio, reflecting the proportion of premiums spent on medical services versus administrative costs. Higher scores indicate stronger alignment with service quality and regulatory expectations in managed healthcare. Applicable to Managed Healthcare industry only.
indicators.parent: Product responsibility & integrity
indicators.nameCn: 医疗赔付率（MLR）绩效得分
indicators.definitionCn: 评估企业医疗赔付率，反映保费用于医疗服务与行政成本的比例。得分越高，表示在管理式医疗中更符合服务质量和监管期望。仅适用于管理式医疗行业。
indicators.parentCn: 产品责任与诚信

indicators.name: Teaching staff score
indicators.definition: Assesses the proportion of teaching staff relative to the total workforce. Applicable to Education Services industry only.
indicators.parent: Product responsibility & integrity
indicators.nameCn: 教学人员得分
indicators.definitionCn: 评估教学人员占员工总数的比例。仅适用于教育服务行业。
indicators.parentCn: 产品责任与诚信

indicators.name: Instruction to marketing expense ratio score
indicators.definition: Assesses the proportion of instruction and student services expenses to marketing and recruitment expenses. Applicable to Education Services industry only.
indicators.parent: Product responsibility & integrity
indicators.nameCn: 教学与营销费用比率得分
indicators.definitionCn: 评估教学及学生服务费用与营销及招生费用的比例。仅适用于教育服务行业。
indicators.parentCn: 产品责任与诚信

indicators.name: Marketing and recruitment expenses score
indicators.definition: Assesses the proportion of marketing expenses relative to the total sales revenue. Applicable to Education Services industry only.
indicators.parent: Product responsibility & integrity
indicators.nameCn: 营销及招生费用得分
indicators.definitionCn: 评估营销费用占销售收入总额的比例。仅适用于教育服务行业。
indicators.parentCn: 产品责任与诚信

indicators.name: Responsible gambling policy & practices score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company's implementation of responsible gambling standards, policies, and player protection measures. Applicable to Casinos & Gaming industry only.
indicators.parent: Product responsibility & integrity
indicators.nameCn: 负责任博彩政策与实践得分
indicators.definitionCn: 评估企业实施负责任博彩标准、政策与玩家保护措施的情况。仅适用于赌场与博彩行业。
indicators.parentCn: 产品责任与诚信

indicators.name: Antibiotics use policy score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company's policy framework and certifications related to antibiotic use in meat production and aquaculture. Applicable to Restaurants industry only.
indicators.parent: Product responsibility & integrity
indicators.nameCn: 抗生素使用政策得分
indicators.definitionCn: 评估企业肉类生产与水产养殖中抗生素使用的政策框架和认证。仅适用于餐饮行业。
indicators.parentCn: 产品责任与诚信

indicators.name: Antibiotics phaseout targets
indicators.definition: Assesses the presence and robustness of issuer plans to phase out non-therapeutic or high-risk antibiotic use in meat production and aquaculture . Applicable to Restaurants industry only.
indicators.parent: Product responsibility & integrity
indicators.nameCn: 逐步停用抗生素目标
indicators.definitionCn: 评估发行人在肉类生产与水产养殖中逐步停用非治疗性或高风险抗生素的计划是否存在及其稳健程度。仅适用于餐饮行业。
indicators.parentCn: 产品责任与诚信

indicators.name: Regulatory warning performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 相对同业组的监管警告绩效
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance based on number or regulatory warnings (warning letters and U.S. FDA form 483s (“Form 483”)) and their intensities (normalized by sales) issued by regulatory authorities, relative to peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司相对同业组的绩效，依据监管机构发出的监管警告数量（警告信和美国 FDA 483 表格（“Form 483”））及其强度（按销售额标准化）。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示绩效强劲。

indicators.name: Industry relative warning letters performance score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on three-year average of total number of Warning Letters received (both absolute and sales normalized), relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.parent: Regulatory warning performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 警告信行业相对绩效得分
indicators.definitionCn: 相对于同业，评估企业收到警告信总数三年平均值的表现，同时考虑绝对数量及以销售额为分母的数量。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
indicators.parentCn: 相对同业组的监管警告绩效

indicators.name: Three-year average warning letters received (absolute)
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average number of warning letters received.
indicators.parent: Regulatory warning performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均收到警告信数量（绝对值）
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量企业收到警告信数量的三年平均值。
indicators.parentCn: 相对同业组的监管警告绩效

indicators.name: Three-year average warning letters received (sales normalized)
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three year average number of warning letters received, normalized by sales.
indicators.parent: Regulatory warning performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均收到警告信数量（按销售额）
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量企业以销售额为分母的收到警告信数量的三年平均值。
indicators.parentCn: 相对同业组的监管警告绩效

indicators.name: Industry relative Form 483 performance score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on three-year average of total number of Form 483s received (both absolute and sales normalized), relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.parent: Regulatory warning performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: Form 483 行业相对绩效得分
indicators.definitionCn: 相对于同业，评估企业收到 Form 483 总数三年平均值的表现，同时考虑绝对数量及以销售额为分母的数量。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
indicators.parentCn: 相对同业组的监管警告绩效

indicators.name: Three-year average Form 483 received (absolute)
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average of absolute number of Form 483s received.
indicators.parent: Regulatory warning performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均收到 Form 483 数量（绝对值）
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量企业收到 Form 483 绝对数量的三年平均值。
indicators.parentCn: 相对同业组的监管警告绩效

indicators.name: Three-year average Form 483 received (sales normalized)
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three year average number of Form 483 received, normalized by sales.
indicators.parent: Regulatory warning performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均收到 Form 483 数量（按销售额）
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量企业以销售额为分母的收到 Form 483 数量的三年平均值。
indicators.parentCn: 相对同业组的监管警告绩效

indicators.name: Warranty performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 相对同业组的保修绩效
indicators.definition: Assesses the company's performance on warranty payments (normalized by sales) and its trend, relative to industry peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司相对于行业同业的质保支付表现（按销售额归一化）及其趋势。原文接着写“以 0–10 分表示，10 分表示”，但句子未完；未补写其含义。
indicators.sourceNote: 原文句子在“where 10 indicates”处中断；未推断或补写 10 分的含义。

indicators.name: Warranty payments industry relative score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s warranty payments intensity (per unit of sales or), relative to industry peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.parent: Warranty performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 保修付款行业相对得分
indicators.definitionCn: 相对于行业同业，评估企业保修付款强度。原文分母写为“每单位销售额或”，语句残缺；以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
indicators.parentCn: 相对同业组的保修绩效
indicators.sourceNote: 原文括号中“per unit of sales or”未完成，未补写另一项分母。

indicators.name: Three-year average warranty payments (per million revenue)
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average warranty payments normalized by revenue.
indicators.parent: Warranty performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均保修付款（每百万收入）
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量企业以收入为分母的保修付款的三年平均值。
indicators.parentCn: 相对同业组的保修绩效

indicators.name: Warranty Payments Industry Relative Trend score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on the three-year average of year-over-year warranty payments intensity trend (per unit of sales), relative to industry peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.parent: Warranty performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 保修付款行业相对趋势得分
indicators.definitionCn: 相对于行业同业，评估企业保修付款强度（每单位销售额）同比变化趋势的三年平均表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
indicators.parentCn: 相对同业组的保修绩效

indicators.name: Three-year average year-over-year warranty payments trend (per million revenue)
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average of year-over-year change in warranty payments normalized by revenue.
indicators.parent: Warranty performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均保修付款同比趋势（每百万收入）
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量企业以收入为分母的保修付款同比变化的三年平均值。
indicators.parentCn: 相对同业组的保修绩效

indicators.name: Product recall performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 相对同业组的产品召回绩效
indicators.definition: Assesses the company's performance with respect to product recalls, relative to industry peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司相对行业同业组的产品召回绩效。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示绩效强劲。

indicators.name: Industry relative recalls performance score (absolute)
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on the total number of recalls, disaggregated by severity (severe, moderate, and minor), relative to industry peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.parent: Product recall performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 召回行业相对绩效得分（绝对值）
indicators.definitionCn: 相对于行业同业，评估按严重、中度和轻微程度区分的召回总数表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
indicators.parentCn: 相对同业组的产品召回绩效

indicators.name: Three-year average absolute total severe recalls
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均绝对严重召回总数
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average of absolute total number of recalls that are severe in nature.
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量公司三年内性质为严重的召回绝对总数的平均值。
indicators.parent: Industry relative recalls performance score (absolute)
indicators.parentCn: 召回行业相对绩效得分（绝对值）

indicators.name: Three-year average absolute total moderate recalls
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均绝对中等召回总数
