indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average of absolute total number of recalls that are moderate in nature.
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量公司三年内性质为中等的召回绝对总数的平均值。
indicators.parent: Industry relative recalls performance score (absolute)
indicators.parentCn: 召回行业相对绩效得分（绝对值）

indicators.name: Three-year average absolute total minor recalls
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均绝对轻微召回总数
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average of absolute total number of recalls that are minor in nature.
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量公司三年内性质为轻微的召回绝对总数的平均值。
indicators.parent: Industry relative recalls performance score (absolute)
indicators.parentCn: 召回行业相对绩效得分（绝对值）

indicators.name: Industry relative recalls performance score (sales based)
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on recall intensity normalized by sales, disaggregated by severity (severe, moderate, and minor), relative to industry peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.parent: Product recall performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 召回行业相对绩效得分（按销售额）
indicators.definitionCn: 相对于行业同业，评估以销售额为分母、并按严重、中度和轻微程度区分的召回强度表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
indicators.parentCn: 相对同业组的产品召回绩效

indicators.name: Three-year average total severe recalls (sales based)
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均严重召回总数（基于销售额）
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average of total number of recalls that are moderate in nature normalized by sales.
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量公司三年内按销售额标准化的性质为中等的召回总数的平均值。
indicators.parent: Industry relative recalls performance score (sales based)
indicators.parentCn: 召回行业相对绩效得分（按销售额）

indicators.name: Three-year average total moderate recalls (sales based)
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均中等召回总数（基于销售额）
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average of total number of recalls that are moderate in nature normalized by sales.
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量公司三年内按销售额标准化的性质为中等的召回总数的平均值。
indicators.parent: Industry relative recalls performance score (sales based)
indicators.parentCn: 召回行业相对绩效得分（按销售额）

indicators.name: Three-year average total minor recalls (sales based)
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均轻微召回总数（基于销售额）
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average of total number of recalls that are minor in nature normalized by sales.
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量公司三年内按销售额标准化的性质为轻微的召回总数的平均值。
indicators.parent: Industry relative recalls performance score (sales based)
indicators.parentCn: 召回行业相对绩效得分（按销售额）

indicators.name: Automobile recalls performance score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s overall performance on recall intensity and trend metrics (vehicles recalled per vehicle manufactured or sold) relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance. Applicable to automobiles industry only.
indicators.parent: Product recall performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 汽车召回绩效得分
indicators.definitionCn: 相对于同业，评估企业召回强度及其趋势指标（每辆生产或销售汽车对应的召回车辆数量）的综合表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示最高绩效水平。仅适用于汽车行业。
indicators.parentCn: 相对同业组的产品召回绩效

indicators.name: Recalls per vehicle sales industry relative score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on vehicle-recall intensity metrics (vehicles recalled per vehicle sold), relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
indicators.parent: Product recall performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 每辆销售汽车召回数量行业相对得分
indicators.definitionCn: 相对于同业，评估企业车辆召回强度指标，即每辆销售汽车对应的召回车辆数量。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示最高绩效水平。
indicators.parentCn: 相对同业组的产品召回绩效

indicators.name: Three-year average of recalls (normalized by number of vehicles sold)
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均召回数（按已售汽车数量标准化）
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average of total number of recalls, normalized by number of vehicles sold.
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量公司三年内按已售汽车数量标准化的召回总数的平均值。
indicators.parent: Recalls per vehicle sales industry relative score
indicators.parentCn: 每辆销售汽车召回数量行业相对得分

indicators.name: Recalls per vehicle sales industry relative trend score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on the three-year average year-over-year trend in vehicle-recall intensity (vehicles recalled per vehicle sold), relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
indicators.parent: Product recall performance relative to peers
indicators.nameCn: 每辆销售汽车召回数量行业相对趋势得分
indicators.definitionCn: 相对于同业，评估企业车辆召回强度（每辆销售汽车对应的召回车辆数量）同比变化趋势的三年平均表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示最高绩效水平。
indicators.parentCn: 相对同业组的产品召回绩效

indicators.name: Three-year average of year-over-year trend in recalls (normalized by number of vehicles sold)
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均召回数同比趋势（按已售汽车数量标准化）
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average of year-over-trend in total number of recalls, normalized by number of vehicles sold.
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量公司三年内按已售汽车数量标准化的召回总数同比趋势的平均值。
indicators.parent: Recalls per vehicle sales industry relative trend score
indicators.parentCn: 每辆销售汽车召回数量行业相对趋势得分

indicators.name: Industry-specific Product Safety and Quality Performance score
indicators.nameCn: 行业专属产品安全与质量绩效得分
indicators.definition: Assesses the company's performance on industry-specific metrics related to product safety and quality. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司在与产品安全与质量相关的行业专属指标上的绩效。以 0-10 分表示，10 表示最高绩效水平。

indicators.name: Airworthiness directives performance score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on compliance with airworthiness directives issued by aviation regulators over a three-year period relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance. Applicable to Aerospace & Defense companies with revenues in Aircrafts segments only.
indicators.parent: Industry-specific Product Safety and Quality Performance score
indicators.nameCn: 适航指令绩效得分
indicators.definitionCn: 相对于同业，评估企业三年期间遵守航空监管机构适航指令的表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示最高绩效水平。仅适用于航空航天与国防行业中具有飞机业务收入的企业。
indicators.parentCn: 行业专属产品安全与质量绩效得分

indicators.name: Industry Relative airworthiness directives intensity score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on airworthiness-directive intensity metrics (number of airworthiness directives per sales) relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
indicators.parent: Industry-specific Product Safety and Quality Performance score
indicators.nameCn: 适航指令强度行业相对得分
indicators.definitionCn: 相对于同业，评估企业适航指令强度指标，即每单位销售额对应的适航指令数量。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
indicators.parentCn: 行业专属产品安全与质量绩效得分

indicators.name: Three-year average airworthiness directives intensity
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均适航指令强度
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average number of airworthiness directives normalized by sales.
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量公司三年内按销售额标准化的适航指令数量的平均值。
indicators.parent: Industry Relative airworthiness directives intensity score
indicators.parentCn: 适航指令强度行业相对得分

indicators.name: Air incidents performance score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on aviation incidents leading to fatalities and damage caused to the aircraft due to aviation incidents. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance. Applicable to Passenger airlines industry only.
indicators.parent: Industry-specific Product Safety and Quality Performance score
indicators.nameCn: 航空事故绩效得分
indicators.definitionCn: 评估企业航空事故造成的死亡和飞机损坏表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示最高绩效水平。仅适用于客运航空行业。
indicators.parentCn: 行业专属产品安全与质量绩效得分

indicators.name: Aviation Incidents Fatality score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on number of fatalities due to air incidents. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
indicators.parent: Industry-specific Product Safety and Quality Performance score
indicators.nameCn: 航空事故死亡得分
indicators.definitionCn: 评估企业航空事故造成死亡人数的表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示最高绩效水平。
indicators.parentCn: 行业专属产品安全与质量绩效得分

indicators.name: Three-year average number of fatalities
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均死亡人数
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three year average number of fatalities caused due to aviation incidents.
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量公司三年内因航空事故造成的死亡人数的平均值。
indicators.parent: Aviation Incidents Fatality score
indicators.parentCn: 航空事故死亡得分

indicators.name: Industry Relative Aircraft Damage intensity score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on damage caused to the aircraft intensity (normalized by sales), relative to peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
indicators.parent: Industry-specific Product Safety and Quality Performance score
indicators.nameCn: 飞机损坏强度行业相对得分
indicators.definitionCn: 相对于同业，评估以销售额为分母的飞机损坏强度表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示最高绩效水平。
indicators.parentCn: 行业专属产品安全与质量绩效得分

indicators.name: Three-year average aircraft damage intensity
indicators.nameCn: 三年平均飞机损伤强度
indicators.definition: Measures the company’s three-year average of aircrafts damaged intensity (normalized by sales) due to aviation incidents.
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量公司三年内因航空事故造成的飞机损伤强度（按销售额标准化）的平均值。
indicators.parent: Industry Relative Aircraft Damage intensity score
indicators.parentCn: 飞机损坏强度行业相对得分

indicators.name: Managed healthcare performance score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on healthcare plan quality and safety metrics based on CMS Star Ratings or IDSS scores. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance. Applicable to managed healthcare industry only.
indicators.parent: Industry-specific Product Safety and Quality Performance score
indicators.nameCn: 管理式医疗绩效得分
indicators.definitionCn: 根据 CMS 星级评级或 IDSS 得分，评估企业医疗计划质量与安全指标的表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示最高绩效水平。仅适用于管理式医疗行业。
indicators.parentCn: 行业专属产品安全与质量绩效得分

indicators.name: Water quality standards score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on compliance with drinking-water-quality standards and regulations. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance. Applicable to water utilities industry only.
indicators.parent: Industry-specific Product Safety and Quality Performance score
indicators.nameCn: 水质标准得分
indicators.definitionCn: 评估企业遵守饮用水质量标准和法规的表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。仅适用于水务公用事业行业。
indicators.parentCn: 行业专属产品安全与质量绩效得分

indicators.name: Labelling or marketing incidents performance score
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s performance on compliance with industry or regulatory labeling and marketing codes. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance. Applicable to Beverages industry only.
indicators.parent: Industry-specific Product Safety and Quality Performance score
indicators.nameCn: 标签或营销事件绩效得分
indicators.definitionCn: 评估企业遵守行业或监管标签与营销准则的表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。仅适用于饮料行业。
indicators.parentCn: 行业专属产品安全与质量绩效得分

scoringNote: 风险型议题将风险敞口与风险管理得分通过总方法论的映射组合，不是两者直接相乘。管理评估可包含实践、绩效、目标及争议扣分；具体组件和行业适用性见本议题 PDF。

name: 负责任投资
summary: 评估企业在管理自有资产或代客管理资产时对 ESG 因素的整合程度。
intro: Responsible Investment is a Key Issue in the Social Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on their integration of environmental, social and governance considerations in the management of their own assets or the assets they manage on behalf of others.
risks: Lower security values due to unmitigated or overlooked ESG risks.
Client attrition due to mismanagement of investment risk.
Higher returns from ESG investments.
risksCn: 因未缓解或被忽视的 ESG 风险导致的证券价值下降。
因投资风险管理不当导致的客户流失。
ESG 投资带来的更高回报。

indicators.name: Dedicated ESG analysts responsible for analyzing ESG issues in investment process
indicators.nameCn: 负责在投资流程中分析 ESG 议题的专职 ESG 分析师
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has a dedicated individual or team responsible for analyzing ESG issues in the investment process or if the company provides training on ESG issues to investment analysts.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否有专门的个人或团队负责在投资流程中分析 ESG 议题，或公司是否为投资分析师提供 ESG 议题培训。

indicators.name: Responsible investment policy to incorporate ESG considerations
indicators.nameCn: 纳入 ESG 考量的负责任投资政策
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has policies and procedures to incorporate ESG considerations in the investment process.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否有将 ESG 考量纳入投资流程的政策和程序。

indicators.name: Highest level of ESG factors incorporation in investment process across asset classes
indicators.nameCn: 各资产类别投资流程中纳入 ESG 因素的最高程度
indicators.definition: Assesses the highest level of ESG factors incorporation observed across the investment process for six asset classes: listed equity, corporate fixed income, non-corporate fixed income, private equity, real estate, and hedge funds/alternative investments. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates highest level of incorporation.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估在六类资产类别（上市股票、公司固定收益、非公司固定收益、私募股权、房地产以及对冲基金/另类投资）的投资流程中所观察到的纳入 ESG 因素的最高程度。以 0–10 分表示，10 分表示纳入程度最高。

indicators.name: Dedicated staff responsible for ESG engagement
indicators.nameCn: 负责 ESG 参与事务的专职人员
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has a dedicated individual or team responsible for monitoring and implementing its ESG engagement or proxy voting policies.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否有专门的个人或团队负责监督和执行其 ESG 参与或代理投票政策。

indicators.name: Detailed engagement policy that addresses environmental, social and governance issues
indicators.nameCn: 涉及环境、社会和治理议题的详细参与政策
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has an engagement or proxy voting policy that addresses environmental, social and governance issues.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否有涉及环境、社会和治理议题的参与或代理投票政策。

scoringNote: 风险型议题将风险敞口与风险管理得分通过总方法论的映射组合，不是两者直接相乘。管理评估可包含实践、绩效、目标及争议扣分；具体组件和行业适用性见本议题 PDF。

name: 金融服务可及性
summary: 评估企业面向服务不足市场提供金融服务、把握相关市场需求的定位。
intro: Access to Finance is a Key Issue in the Social Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on their positioning to meet market demand for financial services in underserved markets.

indicators.name: Innovation in mobile/online distribution channels for financial services
indicators.nameCn: 金融服务移动/线上分销渠道的创新
indicators.definition: The company's innovation in mobile/online distribution channels. Best practice is sector-leading innovation in mobile/online distribution targeting underserved demographics. Applies to financial institutions only.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司在移动/线上分销渠道方面的创新。最佳实践是针对服务不足人群的移动/线上分销领域的行业领先创新。仅适用于金融机构。

indicators.name: Innovation in other alternative branchless distribution channels for financial services
indicators.nameCn: 金融服务其他替代性无网点分销渠道的创新
indicators.definition: The company’s innovation in alternative branchless distribution channels (e.g., correspondents, partnerships with retail stores/post offices). Applies to financial institutions only.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司在替代性无网点分销渠道（如代理机构、与零售商店/邮局的合作）方面的创新。仅适用于金融机构。

indicators.name: Financial literacy initiatives for unbanked, underbanked, or underserved groups
indicators.nameCn: 面向无银行账户、银行服务不足或未得到充分服务群体的金融素养举措
indicators.definition: Assesses the company's initiatives aimed at improving financial literacy for unbanked, underbanked, or underserved customers and communities.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司旨在提升无银行账户、银行服务不足或未得到充分服务的客户及社区的金融素养的举措。

indicators.name: Financial solutions targeting unbanked, underbanked, or underserved customers
indicators.nameCn: 面向无银行账户、银行服务不足或未得到充分服务客户的金融解决方案
indicators.definition: Assesses the company's lending solutions designed to serve underserved individuals and small-and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs).
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司旨在服务未得到充分服务的个人及中小企业（SMEs）的贷款解决方案。

indicators.name: Extent of involvement in microfinance/microinsurance
indicators.nameCn: 参与小额信贷/小额保险的程度
indicators.definition: The type of involvement in microfinance or microinsurance. Best practice is for the company to directly provide microfinance or microinsurance products to customers. Involvement may also come in the form of institutional partnerships, investment vehicles, or charitable giving.
indicators.definitionCn: 参与小额信贷或小额保险的类型。最佳实践是公司直接向客户提供小额信贷或小额保险产品。参与形式也可以是通过机构合作、投资工具或慈善捐赠。

indicators.name: Assessment of lending to small and medium-size enterprises
indicators.nameCn: 中小企业贷款评估
indicators.definition: Assesses the company's lending to small and medium-size enterprises as a percentage of total lending, relative to industry peers.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司对中小企业的贷款占总贷款的比例，并与行业同业进行对比。

indicators.name: Assessment of growth in lending to small and medium-size enterprises
indicators.nameCn: 中小企业贷款增长评估
indicators.definition: Assesses the year-over-year growth in lending to small and medium-size enterprises, relative to industry peers.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估中小企业贷款的同比增速，并与行业同业进行对比。

scoringNote: 机遇型议题根据机遇敞口与把握机遇的管理能力进行非线性映射。下表是源 PDF 列出的管理指标与子指标；仅凭这些指标不能复算完整官方得分。

name: 医疗健康可及性
summary: 评估企业面向发展中国家与服务不足市场提供医疗健康产品与服务、把握市场需求的定位。
intro: Access to Health Care is a Key Issue in the Social Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on their positioning to meet market demand for health care products and services in developing countries and underserved markets.

indicators.name: Number of relevant diseases addressed by the company’s commercialized products
indicators.nameCn: 公司已商业化产品所涵盖的相关疾病数量
indicators.definition: The number of diseases within the scope of this key issue for which the company has commercialized products on the market.
indicators.definitionCn: 在本关键议题范围内、公司已有产品上市销售的疾病数量。

indicators.name: Number of relevant diseases addressed by the company’s research and development
indicators.nameCn: 公司研发所涵盖的相关疾病数量
indicators.definition: The number of diseases within the scope of this key issue for which the company has ongoing research and development.
indicators.definitionCn: 在本关键议题范围内、公司正在开展研发的疾病数量。

indicators.name: Scope of expansion plans to low-income and middle-income countries
indicators.nameCn: 向低收入和中等收入国家扩张计划的覆盖范围
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company explicitly states it plans to expand operations and markets to low-income and middle-income countries as defined by the World Bank. Applies to pharmaceutical, biotech and medical devices operations and markets.
indicators.definitionCn: 说明公司是否明确表示计划将业务和市场扩展至世界银行定义的低收入和中等收入国家。适用于制药、生物技术和医疗器械的业务和市场。

indicators.name: Assistance to local manufacturers to achieve international drug manufacturing quality standards in low- and middle-income countries
indicators.nameCn: 协助本地制造商达到国际药品生产质量
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company undertakes initiatives to improve the capacity of local manufacturers in low-and middle-income countries (as defined by the World Bank) to manufacture products to international quality standards such as the World Health Organization’s Good Manufacturing Practices. These initiatives aim to address local needs, in partnership with local stakeholders, and may have long-term sustainability aims.
indicators.definitionCn: 说明公司是否开展举措，以提升低收入和中等收入国家（世界银行定义）本地制造商按国际质量标准（如世界卫生组织的《药品生产质量管理规范》）生产产品的能力。这些举措旨在与本地利益相关方合作满足本地需求，并可能具有长期可持续发展目标。

indicators.name: Supports pharmacovigilance in low- and middle-income countries
indicators.nameCn: 支持低收入和中等收入国家的药物警戒
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company supports initiatives to build capacity to improve pharmacovigilance capability (i.e., monitoring the effects of drugs and vaccines after sale to detect and assess adverse effects or any other medicine-or vaccine-related problem) in low-and middle-income countries as defined by the World Bank. These initiatives are typically carried out with local relevant partners and aligned with local needs, and their goals and outcomes are generally measured.
indicators.definitionCn: 说明公司是否支持在低收入和中等收入国家（世界银行定义）开展能力建设举措，以提升药物警戒能力（即监测药品和疫苗售后的效果，以发现和评估不良反应或任何其他与药品或疫苗相关的问题）。这些举措通常与本地相关合作方共同开展，并与本地需求保持一致，其目标和成果通常会被衡量。

indicators.name: Trains local healthcare workers in low- and middle-income countries
indicators.nameCn: 培训低收入和中等收入国家的本地医护工作者
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company undertakes initiatives to train health care workers in low-and middle-income countries (as defined by the World Bank) to strengthen the existing health system and build local capacity. These initiatives aim to address local needs in partnership with local stakeholders and may have long-term sustainability aims.
indicators.definitionCn: 说明公司是否开展举措，培训低收入和中等收入国家（世界银行定义）的医护工作者，以加强现有卫生系统并建设本地能力。这些举措旨在与本地利益相关方合作满足本地需求，并可能具有长期可持续发展目标。

indicators.name: Improves availability of products to patients through pharmaceutical supply chain initiatives in low- and middle-income countries
indicators.nameCn: 通过药品供应链举措改善患者获得产品的可及性
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company undertakes initiatives to improve the pharmaceutical supply chain, beyond its own supply chain, in low-and middle-income countries as defined by the World Bank. These initiatives aim to address local needs in partnership with local stakeholders and may have long-term sustainability aims. Examples include initiatives to improve the last-mile supply of essential medicines.
indicators.definitionCn: 说明公司是否在低收入和中等收入国家（世界银行定义）开展举措，以改善其自身供应链之外的药品供应链。这些举措旨在与本地利益相关方合作满足本地需求，并可能具有长期可持续发展目标。示例包括改善基本药物最后一公里供应的举措。

indicators.name: Involvement in public-private partnerships for improving local research and development capacity in low- and middle-income countries
indicators.nameCn: 参与旨在改善本地研发的公私合作
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company undertakes public-private partnerships to strengthen local research and development capability in low-and middle-income countries as defined by the World Bank. These initiatives aim to address local needs and skill requirements in collaboration with relevant stakeholders, and may have long-term sustainability aims.
indicators.definitionCn: 说明公司是否开展公私合作，以增强低收入和中等收入国家（世界银行定义）的本地研发能力。这些举措旨在与相关利益相关方合作满足本地需求和技术要求，并可能具有长期可持续发展目标。

indicators.name: Capacity building of public health infrastructure, information, or health programs in low- and middle-income countries
indicators.nameCn: 低收入和中等收入国家公共卫生基础设施、信息或卫生项目的能力建设
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company undertakes initiatives to improve public health systems in terms of infrastructure, information, or health programs in low-and middle-income countries as defined by the World Bank. These initiatives aim to address local needs and skill requirements in collaboration with relevant stakeholders and may have long-term sustainability aims.
indicators.definitionCn: 说明公司是否开展举措，从基础设施、信息或卫生项目方面改善低收入和中等收入国家（世界银行定义）的公共卫生系统。这些举措旨在与相关利益相关方合作满足本地需求和技术要求，并可能具有长期可持续发展目标。

indicators.name: Number of non-exclusive voluntary licenses issued or received
indicators.nameCn: 已发出或已获得的非独占自愿许可数量
indicators.definition: The number of non-exclusive voluntary licenses (NEVLs) that a patent holder has issued or that a generic manufacturer has received to allow the manufacture and supply of generic versions of patented medicines by other manufacturers.
indicators.definitionCn: 专利权人已发出、或仿制药制造商已获得的非独占自愿许可（NEVL）数量，此类许可允许其他制造商生产和供应专利药品的仿制版本。

indicators.name: Extent of pricing policies based on affordability
indicators.nameCn: 基于可负担性的定价政策的程度
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company implements tiered pricing (i.e., tailoring the price according to local ability to pay) for its products between countries, within countries or on both levels. Applies to patented drugs, generics, vaccines and medical devices.
indicators.definitionCn: 说明公司是否对其产品在国家之间、国家内部或两个层面实施分级定价（即根据当地支付能力调整价格）。适用于专利药品、仿制药、疫苗和医疗器械。

indicators.name: Signed licensing agreements or entered into manufacturing contracts with the Medicines Patent Pool (MPP)
indicators.nameCn: 与药品专利池签署许可协议或订立生产合同
indicators.definition: The extent of the company’s licensing agreements or manufacturing contracts with the Medicines Patent Pool (MPP).
indicators.definitionCn: 公司与药品专利池（Medicines Patent Pool，MPP）之间许可协议或生产合同的程度。

indicators.name: Pricing transparency in developed and developing markets
indicators.nameCn: 发达市场和发展中市场的定价透明度
indicators.definition: Describes the level of detail provided by a company regarding its product pricing. Applies to healthcare companies only.
indicators.definitionCn: 描述公司就其产品定价所提供信息的详细程度。仅适用于医疗健康公司。

indicators.name: Is the company conducting R&D to address antibiotic resistance (e.g., in-house R&D, partnerships)?
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company engages in antibiotic stewardship initiatives, such as collaboration on research and development of solutions for antibiotic resistance, or partnerships with industry peers, academia, or other entities to address antibiotic resistance.
indicators.nameCn: 是否开展解决抗生素耐药性的研发（例如内部研发或合作）
indicators.definitionCn: 说明企业是否参与抗生素管理举措，例如合作研发解决抗生素耐药性的方案，或与行业同业、学术机构及其他主体合作解决抗生素耐药性。

scoringNote: 机遇型议题根据机遇敞口与把握机遇的管理能力进行非线性映射。下表是源 PDF 列出的管理指标与子指标；仅凭这些指标不能复算完整官方得分。

name: 营养与健康机遇
summary: 评估企业把握具有更优营养或健康特征产品市场需求的定位。
intro: Opportunities in Nutrition & Health is a Key Issue in the Social Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on their positioning to meet market demand for products with improved nutritional or health profiles.

indicators.name: In-house innovation capacity to develop healthier products
indicators.nameCn: 开发更健康产品的内部创新能力
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has resources dedicated to developing healthier and more natural products. Leading practice is to have dedicated research centers and staff to develop healthier products.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否有专门用于开发更健康和更天然产品的资源。领先实践是设立专门的研究中心和人员来开发更健康的产品。

indicators.name: Strategy to develop natural and healthy products
indicators.nameCn: 开发天然和健康产品的战略
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has a strategy to further develop natural and healthy products.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否有进一步开发天然和健康产品的战略。

indicators.name: Food & beverage nutrition enhancement programs score
indicators.nameCn: 食品饮料营养强化方案评分
indicators.definition: Assesses the company’s efforts to improve the nutritional profile of its food and beverage products. Highest performance reflects comprehensive programs to reduce artificial ingredients, fat, sodium, sugar, and portion size, enhance products through fortification and use natural ingredients. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
indicators.definitionCn: 评估公司改善其食品饮料产品营养成分的努力。最高绩效体现为减少人工成分、脂肪、钠、糖和份量的综合方案，通过营养强化和使用天然成分提升产品。以 0–10 分表示，10 分表示绩效最高水平。

indicators.name: Extent of programs to reduce artificial ingredients in food products
indicators.definition: The estimated share of revenues generated from food and beverage products that contain less or no artificial ingredients (e.g., preservatives, colorings, aspartame) or less or no controversial ingredients (e.g., antibiotics).
indicators.parent: Food & beverage nutrition enhancement programs score
indicators.nameCn: 减少食品中人工成分的计划覆盖程度
indicators.definitionCn: 所含人工成分（例如防腐剂、色素、阿斯巴甜）更少或为零，或争议性成分（例如抗生素）更少或为零的食品及饮料产品所产生收入的估计占比。
indicators.parentCn: 食品饮料营养强化方案评分

indicators.name: Extent of programs to reduce portion size
indicators.definition: The estimated share of revenues generated from products reformulated with reduced portions.
indicators.parent: Food & beverage nutrition enhancement programs score
indicators.nameCn: 缩小产品份量的计划覆盖程度
indicators.definitionCn: 经重新配方或设计、缩小份量的产品所产生收入的估计占比。
indicators.parentCn: 食品饮料营养强化方案评分

indicators.name: Extent of programs to reduce sugar in food products
indicators.definition: The estimated share of revenues generated from food and beverage products reformulated with less sugar.
indicators.parent: Food & beverage nutrition enhancement programs score
indicators.nameCn: 减少食品中糖含量的计划覆盖程度
indicators.definitionCn: 经重新配方、含糖量更低的食品及饮料产品所产生收入的估计占比。
indicators.parentCn: 食品饮料营养强化方案评分

indicators.name: Extent of programs to reduce fat in food products
indicators.definition: Indicates the estimated share of revenues generated from food/beverage products reformulated with less fat.
indicators.parent: Food & beverage nutrition enhancement programs score
indicators.nameCn: 减少食品中脂肪含量的计划覆盖程度
indicators.definitionCn: 经重新配方、脂肪含量更低的食品及饮料产品所产生收入的估计占比。
indicators.parentCn: 食品饮料营养强化方案评分

indicators.name: Extent of programs to reduce sodium in food products
indicators.definition: Indicates the estimated share of revenues generated from food/beverage products reformulated with less salt.
indicators.parent: Food & beverage nutrition enhancement programs score
indicators.nameCn: 减少食品中钠含量的计划覆盖程度
indicators.definitionCn: 经重新配方、含盐量更低的食品及饮料产品所产生收入的估计占比。
indicators.parentCn: 食品饮料营养强化方案评分

indicators.name: Extent of programs to enhance or fortify products to address nutrient deficiencies
indicators.definition: Indicates the estimated share of revenues generated from food/beverage products fortified to reduce nutrient deficiencies (e.g. vitamin A, zinc, iodine, iron).
indicators.parent: Food & beverage nutrition enhancement programs score
indicators.nameCn: 针对营养素缺乏改善或强化产品的计划覆盖程度
indicators.definitionCn: 为减少营养素缺乏而强化营养（例如维生素 A、锌、碘、铁）的食品及饮料产品所产生收入的估计占比。
indicators.parentCn: 食品饮料营养强化方案评分

indicators.name: Extent of initiatives to use more natural ingredients
indicators.definition: The estimated share of revenues generated from food and beverage products that are certified to organic standards.
indicators.parent: Food & beverage nutrition enhancement programs score
indicators.nameCn: 使用更多天然成分的举措覆盖程度
indicators.definitionCn: 获得有机标准认证的食品及饮料产品所产生收入的估计占比。
indicators.parentCn: 食品饮料营养强化方案评分

scoringNote: 机遇型议题根据机遇敞口与把握机遇的管理能力进行非线性映射。下表是源 PDF 列出的管理指标与子指标；仅凭这些指标不能复算完整官方得分。

name: 社区关系
summary: 评估企业对当地社区关系的管理，以及人权相关政策与实践。
intro: Community Relations is a Key Issue in the Social Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on their management of local community relations and policies on human rights.
risks: Operational disruptions or loss of market access due to community opposition.
Loss of formal and social license to operate.
Litigation by landowners and other affected parties.
risksCn: 因社区反对导致运营中断或市场准入丧失。
丧失正式运营许可和社会运营许可。
土地所有者及其他受影响方提起诉讼。

indicators.name: Commitment to refrain from operating in protected areas
indicators.nameCn: 承诺不在保护区内运营
indicators.definition: Indicates whether a company has made a commitment to avoid operating in high-conservation areas, such as World Heritage sites or areas of cultural significance.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否已承诺避免在高保护价值区域（如世界遗产地或具有文化意义的区域）运营。

indicators.name: Conducts community impact assessment prior to settling in new areas
indicators.nameCn: 在新区域落户前开展社区影响评估
indicators.definition: Indicates whether a company conducts community impact assessments in line with the principles of Free, Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC) or whether there is any evidence of community engagement prior to developing in new areas.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否按照自由、事先和知情同意（FPIC）原则开展社区影响评估，或在开发新区域之前是否有任何社区参与的迹象。

indicators.name: Indigenous people policy
indicators.nameCn: 原住民政策
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has a policy to minimize community impacts on indigenous people and their traditional way of life.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否有政策以尽量减少对原住民及其传统生活方式的社区影响。

indicators.name: Local community engagement approach
indicators.nameCn: 当地社区参与方式
indicators.definition: Indicates whether a company’s approach to local community engagement includes proactive programs, such as grievance reporting mechanisms and formal community engagement channels.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司当地社区参与的方式是否包含主动举措，如申诉报告机制和正式的社区参与渠道。

indicators.name: Monitors the effectiveness of its human rights policy
indicators.nameCn: 监测其人权政策的有效性
indicators.definition: The extent of monitoring to measure the effectiveness of human rights policies, and whether the company commits to targets or reports progress against human rights targets.
indicators.definitionCn: 衡量人权政策有效性的监测程度，以及公司是否承诺目标或报告人权目标的进展。

indicators.name: Employee training on human rights protection
indicators.nameCn: 人权保护员工培训
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has employee training programs on human rights.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否有关于人权的员工培训方案。

indicators.name: Ethical conduct policy covers contract security providers
indicators.nameCn: 道德行为政策涵盖合同安保服务提供商
indicators.definition: Indicates whether a company has a formal business ethics policy that applies to contract security providers and whether that policy is supported by auditing to ensure compliance.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否有适用于合同安保服务提供商的正式商业道德政策，以及该政策是否有审计支持以确保合规。

indicators.name: Human rights policy
indicators.nameCn: 人权政策
indicators.definition: Indicates whether a company has adopted a formal human rights policy and whether that policy is aligned with the United Nations Declaration of Human Rights.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否采用了正式的人权政策，以及该政策是否与《联合国人权宣言》一致。

indicators.name: Violence and conflict policy
indicators.nameCn: 暴力与冲突政策
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has a formal policy or informal commitment related to violence and conflict.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否有与暴力和冲突相关的正式政策或非正式承诺。

indicators.name: Local procurement policy
indicators.nameCn: 本地采购政策
indicators.definition: Indicates whether a company has a policy to support local suppliers or prioritize purchases that support local communities.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否有政策支持本地供应商，或优先进行支持当地社区的采购。

indicators.name: Programs to support local communities
indicators.nameCn: 支持当地社区的方案
indicators.definition: A company’s investments in community projects (including local infrastructure, hospitals and education) and philanthropic programs to support local communities.
indicators.definitionCn: 公司在社区项目（包括当地基础设施、医院和教育）以及支持当地社区的公益方案方面的投资。

scoringNote: 风险型议题将风险敞口与风险管理得分通过总方法论的映射组合，不是两者直接相乘。管理评估可包含实践、绩效、目标及争议扣分；具体组件和行业适用性见本议题 PDF。

name: 争议性采购
summary: 评估企业对冲突地区原材料的依赖程度与采购规模，以及可追溯性和认证方面的努力。
intro: Controversial Sourcing is a Key Issue in the Social Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on their dependence on, and purchasing volume of, raw materials procured from conflict areas and their efforts at traceability and certification.
risks: Reputational risk and potential loss of market share as consumer awareness grows.
Costs to comply with new regulations (e.g., Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive (CSDDD), U.S. Dodd-Frank Act).
risksCn: 随着消费者意识提高而产生的声誉风险及市场份额潜在流失。
遵守新法规的成本（例如企业可持续尽职调查指令（CSDDD）、美国《多德-弗兰克法案》）。

indicators.name: Extent of efforts to ensure compliance with controversial materials sourcing policy
indicators.nameCn: 确保遵守争议材料采购政策的努力程度
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company carries out initiatives to ensure compliance with its controversial sourcing policy, or collaborates with stakeholders to promote supply chain transparency and accountability.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否开展举措以确保遵守其争议采购政策，或与利益相关方合作以促进供应链透明度和问责。

indicators.name: Targets for ensuring compliance with controversial materials sourcing policy
indicators.nameCn: 确保遵守争议材料采购政策的目标
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has targets for ensuring compliance with its controversial materials sourcing policy.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否设有确保遵守其争议材料采购政策的目标。

indicators.name: Extent of supplier/material certification as conflict-free by external agencies using the most stringent criteria
indicators.nameCn: 由外部机构使用最严格标准将供应商/材料认证为无冲突的程度
indicators.definition: The extent of relevant products externally certified as conflict-free using the most stringent criteria, which may differ from industry to industry. Example: Responsible Minerals Assurance Process (RMAP) for Consumer Electronics.
indicators.definitionCn: 使用最严格标准（因行业而异）获得外部无冲突认证的相关产品程度。示例：针对消费电子产品的负责任矿产保证流程（RMAP）。

indicators.name: Commitments to address controversial sourcing practices
indicators.nameCn: 应对争议采购实践的承诺
indicators.definition: Indicates whether the company has a policy to address sourcing and use of raw materials that may originate from areas associated with human rights violations, illicit trade and/or financing of violence.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明公司是否制定政策，以应对可能来源于与侵犯人权、非法贸易和/或资助暴力相关地区的原材料的采购与使用。

indicators.name: Extent of material traceability to place of origin
indicators.nameCn: 材料追溯至原产地的程度
indicators.definition: Indicates the estimated share of relevant products with traceable origin of raw materials. Traceable origin refers to the location where the ore was mined, to the best detail possible. At a minimum, the description must include the country, but more details may be provided including the province/state, city, mine site and mine name.
indicators.definitionCn: 表明可追溯原材料原产地的相关产品估计占比。可追溯原产地指矿石开采的地点，尽可能详细。描述至少需包含国家，但可提供更多细节，包括省/州、城市、矿区及矿山名称。

scoringNote: 风险型议题将风险敞口与风险管理得分通过总方法论的映射组合，不是两者直接相乘。管理评估可包含实践、绩效、目标及争议扣分；具体组件和行业适用性见本议题 PDF。

name: 商业道德
summary: 评估企业对欺诈、高管不当行为、腐败行为、洗钱或反垄断违规等商业道德问题的监督与管理。
intro: Business Ethics is a Key Issue in the Governance Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on their oversight and management of business ethics issues such as fraud, executive misconduct, corrupt practices, money laundering, or antitrust violations.

keyMetrics.name: Oversight of Ethics Issues
keyMetrics.fullName: Oversight of Ethics Issues Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Indicates the company's governance body (e.g., board-level committee, C-suite or executive committee, or special task force or risk officer) responsible for oversight of business ethics and corruption issues.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 表明公司负责监督商业道德与腐败议题的治理机构（例如董事会层面的委员会、高管层或执行委员会，或专项工作组或风险官）。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on disclosure of management practice: Board level committee, C-suite or executive committee: 0.0. Special task force, or risk officer, or Corporate Social Responsibility / Sustainability team: -0.7. No evidence: -1.4.
keyMetrics.scoringText: Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on disclosure of management practice: Board level committee, C-suite or executive committee: 0.0. Special task force, or risk officer, or Corporate Social Responsibility / Sustainability team: -0.7. No evidence: -1.4.

keyMetrics.name: Bribery and Anti-corruption Policy
keyMetrics.fullName: Bribery and Anti-corruption Policy Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Indicates if the company has a policy on bribery and anti-corruption in place and the scope of that policy.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 表明公司是否已制定贿赂与反腐败政策以及该政策的范围。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on disclosure of management practice: Detailed formal policy on bribery and anti-corruption: 0.0. General statements of commitment to address bribery and corruption: -0.7. No evidence: -1.4.
keyMetrics.scoringText: Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on disclosure of management practice: Detailed formal policy on bribery and anti-corruption: 0.0. General statements of commitment to address bribery and corruption: -0.7. No evidence: -1.4.

keyMetrics.name: Anti-Corruption Policy for Suppliers
keyMetrics.fullName: Anti-Corruption Policy for Suppliers Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Indicates the scope of the bribery and anti-corruption policy in place for suppliers.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 表明针对供应商实施的贿赂与反腐败政策的范围。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on disclosure of management practice: All suppliers are required to have anti-corruption policies and programs to verify compliance: 0.0. All suppliers are required to have anti-corruption policies: -0.7. Policy covers selected suppliers: -1.0. No evidence: -1.4.
keyMetrics.scoringText: Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on disclosure of management practice: All suppliers are required to have anti-corruption policies and programs to verify compliance: 0.0. All suppliers are required to have anti-corruption policies: -0.7. Policy covers selected suppliers: -1.0. No evidence: -1.4.

keyMetrics.name: Whistleblower Protection
keyMetrics.definition: Indicates whether the company has disclosed a whistleblower policy that provides whistleblowers with protection from retaliation.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 表明公司是否披露了为举报人提供免受报复保护的举报人政策。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on disclosure of management practice: Policy provides whistleblowers with protection from retaliation: 0.0. No evidence: -1.4.
keyMetrics.scoringText: Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on disclosure of management practice: Policy provides whistleblowers with protection from retaliation: 0.0. No evidence: -1.4.

keyMetrics.name: Employee Training on Ethical Standards
keyMetrics.fullName: Employee Training on Ethical Standards Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Indicates the scope of employee training on anti-corruption and business ethics standards.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 表明反腐败和商业道德标准方面的员工培训范围。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on disclosure of management practice: Programs covering all employees (including part-time) and contractors: 0.0. Programs covering all permanent employees (excluding part-time and contractors): -0.7. General statements on employee training on ethical standards: -1.0. No evidence: -1.4.
keyMetrics.scoringText: Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on disclosure of management practice: Programs covering all employees (including part-time) and contractors: 0.0. Programs covering all permanent employees (excluding part-time and contractors): -0.7. General statements on employee training on ethical standards: -1.0. No evidence: -1.4.

keyMetrics.name: Regular Audits of Ethical Standards
keyMetrics.fullName: Regular Audits of Ethical Standards Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Indicates the frequency and scope of audits related to anti-corruption and business ethics.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 表明与反腐败和商业道德相关的审计频率和范围。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on disclosure of management practice: Audits of all operations at least once every three years: 0.0. Audits of selected operations at least once every three years: -0.7. Evidence of audits but no specific details / audits conducted but not on a regular schedule: -0.7. No evidence: -1.4.
keyMetrics.scoringText: Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on disclosure of management practice: Audits of all operations at least once every three years: 0.0. Audits of selected operations at least once every three years: -0.7. Evidence of audits but no specific details / audits conducted but not on a regular schedule: -0.7. No evidence: -1.4.

keyMetrics.name: Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Policy
keyMetrics.definition: Indicates the scope of a company's policy on anti-money laundering and know your customer.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 表明公司反洗钱与了解你的客户政策的范围。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on disclosure of management practice: Policy and implementation strategy articulated: 0.0. Evidence of policy but no disclosure of implementation: -0.7. Not disclosed: -1.4.
keyMetrics.scoringText: Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on disclosure of management practice: Policy and implementation strategy articulated: 0.0. Evidence of policy but no disclosure of implementation: -0.7. Not disclosed: -1.4.

keyMetrics.name: Corruption Risk Exposure & Controversies
keyMetrics.fullName: Corruption Risk Exposure & Controversies Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Indicates the company’s exposure to business activities or geographies facing a higher incidence of corruption and involvement in ongoing corruption-related controversies.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 表明公司对腐败发生率较高的商业活动或地区的敞口，以及是否卷入正在进行的腐败相关争议。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on percentage of operations in medium-and high-risk geographies, high-risk business segments, government ownership (percentage) and controversy type & assessment.
keyMetrics.scoringText: Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on percentage of operations in medium-and high-risk geographies, high-risk business segments, government ownership (percentage) and controversy type & assessment. Range: 0 to -7.0 Refer to the Corruption Risk Exposure Deduction Key, below, for details on corruption risk exposure deduction. Refer to the Corporate Behavior Controversy Deduction Key, below, for details on corruption-related controversy deduction.

keyMetrics.name: Business Ethics Controversies
keyMetrics.definition: Indicates the company’s involvement in anticompetitive and business ethics controversies. Cases related to the two Board Key Issue-related Key Metrics Securities Violations and Executive Misconduct (See the “MSCI ESG Ratings Methodology: Board Key Issue” document for details) will be taken into consideration in the assessment of the Business Ethics Controversies Key Metric.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 表明公司是否卷入反竞争和商业道德争议。与董事会关键议题相关的两项关键指标——证券违规和高管不当行为（详情请参阅《MSCI ESG Ratings Methodology: Board Key Issue》文件）——相关的案件将在商业道德争议关键指标的评估中予以考虑。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on Severity, Status (Ongoing, Partially Concluded, or Concluded), and the company’s Role (Direct vs. Indirect Involvement) in the controversy.
keyMetrics.scoringText: Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on Severity, Status (Ongoing, Partially Concluded, or Concluded), and the company’s Role (Direct vs. Indirect Involvement) in the controversy. Range: 0 to -7.0 Refer to the Corporate Behavior Controversy Deduction Key, below.

scoringNote: 治理先从 10 分起扣除相关关键指标的贡献，并按方法论做缩放、主题与支柱汇总。部分指标影响议题得分，但不经公司治理主题进入最终评级；适用范围及贡献以各指标原文和总方法论为准。

rules.title: 公司行为争议与腐败敞口
body: 腐败风险敞口扣分取决于中高风险地区、高风险业务及政府持股；争议扣分另看严重性、状态和直接／间接角色。两类规则应按第 7–8 页扣分表结合使用。
证券违规和高管不当行为在董事会议题中的得分影响，不经公司治理主题计入最终评级；相关案件会在商业道德争议中评估。
rules.note: 页面保留每项指标完整的英文适用范围与扣分说明。未用某一个“典型扣分”推断所有公司。

name: 税务透明度
summary: 评估企业估计税负缺口、收入申报透明度及税务相关争议的参与情况。
intro: Tax Transparency is a Key Issue in the Governance Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on their estimated corporate tax gap (see below), revenue-reporting transparency and their involvement in tax-related controversies. A company’s estimated tax gap will only affect its 0-10 Corporate Behavior Theme Score and its 0-10 Governance Pillar Score when it is involved in an ongoing tax-related controversy. Because the estimated tax gap is an approximation and does not consider the unique circumstances of a company’s tax structure, ongoing tax controversies are used to improve the level of conviction in an estimated negative tax gap.

keyMetrics.name: Tax Controversies
keyMetrics.definition: Indicates the company’s involvement in ongoing tax-related controversies.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 表明公司是否涉及正在进行的税务相关争议。
keyMetrics.deduction: The scoring contribution is variable, based on the type and assessment of ongoing controversies.
keyMetrics.scoringText: Typical Scoring Contribution: The scoring contribution is variable, based on the type and assessment of ongoing controversies. Scoring range: 0 to -2.0. For details about the deduction, refer to the Tax Controversy Deduction Key, below.

sourceNote: 该议题 PDF 的框架图仍含已删除的历史议题。本网站的 33 议题结构依据 2026 年 3 月总方法论第 6 页；删除历史见模型更新 v4.2（2023-04-03）。议题指标本身仍按本文件核对。
scoringNote: 治理先从 10 分起扣除相关关键指标的贡献，并按方法论做缩放、主题与支柱汇总。部分指标影响议题得分，但不经公司治理主题进入最终评级；适用范围及贡献以各指标原文和总方法论为准。

rules.title: 税收差距影响得分的前提
body: 只有涉及正在进行的税务争议时，估计税收差距才影响公司行为主题和治理支柱得分。税收差距是近五年平均估计有效税率与按收入来源国家／地区估计法定税率之间的差异。
rules.note: 原表“5% or below”和“5–10%”在 5% 处有显示交叠；未自行规定边界归属。

name: 会计
summary: 评估外部审计机构的聘任、审计报告结论，以及其他会计事件所反映的潜在会计风险。
intro: Accounting is a Key Issue in the Governance Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on the appointment of the external audit firm, the findings of its audit report, and on other accounting events as an indicator of potential accounting risk.

keyMetrics.name: Accounting Investigations
keyMetrics.definition: Has the company announced an internal investigation into its accounting, come under investigation from a regulatory body, or been subject to fine, settlement, or conviction for issues related to its accounting practices? Or has the company’s auditor come under investigation for issues related to its work on the audit of the company? Flagged if yes. The duration of the flag is dependent on the severity assessment.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司是否宣布对其会计进行内部调查、受到监管机构调查，或因会计实践相关问题而被罚款、和解或定罪？或者公司的审计机构是否因与公司审计工作相关的问题而受到调查？若是，则被标记。标记的持续时间取决于严重程度评估。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.3, Severe 0.5, Very Severe 1.0
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.3, Severe 0.5, Very Severe 1.0

keyMetrics.name: Auditor Report Concerns
keyMetrics.definition: Has the company’s independent auditor expressed a qualified, adverse, or disclaimer of opinion, expressed concerns via an emphasis of matter paragraph? Have concerns been identified in respect of the auditor’s ability to present an independent opinion, or has the auditor been changed in a manner that may raise concerns for investors? Flagged if yes within the past year. This metric is based on the report of the external auditor disclosed in the annual financial statements and highlights any qualified auditor opinion or concerns raised in an emphasis of matter inserted by the auditor. Purely informational emphasis of matter paragraphs are not flagged. This metric is also evaluated on the basis of news reports or regulatory filings, including those that relate to interim or quarterly financial statements in which the auditors have raised concerns.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司的独立审计机构是否发表保留意见、否定意见或无法表示意见，或通过强调事项段表达关注？是否已识别出与审计机构能否提出独立意见相关的关注事项，或审计机构发生变更的方式可能引发投资者担忧？若在过去一年内为是，则被标记。该指标基于年度财务报表中披露的外部审计机构报告，并突出显示任何保留审计意见或审计机构在强调事项段中提出的关注。纯属信息性的强调事项段不予标记。该指标还基于新闻报道或监管文件进行评估，包括与审计机构提出关注的、中期或季度财务报表相关的报道或文件。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on type of auditor opinion/emphasis of matter and whether there are consecutive years of concerns.
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on type of auditor opinion/emphasis of matter and whether there are consecutive years of concerns. Range: 0.5 to 3.0

keyMetrics.name: Internal Controls
keyMetrics.definition: Has there been evidence of material weakness in the company’s internal control systems? Flagged if yes. The duration of the flag is dependent on the severity assessment. The event tags or categories used to create this flag include material weakness in internal controls or SOX 404 violations. Outside of the U.S., this metric is evaluated based on the audit committee’s assessment of the effectiveness of internal control.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 是否有证据表明公司的内部控制体系存在重大缺陷？若有，则被标记。标记的持续时间取决于严重程度评估。用于生成该标记的事件标签或类别包括内部控制的重大缺陷或 SOX 404 违规。在美国以外，该指标基于审计委员会对内部控制有效性的评估进行评估。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.1, Severe 0.2, Very Severe 0.4
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.1, Severe 0.2, Very Severe 0.4

keyMetrics.name: Restatements or Special Charges
keyMetrics.fullName: Restatements or Special Charges Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Has the company had to restate previously published financial statements due to fraud, error, or the misapplication of accounting standards? Has the company announced or reported special charges or write-offs that might raise questions as to the stewardship of the company by the board? Flagged if yes. The duration of the flag is dependent on the severity assessment.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司是否因欺诈、错误或会计准则的误用而不得不重述此前公布的财务报表？公司是否宣布或报告了可能对董事会对公司的管理提出质疑的特别费用或核销？若有，则被标记。标记的持续时间取决于严重程度评估。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.3, Severe 0.5, Very Severe 1.0
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.3, Severe 0.5, Very Severe 1.0

keyMetrics.name: Late Filings
keyMetrics.definition: Is the company currently late in filing its quarterly, half-year (or interim), or annual reports, or its annual proxy/notice of annual meeting of shareholders? Flagged if yes. The flag will be removed once the case is assessed as concluded.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司目前是否延迟提交其季度、半年度（或中期）或年度报告，或其年度委托书/股东大会通知？若是，则被标记。一旦该事项被评估为已结案，该标记将被移除。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring Deduction: 0.2

keyMetrics.name: Auditor Independence
keyMetrics.definition: Did the company pay its external audit firm less for audit and audit-related services than for other services in the last fiscal year? Flagged if yes. This metric uses auditor fees schedules to flag companies where such independence may have been compromised.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 在上一个财年，公司为其外部审计机构支付的审计及审计相关服务费用是否低于其他服务费用？若是，则被标记。该指标使用审计机构费用明细表来标记此类独立性可能已受损的公司。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.5

keyMetrics.name: Auditor Tenure
keyMetrics.definition: Is there evidence that the external audit firm has served in excess of 20 years? Flagged if yes.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 是否有证据表明外部审计机构已服务超过 20 年？若有，则被标记。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable based on tenure: 0.3 if > 50 years 0.2 if > 20 years 0.1 if not disclosed
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable based on tenure: 0.3 if > 50 years 0.2 if > 20 years 0.1 if not disclosed

sourceNote: 该议题 PDF 的框架图仍含已删除的历史议题。本网站的 33 议题结构依据 2026 年 3 月总方法论第 6 页；删除历史见模型更新 v4.2（2023-04-03）。议题指标本身仍按本文件核对。
scoringNote: 治理先从 10 分起扣除相关关键指标的贡献，并按方法论做缩放、主题与支柱汇总。部分指标影响议题得分，但不经公司治理主题进入最终评级；适用范围及贡献以各指标原文和总方法论为准。

name: 董事会
summary: 评估董事会相对于管理层及其他利益方的独立性，以及董事出席率、董事兼职过多等经验与有效性指标。
intro: Board is a Key Issue in the Governance Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on the board’s independence from management and/or other interests, and on various measures of board experience and effectiveness such as director attendance and director overboarding, where individual board members may compromise their effectiveness by serving on too many boards. Negative governance-related events such as bankruptcies; securities violations or regulatory investigations; and delisting threats are included in this section. These event metrics, when flagged, may have a significant impact on a company’s overall governance score.

keyMetrics.name: Independent Chair
keyMetrics.definition: Is the chair classified as not independent of management or not independent of other interests (links to employees, government or major owners), based on MSCI S&C criteria? Flagged if yes. This metric refers to the board of directors or (in a two-tier board structure) to the supervisory board. See the section Evaluating Directors, below, for details of the independence evaluation criteria.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 根据 MSCI S&C 标准，董事长是否被归类为不独立于管理层或不独立于其他利益（与员工、政府或主要股东的联系）？若是则被标记。本指标指董事会，或（在双层董事会结构中）指监事会。独立性评估标准的详情见下文“评估董事”章节。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.1

keyMetrics.name: Combined CEO/Chair
keyMetrics.nameCn: 首席执行官与董事长兼任
keyMetrics.definition: Does the company have a combined CEO/chair? Flagged if yes. While the practice of combining the CEO and chair positions on the board of directors is common enough to minimize its significance as a standalone metric, when combined with other key indicators this practice may be an indicator of potential governance weakness.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司是否存在首席执行官与董事长由同一人担任的情况？若是则被标记。尽管在董事会中兼任首席执行官与董事长职务的做法较为普遍，使其作为单独指标的重要性降低，但与其他关键指标结合时，这种做法可能预示潜在的治理薄弱。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

keyMetrics.name: Leadership Concerns
keyMetrics.definition: Are there concerns that there is a leader with excessive influence, including, but not limited to, instances such as: • An executive chair is serving alongside a CEO. • A former CEO remaining on the board as a non-executive director. • The non-executive chair is a former CFO. • An executive chair at one group company serves as a non-executive director at another group company. • A founder or co-founder remains on the board but not as chair or CEO. • Unregistered directors providing leadership direction. Flagged if yes.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 是否存在某位领导者拥有过度影响力的问题，包括但不限于以下情形：• 执行董事长与首席执行官同时任职。• 前首席执行官作为非执行董事留任董事会。• 非执行董事长曾任首席财务官。• 某集团公司的一名执行董事长在另一集团公司担任非执行董事。• 创始人或联合创始人留任董事会但并非董事长或首席执行官。• 未登记的董事提供领导方向。若是则被标记。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.3

keyMetrics.name: Chair Not Independent & No Independent Lead Director
keyMetrics.nameCn: 董事长不独立且无独立首席董事
keyMetrics.fullName: Chair Not Independent & No Independent Lead Director Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: For companies with a non-independent chair, has the company failed to designate an individually named non-executive lead director or independent deputy chair who is classified as both independent of management and independent of other interests (links to employees, government or major owners), based on MSCI S&C criteria? Flagged if yes. This metric refers to the board of directors or (in a two-tier board structure) to the supervisory board. See the section Evaluating Directors, below, for details of the independence evaluation criteria. For purposes of evaluating this metric, MSCI S&C excludes any lead directors who have not been individually designated as such by the company. This standard explicitly excludes lead director assignments based on rotating committee chair assignments or similar practices that may weaken the role and effectively counter its intended purpose.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 对于董事长不独立的公司，公司是否未能指派一位具名的非执行首席董事或独立副董事长，且该人根据 MSCI S&C 标准同时被归类为独立于管理层和独立于其他利益（与员工、政府或主要股东的联系）？若是则被标记。本指标指董事会，或（在双层董事会结构中）指监事会。独立性评估标准的详情见下文“评估董事”章节。就评估本指标而言，MSCI S&C 排除任何未被公司单独指名为首席董事的人士。此标准明确排除基于轮值委员会主席指派或类似做法而产生的首席董事任命，此类做法可能削弱该角色的作用并实质上背离其预期目的。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.1

keyMetrics.name: Board Majority Independent of Management
keyMetrics.nameCn: 董事会多数成员独立于管理层
keyMetrics.fullName: Board Majority Independent of Management Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Are less than a majority of directors independent of management, as defined by MSCI S&C? Flagged if yes. This metric flags issuers when less than 51% of the board is independent of management. See the section Evaluating Directors, below, for our definition of independence from management. For issuers with a two-tier board structure, this Key Metric assesses the supervisory board.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 根据 MSCI S&C 的定义，独立于管理层的董事是否不足多数？若是则被标记。当董事会中独立于管理层的成员不足 51% 时，本指标会标记发行人。关于独立于管理层的定义，见下文“评估董事”章节。对于双层董事会结构的发行人，本关键指标评估监事会。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on percentage of independent (of management) directors and whether the company is controlled:
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on percentage of independent (of management) directors and whether the company is controlled: Range: 0.2 to 1.0

keyMetrics.name: Board Majority Independent of Other Interest
keyMetrics.nameCn: 董事会多数成员独立于其他利益
keyMetrics.fullName: Board Majority Independent of Other Interest Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Are less than a majority of directors independent of other interests, as defined by MSCI S&C? Flagged if yes. This metric assesses what percentage of directors are affiliated with interests (other than those of management) that may diverge from the interests of minority investors. Issuers are flagged when less than 51% of the board is independent of other interests. See the section Evaluating Directors, below, for our definition of independence from other interests. For issuers with a two-tier board structure, this Key Metric assesses the supervisory board.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 根据 MSCI S&C 的定义，独立于其他利益的董事是否不足多数？若是则被标记。本指标评估与可能背离少数股东利益之利益方（管理层利益方除外）有关联的董事所占百分比。当董事会中独立于其他利益的成员不足 51% 时，发行人会被标记。关于独立于其他利益的定义，见下文“评估董事”章节。对于双层董事会结构的发行人，本关键指标评估监事会。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on percentage of independent (of other interests) directors:
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on percentage of independent (of other interests) directors: Range: 0.3 to 1.0.

keyMetrics.name: Executives on Board
keyMetrics.definition: Does 30% or more of the board of directors comprise executive directors or does the management board include eight or more executive directors? Flagged if yes. All board member bios are reviewed to determine current titles and positions.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 董事会中执行董事是否占 30% 或以上，或管理委员会是否包含八名或以上执行董事？若是则被标记。会审阅所有董事会成员的个人简介以确定其现任职务和职位。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on percentage of executive directors (or number of executives on a management board):
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on percentage of executive directors (or number of executives on a management board): Range: 0.2 to 0.5.

keyMetrics.name: No Independent Directors
keyMetrics.definition: Is the board composed entirely of directors who do not meet the MSCI S&C criteria for independence from management? Flagged if yes. This metric tests for those extreme cases where there is not a single member of the board of directors or supervisory board who can be considered independent of management. See the section Evaluating Directors, below, for details of the independence evaluation criteria.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 董事会是否完全由不符合 MSCI S&C 独立于管理层标准的董事组成？若是则被标记。本指标用于检验以下极端情形：董事会或监事会中没有任何一名成员可被视为独立于管理层。独立性评估标准的详情见下文“评估董事”章节。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.5

keyMetrics.name: Related-Party Transactions
keyMetrics.definition: Have there been any disclosed related-party transactions (RPTs) in either of the two most recently reported financial years? Flagged if yes. See the section Related-Party Transactions, below.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 在最近报告的两个财务年度中的任一年度，是否存在任何已披露的关联方交易（RPT）？若是则被标记。见下文“关联方交易”章节。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on transaction size, type of related-party and (for higher-risk cases) qualitative criteria. Partial disclosure: 0.5 or (if controlled) 1.0 If non-disclosure market & no company disclosure: 1.0 (scored but not flagged)
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on transaction size, type of related-party and (for higher-risk cases) qualitative criteria. Partial disclosure: 0.5 or (if controlled) 1.0 If non-disclosure market & no company disclosure: 1.0 (scored but not flagged) Range: 0.05 to 3.4

keyMetrics.name: Flagged Directors on Board
keyMetrics.fullName: Flagged Directors on Board Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Are any of the board members Flagged Directors, as defined by MSCI S&C? Flagged if yes. See the section Evaluating Directors, below, for details of the evaluation criteria. For issuers with two-tier board structures, members of either the supervisory board or the management board may be flagged.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 是否有任何董事会成员属于 MSCI S&C 定义的被标记董事？若是则被标记。评估标准的详情见下文“评估董事”章节。对于双层董事会结构的发行人，监事会或管理委员会的成员均可能被标记。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on number of flagged directors on the board and number of flagged-director instances for each director.
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on number of flagged directors on the board and number of flagged-director instances for each director. Range: 0.2 to 1.0

keyMetrics.name: Overboarded Non-Exec Directors
keyMetrics.nameCn: 兼任过多董事职务的非执行董事
keyMetrics.definition: Do any of the company’s non-executive board members serve on the boards of four or more issuers in MSCI S&C’s corporate governance research universe (whether included as an equity or debt issuer)? Flagged if yes. Board membership counts reference the board of directors or (in a two-tier board structure) the supervisory board. See the section Evaluating Directors, below, for details of the evaluation criteria.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司是否有任何非执行董事会成员在 MSCI S&C 公司治理研究范围（无论作为股权或债券发行人纳入）内的四家或以上发行人董事会任职？若是则被标记。董事会任职计数指董事会，或（在双层董事会结构中）指监事会。评估标准的详情见下文“评估董事”章节。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.5

keyMetrics.name: Overboarded Exec Directors
keyMetrics.nameCn: 兼任过多董事职务的执行董事
keyMetrics.definition: Do any of the company’s executive board members serve on the boards of three or more issuers in MSCI S&C’s corporate governance research universe (whether included as an equity or debt issuer)? Flagged if yes. This is of particular significance in the case of the company’s CEO. Board membership counts reference the board of directors or (in a two-tier board structure) the supervisory board. See the section Evaluating Directors, below, for details of the evaluation criteria.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司是否有任何执行董事会成员在 MSCI S&C 公司治理研究范围（无论作为股权或债券发行人纳入）内的三家或以上发行人董事会任职？若是则被标记。就公司首席执行官而言，这一点尤为重要。董事会任职计数指董事会，或（在双层董事会结构中）指监事会。评估标准的详情见下文“评估董事”章节。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.5

keyMetrics.name: Significant Votes Against Directors
keyMetrics.fullName: Significant Votes Against Directors Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Are there one or more directors on the board who received a negative or withheld shareholder vote in excess of 10% in the most recently reported election? Flagged if yes. This metric refers to the board of directors or (in a two-tier board structure) to the supervisory board and the management board. Even a negative vote of 5% indicates an unusually high vote against a particular individual director at most companies. This metric is triggered by a negative vote of over 10% against any directors in the most recently reported election (or in certain markets on the discharge of the directors). A “negative vote” includes any against, withhold or abstain votes.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 在最近报告的选举中，是否有一名或多名董事会成员获得超过 10% 的反对票或拒绝投票？若是则被标记。本指标指董事会，或（在双层董事会结构中）指监事会和管理委员会。在多数公司中，针对某位特定董事哪怕 5% 的反对票都表明反对票异常之高。在最近报告的选举中（或在某些市场针对董事的免责表决中），只要有超过 10% 的反对票针对任何董事，本指标即被触发。“反对票”包括任何反对票、拒绝投票或弃权票。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on number of directors, the size of against/abstain/withhold votes and whether there is a controlling shareholder.
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on number of directors, the size of against/abstain/withhold votes and whether there is a controlling shareholder. Range: 0.25 to 2.0

keyMetrics.name: Oversized Board
keyMetrics.definition: Does the board of directors or the supervisory board include a high number of directors that suggests obstacles to effective oversight and decision-making? Flagged if yes. This is currently set at 20 directors and refers to either the board of directors or supervisory board. Boards of this size may find it harder to discuss issues in the necessary detail or take decisions in a timely manner.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 董事会或监事会是否包含数量过多、可能对有效监督和决策构成障碍的董事？若是则被标记。目前设定为 20 名董事，指董事会或监事会。如此规模的董事会可能更难对问题进行必要的深入讨论，或更难以适时作出决策。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.5

keyMetrics.name: Undersized Board
keyMetrics.definition: Are there four or fewer directors on the board of directors or supervisory board? Flagged if yes. Boards comprising so few individuals may lack the diversity of view and experience needed to provide effective oversight over most public companies, particularly when it comes to appointing members to the board’s standing committees. This metric refers to either the board of directors or supervisory board.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 董事会或监事会中是否有四名或更少的董事？若是则被标记。由如此少数个人组成的董事会可能缺乏对多数上市公司进行有效监督所需的观点和经验多样性，尤其是在向董事会各常设委员会任命成员时。本指标指董事会或监事会。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 1.0

keyMetrics.name: Board Attendance Failures
keyMetrics.definition: Did any members of the board fail to attend at least 75% of all board and committee meetings held during the last reported period? Flagged if yes. This metric refers to the board of directors or (in a two-tier board structure) to the supervisory board and the management board. Excessive board attendance failures have been linked to other, less visible board problems or weaknesses.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 在最近报告的期间内，是否有任何董事会成员未能出席所有董事会及委员会会议的至少 75%？若是则被标记。本指标指董事会，或（在双层董事会结构中）指监事会和管理委员会。董事出席率的严重不达标与其他较不明显的董事会问题或薄弱环节有关联。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.1

keyMetrics.name: Entrenched Board
keyMetrics.definition: Does the percentage of long-tenured, aging directors suggest a problem with board entrenchment? Flagged if yes. This metric is based on an assessment of multiple factors, including director age and tenure in the following combinations: • More than 35% of the board has a tenure of 15 years or greater; • More than 22% of the board has a tenure of 15 years or greater and more than 15% of the directors are aged 70 or over; • There are more than four directors who have a tenure of 15 years or greater; or • There are more than four directors who are aged 70 or over. This metric extends to the board of directors and supervisory board. The strength of this metric as an indicator of potential governance problems is greatly increased at companies whose recent performance has consistently lagged their peers.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 长期任职及年长董事所占百分比是否表明存在董事会固化的迹象？若是则被标记。本指标基于对多重因素的评估，包括以下组合中的董事年龄和任期：• 超过 35% 的董事会成员任期为 15 年或以上；• 超过 22% 的董事会成员任期为 15 年或以上，且超过 15% 的董事年龄为 70 岁或以上；• 有四名以上董事任期为 15 年或以上；或 • 有四名以上董事年龄为 70 岁或以上。本指标适用于董事会和监事会。在近期绩效持续落后于同业组的公司，本指标作为潜在治理问题迹象的效力会大大增强。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on CEO tenure & board refreshment rate.
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on CEO tenure & board refreshment rate. Range: 0.6 to 1.5

keyMetrics.name: CEOs on Board
keyMetrics.nameCn: 董事会中的首席执行官
keyMetrics.definition: Is more than 30% of the board composed of currently active corporate CEOs from other companies? Flagged if yes. This metric extends to the board of directors and supervisory board. To be included in this category, the individual must be a currently active CEO at another publicly traded company; the CEO of the company being rated is excluded. Based on information contained in each individual’s bio or on his or her designation as a current company CEO in the MSCI S&C director database.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 董事会中是否有超过 30% 由来自其他公司的现任在职首席执行官组成？若是则被标记。本指标适用于董事会和监事会。要纳入此类别，该人士必须是另一家上市公司的现任在职首席执行官；被评级的公司自身的首席执行官被排除在外。依据每个人个人简介中的信息，或其在 MSCI S&C 董事数据库中作为现任公司首席执行官的标注。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.5

keyMetrics.name: No Female Directors
keyMetrics.definition: Does the composition of the board fail to include any female directors? Flagged if yes. This metric extends to the board of directors and supervisory board.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 董事会的构成中是否没有任何女性董事？若是则被标记。本指标适用于董事会和监事会。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.2

keyMetrics.name: Not 30% Female Directors
keyMetrics.definition: Does the composition of the board fail to include at least 30% female directors? Flagged if yes. This metric extends to the board of directors and supervisory board.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 董事会的构成中是否未包含至少 30% 的女性董事？若是则被标记。本指标适用于董事会和监事会。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.1

keyMetrics.name: Risk Management Expertise
keyMetrics.definition: Does the board lack at least one non-executive member of the board who has general expertise in risk management, based on MSCI S&C standards? Flagged if yes. This metric extends to the board of directors and supervisory board. See the section Evaluating Directors, below, for details of the evaluation criteria.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 根据 MSCI S&C 标准，董事会是否缺少至少一名具备风险管理一般专长的非执行董事成员？若是则被标记。本指标适用于董事会和监事会。评估标准的详情见下文“评估董事”章节。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.2

keyMetrics.name: Audit Board/Committee Independence
keyMetrics.nameCn: 审计委员会/审计董事会独立性
keyMetrics.definition: Has the company failed to establish an audit committee or audit board comprising only directors who are independent of management based on MSCI S&C’s criteria? Flagged if yes. See the section Evaluating Directors, below, for details of the independence evaluation criteria.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司是否未能设立仅由符合 MSCI S&C 独立于管理层标准的董事组成的审计委员会或审计董事会？若是则被标记。独立性评估标准的详情见下文“评估董事”章节。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on whether committee exists & percentage of independent members.
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on whether committee exists & percentage of independent members. Range: 0.1 to 0.8

keyMetrics.name: Executives on Audit Board/Committee
keyMetrics.nameCn: 审计委员会/审计董事会中的高管
keyMetrics.fullName: Executives on Audit Board/Committee Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Are there company executives serving on the audit committee or audit board? Flagged if yes.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 是否有公司高管在审计委员会或审计董事会任职？若是则被标记。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on percentage of executive members.
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on percentage of executive members. Range: 0.2 to 0.5

keyMetrics.name: Audit Committee Financial Expert
keyMetrics.fullName: Audit Committee Financial Expert Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Does the audit committee or audit board lack at least one non-executive member with general expertise in accounting or financial management, based on the MSCI S&C criteria? Flagged if yes. See the section Evaluating Directors, below, for details of the evaluation criteria.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 根据 MSCI S&C 标准，审计委员会或审计董事会是否缺少至少一名具备会计或财务管理一般专长的非执行成员？若是则被标记。评估标准的详情见下文“评估董事”章节。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.1

keyMetrics.name: Audit Committee Industry Expert
keyMetrics.fullName: Audit Committee Industry Expert Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Does the audit committee or audit board lack at least one non-executive member who has substantial industry knowledge, based on the MSCI S&C criteria? Flagged if yes. See the section Evaluating Directors, below, for details of the evaluation criteria.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 根据 MSCI S&C 标准，审计委员会或审计董事会是否缺少至少一名具备深厚行业知识的非执行成员？若是则被标记。评估标准的详情见下文“评估董事”章节。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.1

keyMetrics.name: Overboarded Audit Committee Members
keyMetrics.nameCn: 兼任过多董事职务的审计委员会成员
keyMetrics.fullName: Overboarded Audit Committee Members Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Do any of the independent members of the audit committee serve on the boards of four or more issuers in MSCI S&C’s corporate governance research universe (whether included as an equity or debt issuer)? Or do any of the non-independent members of the audit committee serve on the boards of three or more issuers? Flagged if yes. This metric further emphasizes the link between overboarding and board effectiveness by testing for its presence on this committee.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 审计委员会是否有任何独立成员在 MSCI S&C 公司治理研究范围（无论作为股权或债券发行人纳入）内的四家或以上发行人董事会任职？或审计委员会是否有任何非独立成员在三家或以上发行人董事会任职？若是则被标记。本指标通过检验该委员会中是否存在此类情形，进一步强调董事兼任过多与董事会有效性之间的关联。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.1

keyMetrics.name: Pay Committee Independence
keyMetrics.definition: Where the company has established a pay committee, are there directors serving on the committee who are not independent of management based on MSCI S&C’s criteria? Flagged if yes. See the section Evaluating Directors, below, for details of the independence evaluation criteria.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 在公司已设立薪酬委员会的情况下，委员会中是否有不符合 MSCI S&C 独立于管理层标准的董事任职？若是则被标记。独立性评估标准的详情见下文“评估董事”章节。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on percentage of independent members.
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on percentage of independent members. Range: 0.1 to 0.3

keyMetrics.name: Executives on Pay Committee
keyMetrics.fullName: Executives on Pay Committee Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Are there company executives serving on the pay committee? Flagged if yes. In addition to evaluating the independence of its non-executive members, MSCI S&C also takes into consideration the presence of current company executives on this standing committee.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 是否有公司高管在薪酬委员会任职？若是则被标记。除评估其非执行成员的独立性外，MSCI S&C 还会考虑公司现任高管在该常设委员会中的存在情况。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on percentage of executive members.
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on percentage of executive members. Range: 0.1 to 0.2

keyMetrics.name: No Pay Committee & Execs on Board
keyMetrics.nameCn: 无薪酬委员会且董事会中有高管
keyMetrics.fullName: No Pay Committee & Execs on Board Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Does the company lack a standing pay committee, and are current company executives serving on its board? Flagged if yes. This metric is flagged for boards that lack a formally named pay committee yet include among its members one or more current company executives, including the CEO.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司是否缺少常设薪酬委员会，且其董事会中有现任公司高管任职？若是则被标记。对于缺少正式命名的薪酬委员会、但其成员中包含一名或多名现任公司高管（包括首席执行官）的董事会，本指标会被标记。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.6

keyMetrics.name: Pay Committee Concerns
keyMetrics.definition: Does the composition of the pay committee raise concerns about the presence of active CEOs on the committee or in relation to the past record of the pay committee chair? Flagged if yes. This metric is triggered by the majority of pay committee or the committee chair being active CEOs, where the pay committee chair also chairs other pay committees and the latest annual say-on-pay vote was defeated, or where the pay committee chair is a former listed-company CEO and during his CEO tenure the say-on-pay vote was defeated.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 薪酬委员会的构成是否因委员会中存在在职首席执行官，或与薪酬委员会主席以往记录相关而引发担忧？若是则被标记。本指标的触发情形包括：薪酬委员会的多数成员或委员会主席为在职首席执行官；薪酬委员会主席同时担任其他薪酬委员会主席且最近的年度薪酬表决（say-on-pay）未获通过；或薪酬委员会主席曾任上市公司首席执行官且在其首席执行官任期内薪酬表决未获通过。
keyMetrics.deduction: 0.3 (if one test is met) 0.5 (if Pay Committee is 100% active CEOs) 0.6 (if two or more tests are met)
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.3 (if one test is met) 0.5 (if Pay Committee is 100% active CEOs) 0.6 (if two or more tests are met)

keyMetrics.name: No Nomination Committee
keyMetrics.definition: Does the company lack a standing nomination committee? Flagged if yes. This metric flags issuers that have not disclosed a formal nomination committee. A committee with the responsibility to nominate directors for election to the board will generally be considered a nomination committee, regardless of its name or other roles.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司是否缺少常设提名委员会？若是则被标记。本指标会标记未披露正式提名委员会的发行人。负责提名董事参加董事会选举的委员会，不论其名称或其他职能如何，通常会被视为提名委员会。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.3

keyMetrics.name: Nomination Committee Chair Independence
keyMetrics.nameCn: 提名委员会主席独立性
keyMetrics.fullName: Nomination Committee Chair Independence Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Is the nomination committee chair not independent of management or other interests, as defined by MSCI S&C? Flagged if yes. MSCI S&C consider it a best practice for key committees to be led by members who are independent of management, and, in some markets, nomination committees may include a high proportion of stakeholder representatives whose interests may diverge from those of minority investors. Therefore, this metric assesses the committee chair’s independence from both management and other interests. See the section Evaluating Directors, below, for our definitions of independence. This metric is not evaluated for companies that lack a nomination committee.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 根据 MSCI S&C 的定义，提名委员会主席是否不独立于管理层或其他利益？若是则被标记。MSCI S&C 认为关键委员会由独立于管理层的成员领导是最佳实践，且在某些市场，提名委员会可能包含高比例的利益相关方代表，其利益可能背离少数股东的利益。因此，本指标评估委员会主席独立于管理层和其他利益两者的程度。关于独立性的定义，见下文“评估董事”章节。对于缺少提名委员会的公司，不评估本指标。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.1

keyMetrics.name: Nomination Committee Independence
keyMetrics.definition: Are less than a majority of nomination committee members independent of management and other interests, as defined by MSCI S&C? Flagged if yes.
