MSCI S&C consider it a best practice for key committees to be independent of management, and, in some markets, nomination committees may include a high proportion of stakeholder representatives whose interests may diverge from those of minority investors. Therefore, this metric assesses what percentage of the committee is independent of both management and other interests. See the section Evaluating Directors, below, for our definitions of independence. This metric is not evaluated for companies that lack a nomination committee.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 根据 MSCI S&C 的定义，独立于管理层和其他利益的提名委员会成员是否不足多数？若是则被标记。MSCI S&C 认为关键委员会独立于管理层是最佳实践，且在某些市场，提名委员会可能包含高比例的利益相关方代表，其利益可能背离少数股东的利益。因此，本指标评估委员会中独立于管理层和其他利益两者的成员所占百分比。关于独立性的定义，见下文“评估董事”章节。对于缺少提名委员会的公司，不评估本指标。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.1

keyMetrics.name: Bankruptcy or Liquidation
keyMetrics.definition: Is the company, or a material subsidiary, currently in receivership, under bankruptcy protection, or facing liquidation? Flagged if yes. The flag will be removed once the case is assessed as concluded. This Key Metric focuses on negative credit events including bankruptcy protection, administration, receivership, curatorship and liquidation.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司或重大子公司目前是否处于破产接管、破产保护之下，或面临清算？若是则被标记。一旦该案件被评估为已了结，标记即会移除。本关键指标关注负面信用事件，包括破产保护、破产管理、破产接管、财产监管和清算。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.8, Severe 1.5, Very Severe 3.0
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.8, Severe 1.5, Very Severe 3.0

keyMetrics.name: Debt Covenant Concerns
keyMetrics.definition: Has the company, or a material subsidiary, recently breached the terms of its debt covenants, had a test of its debt covenant terms deferred or waived, or been reported to be in danger of breaching its debt covenants? Flagged if yes. The flag will be removed once the case is assessed as concluded. This Key Metric focuses on negative credit events including failure to repay (or defer paying) capital or interest on the debt, breaching terms (or waiving or deferring the testing) of the debt covenants such as exceeding borrowing limits or breaches of technical provisions.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司或重大子公司最近是否违反了其债务契约条款、其债务契约条款的检验被推迟或豁免，或被报告面临违反债务契约的风险？若是则被标记。一旦该案件被评估为已了结，标记即会移除。本关键指标关注负面信用事件，包括未能偿还（或推迟偿还）债务本金或利息、违反条款（或豁免或推迟检验）债务契约（如超出借款限额或违反技术性条款）。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.3, Severe 0.5, Very Severe 1.0
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.3, Severe 0.5, Very Severe 1.0

keyMetrics.name: Financing Difficulties
keyMetrics.definition: Have concerns been identified by the board or been reported in the press in relation to the going-concern assumption, or is there other evidence that the company, or a material subsidiary, may be facing financing difficulties? Flagged if yes. The flag will be removed once the case is assessed as concluded. This Key Metric seeks to identify where there is a risk of a negative credit event. A successful outcome, such as an equity-raising or renegotiated credit terms, may resolve this concern, and forms part of the severity assessment criteria.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 董事会是否已发现与持续经营假设相关的问题，或媒体已报道此类问题，或有其他证据表明公司或重大子公司可能面临融资困难？若是则被标记。一旦该案件被评估为已了结，标记即会移除。本关键指标旨在识别存在负面信用事件风险的情形。成功的结果（如股权融资或重新协商信贷条款）可能化解此问题，并构成严重程度评估标准的一部分。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.3, Severe 0.5, Very Severe 1.0
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.3, Severe 0.5, Very Severe 1.0

keyMetrics.name: Capital Management Concerns
keyMetrics.definition: Have concerns been raised as to the treatment of security holders in relation to the raising and/or return of capital? Flagged if yes. The duration of the flag is dependent on the severity assessment. Circumstances that may be flagged include situations where investors face high potential equity dilution through new share issuances, where existing investors have been treated unfairly in capital raisings, or where there are concerns related to share buyback activity.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 在资本的募集和/或返还方面，是否有人就证券持有人的待遇提出担忧？若是则被标记。标记的持续时间取决于严重程度评估。可能被标记的情形包括：投资者因新股发行而面临高度潜在股权稀释；现有投资者在资本募集中被不公平对待；或与股份回购活动相关的担忧。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.3, Severe 0.5, Very Severe 1.0
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.3, Severe 0.5, Very Severe 1.0

keyMetrics.name: Securities Violations
keyMetrics.definition: Has the company faced allegations that investors have not been given access to certain basic facts about the company, whether in the process of issuing new securities or following issuance? Or has the company faced substantive allegations of breaches of investor protection requirements (including in relation to offers it makes for third parties)? Flagged if yes. The duration of the flag is dependent on the severity assessment. Items that relate specifically to accounting and audit issues are covered under the Accounting Key Issue. The Securities Violations Key Metric contributes to the Board Key Issue, but does not contribute to a company’s ESG Ratings via the Corporate Governance Theme Score. The impact will instead be reflected in the Corporate Behavior Theme under the Business Ethics Key Issue in the assessment of the Business Ethics Controversies Key Metric. (See the “MSCI ESG Ratings Methodology: Business Ethics Key Issue” document for details)
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司是否面临指控，称投资者未能在发行新证券的过程中或发行之后获得有关公司的某些基本事实？或公司是否面临实质性指控，称其违反了投资者保护要求（包括与向第三方提出的要约相关的要求）？若是则被标记。标记的持续时间取决于严重程度评估。与会计和审计问题具体相关的项目在“会计”关键议题下涵盖。证券违规关键指标对“董事会”关键议题有贡献，但不通过公司治理主题评分贡献于公司的 ESG 评级。其影响将改为在公司行为主题下的商业道德关键议题中，通过商业道德争议关键指标的评估予以反映。（详情见《MSCI ESG Ratings Methodology: Business Ethics Key Issue》文件）
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.3, Severe 0.5, Very Severe 1.0
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.3, Severe 0.5, Very Severe 1.0

keyMetrics.name: Threat of Delisting
keyMetrics.definition: Is the issuer currently in breach of its continuing obligations that apply to the listing of its securities, which may threaten the continued listing or trading of those securities? Flagged if yes. The flag will be removed once the case is assessed as concluded.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 发行人目前是否违反了适用于其证券上市的持续义务，从而可能威胁这些证券的继续上市或交易？若是则被标记。一旦该案件被评估为已了结，标记即会移除。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.5

keyMetrics.name: Executive Misconduct
keyMetrics.definition: Has a current or recent member of the board or a senior executive of the company (and while serving at this company) allegedly failed to act with honesty and integrity, engaged in actions contrary to the interests of the company and its shareholders, breached trust or confidence, engaged in criminal actions or engaged in actions that caused damage to the company’s reputation? Flagged if yes. The duration of the flag is dependent on the severity assessment. This metric refers to current or former members of the board of directors, management board (in a two-tier structure) and executive committee. The Executive Misconduct Key Metric contributes to the Board Key Issue, but does not contribute to a company’s ESG Ratings via the Corporate Governance Theme Score. The impact will instead be reflected in the Corporate Behavior Theme under the Business Ethics Key Issue in the assessment of the Business Ethics Controversies Key Metric. (See the “MSCI ESG Ratings Methodology: Business Ethics Key Issue” document for details.)
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司现任或近期的董事会成员或高级高管（且在其于本公司任职期间）是否被指控未能以诚实和诚信行事、从事违背公司及其股东利益的行为、违反信任或信赖、从事犯罪行为，或从事损害公司声誉的行为？若是则被标记。标记的持续时间取决于严重程度评估。本指标指董事会、管理委员会（双层结构下）和执行委员会的现任或前任成员。高管不当行为关键指标对“董事会”关键议题有贡献，但不通过公司治理主题评分贡献于公司的 ESG 评级。其影响将改为在公司行为主题下的商业道德关键议题中，通过商业道德争议关键指标的评估予以反映。（详情见《MSCI ESG Ratings Methodology: Business Ethics Key Issue》文件。）
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.3, Severe 0.5, Very Severe 1.0
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.3, Severe 0.5, Very Severe 1.0

keyMetrics.name: Other High-Impact Governance Events
keyMetrics.fullName: Other High-Impact Governance Events Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Has the company faced situations that may distract the board from focusing on business operations and strategic matters; have major questions been raised as to the quality of past board decisions; or is there evidence of governance failures at the company? Flagged if yes. The duration of the flag is dependent on the severity assessment.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司是否面临可能使董事会无法专注于业务运营和战略事项的情形；是否有人就过往董事会决策的质量提出重大质疑；或是否存在公司治理失灵的迹象？若是则被标记。标记的持续时间取决于严重程度评估。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.5, Severe 1.0, Very Severe 2.0 Evaluating directors Independence Director independence is assessed along two dimensions — independence from management and independence from other interests (links to employees, government or major owners). The Board Leadership Key Metrics require independence from both management and other interests, however, assessments of the board as a whole and of the various board committees (excluding the nomination committee) are based on the independent of management criteria only. Lengthy tenure is not evaluated as part of the independence assessments but forms part of the Entrenched Board Key Metric evaluation criteria. Independent of management Per MSCI S&C’s definition of independence from management, a director will be considered not independent of management if they meet one or more of the following criteria in Exhibit 2.
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.5, Severe 1.0, Very Severe 2.0 Evaluating directors Independence Director independence is assessed along two dimensions — independence from management and independence from other interests (links to employees, government or major owners). The Board Leadership Key Metrics require independence from both management and other interests, however, assessments of the board as a whole and of the various board committees (excluding the nomination committee) are based on the independent of management criteria only. Lengthy tenure is not evaluated as part of the independence assessments but forms part of the Entrenched Board Key Metric evaluation criteria. Independent of management Per MSCI S&C’s definition of independence from management, a director will be considered not independent of management if they meet one or more of the following criteria in Exhibit 2.

scoringNote: 治理先从 10 分起扣除相关关键指标的贡献，并按方法论做缩放、主题与支柱汇总。部分指标影响议题得分，但不经公司治理主题进入最终评级；适用范围及贡献以各指标原文和总方法论为准。

name: 所有权与控制权
summary: 评估企业所有权结构、最大股东经济权益与投票权的偏离（控制权倾斜），以及影响治理风险的资本与所有权因素；并评估股东权利与问责框架、监管环境。
intro: Ownership & Control is a Key Issue in the Governance Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on their ownership structure, the proportionality between the economic exposure and voting power of the largest owner (“control skew”), and other capital or ownership factors that may affect governance risk. Companies are also evaluated on investor protection, specifically the rights of shareholders and the effectiveness of the framework to hold boards to account, in addition to the regulatory and company- specific provisions that support (or restrict) shareholders’ ability to determine the company’s future.

keyMetrics.name: Controlling Shareholder
keyMetrics.definition: Does any shareholder or shareholder bloc control more than 30% of the voting shares, or are they able to elect more than 50% of the company’s board? Flagged if yes. Where the Governance Reference Entity is not an equity issuer, this evaluation is based on the ultimate owner.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 是否有任何股东或股东集团控制超过 30% 的有表决权股份，或能够选出超过 50% 的公司董事会成员？若为是则被标记。当治理参考实体并非股权发行人时，该评估基于最终所有者。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0

keyMetrics.name: Controlling Shareholder Concerns
keyMetrics.definition: Does the company have ownership structures or governance arrangements that may present risks for minority public shareholders? Flagged if yes. This can be triggered by the presence of one or more criteria, including where: • Any of the following Key Metrics are also flagged:  No Independent Directors; Leadership Concerns; Undersized Board; Cross Shareholdings; or Poison Pill. • Or any of the following apply:  The issuer has issued golden shares;  The issuer is controlled via a stock pyramid;  The issuer is incorporated as a Partnership Limited by Shares; or  The largest shareholder holds more than 75% of the total voting rights.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司是否存在可能给少数公众股东带来风险的所有权结构或治理安排？若为是则被标记。可由一项或多项标准触发，包括：• 以下任一关键指标也被标记：无独立董事；领导层问题；董事会规模不足；交叉持股；或毒丸计划。• 或存在以下任一情形：发行人已发行黄金股；发行人通过股权金字塔控制；发行人注册为股份有限公司合伙企业（Partnership Limited by Shares）；或最大股东持有超过 75% 的全部表决权。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 1.0

keyMetrics.name: Dispersed Ownership Concerns
keyMetrics.definition: Is the company so widely held that there are no principal shareholders or other large-bloc holders? Flagged if yes. This test eliminates family or founder firms, companies with a principal shareholder with more than 10% of voting rights, and companies where the aggregate 5%+ holdings exceed 30%. This metric is intended to capture companies where there is a disconnect between ownership and management. In the absence of the constraining influence of an informed and involved bloc of shareholders, there is a greater risk of the CEO and board asserting a degree of power and authority more commonly associated with controlled companies.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司是否持股如此分散，以致没有主要股东或其他大额持股方？若是则被标记。该测试排除家族或创始人企业、拥有表决权超过 10% 的主要股东的公司，以及所有至少持有 5% 股份的股东合计持股超过 30% 的公司。本指标旨在识别所有权与管理层脱节的公司。若缺少知情且积极参与的股东群体所形成的约束，CEO 和董事会可能行使通常见于受控公司的权力与权威，风险更大。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

keyMetrics.name: Cross-Shareholdings
keyMetrics.definition: Is the company involved in a series of cross-shareholdings with other (related or unrelated) companies? Flagged if yes. This metric identifies cross-shareholdings intended for non-investment purposes. Cross-shareholdings for the purpose of this Key Metric include direct, indirect (via subsidiary companies), circular, or more complex cross-shareholding networks.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司是否与其他（关联或非关联）公司存在一系列交叉持股？若为是则被标记。该指标识别出于非投资目的的交叉持股。就本关键指标而言，交叉持股包括直接、间接（通过子公司）、循环或更复杂的交叉持股网络。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on size of cross-shareholdings:
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on size of cross-shareholdings: Range: 0.2 to 3.2

keyMetrics.name: Tracking Stock
keyMetrics.definition: Is the company being traded as a tracking stock or similar trading-based entity? Flagged if yes. Tracking stocks are treated as an indicator of potential governance weakness.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司是否以追踪股票或类似的基于交易的实体形式交易？若为是则被标记。追踪股票被视为潜在治理弱点的指标。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.5

keyMetrics.name: Variable Interest Entities
keyMetrics.definition: Does at least 5% of the group's revenue come from VIEs where the company holds less than 10% voting rights? Flagged if yes. A variable interest entity (VIE) is a special purpose vehicle in which the issuer holds a controlling interest in an operating company that is not based on a majority of the voting rights. Via structured contracts, the issuer is typically the primary beneficiary of the VIE.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 集团是否有至少 5% 的收入来自公司持有不足 10% 表决权的 VIE？若为是则被标记。可变利益实体（VIE）是一种特殊目的载体，发行人在其中对一家经营公司持有控制性权益，但该控制并非基于多数表决权。通过结构化合同，发行人通常是该 VIE 的主要受益人。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.5

keyMetrics.name: Multiple Equity Classes with Different Voting Rights
keyMetrics.nameCn: 具有不同表决权的多重股权类别
keyMetrics.fullName: Multiple Equity Classes with Different Voting Rights Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Has the company issued more than one class of equity shares and do these classes carry unequal voting rights? Flagged if yes. The inequality in the voting rights may be manifested via different votes per share, different votes per unit of nominal value, through the ability to vote only on certain matters, on the election of certain directors, or grant special rights (such as the exclusive right of nominating directors). When a share class termed as “preference,” “preferred,” or similar, is classified in the annual accounts under accounting standards as an equity security rather than a liability, then it will be considered as an equity class for the purposes of this metric. Share classes that do not carry special rights but have unequal voting rights may not be flagged if the number issued is not significant.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司是否发行了多于一个类别的股权股份，且这些类别具有不等的表决权？若为是则被标记。表决权的不平等可能表现为每股表决票不同、每单位面值表决票不同，或仅可就特定事项、特定董事选举进行表决，或授予特殊权利（如提名董事的专属权利）。当被称为“优先”“优先股”或类似名称的股份类别，依据会计准则在年度账目中被归类为权益证券而非负债时，就本指标而言将被视为一个股权类别。不附带特殊权利但具有不等表决权的股份类别，若发行数量不重大，可能不被标记。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on size of voting rights differential & percentage of votes held by largest owner:
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on size of voting rights differential & percentage of votes held by largest owner: Range: 0.2 to 0.6

keyMetrics.name: Single Equity Class with Different Voting Rights
keyMetrics.nameCn: 具有不同表决权的单一股权类别
keyMetrics.fullName: Single Equity Class with Different Voting Rights Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Does the capital structure include a single share class where the voting rights vary based on the duration of ownership (or extra voting rights are granted via “loyalty shares”)? Flagged if yes. In some literature these may also be referred to as tenured voting shares.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 资本结构是否包含单一股份类别，其表决权根据持股时间长短而变化（或通过“忠诚股”授予额外表决权）？若为是则被标记。在某些文献中，这些也可称为附期限表决股份（tenured voting shares）。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on length of required holding period and percentage of votes held by largest owner.
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on length of required holding period and percentage of votes held by largest owner. Range: 0.2 to 0.55

keyMetrics.name: Voting Rights Limits Shares Held
keyMetrics.fullName: Voting Rights Limits Shares Held Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Are voting rights capped at a certain percentage, no matter how many shares the investor owns? Flagged if yes. This may refer to either an “ownership ceiling” or a “voting rights ceiling,” in which ownership and/or voting rights limits are applied to some or all shareholders. This metric is derived from a company’s corporate charter and bylaws, or on the basis of applicable corporate regulations.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 无论投资者持有多少股份，表决权是否被限制在某一百分比？若为是则被标记。这可能指“持股上限”或“表决权上限”，即对部分或全部股东适用持股和/或表决权限制。该指标源自公司的公司章程和细则，或基于适用的公司法规。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on ownership or voting-limit percentage.
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on ownership or voting-limit percentage. Range: 0.1 to 0.3

keyMetrics.name: Voting Rights Limits Residency
keyMetrics.fullName: Voting Rights Limits Residency Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Are voting rights different for foreign or non-resident shareholders? Flagged if yes. This provision sets limits on the ability of foreign or non-resident parties to vote on corporate matters, regardless of the number or type of shares held, and includes cases in which foreign shareholders are prohibited from voting. This may refer either to an aggregate limit on shares or voting rights held by shareholders of a stated nationality or to a limit on holdings of one shareholder based on that shareholder’s nationality. This metric is derived from a company’s corporate charter and bylaws, or on the basis of applicable corporate regulations.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 外国或非居民股东的表决权是否不同？若为是则被标记。该条款限制外国或非居民一方就公司事项进行表决的能力，无论其持有的股份数量或类型如何，并包括禁止外国股东表决的情形。这可能指对具有某一国籍的股东所持股份或表决权的合计限制，或基于某股东国籍对其持股的限制。该指标源自公司的公司章程和细则，或基于适用的公司法规。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on ownership or voting-limit percentage.
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on ownership or voting-limit percentage. Range: 0.15 to 0.3

keyMetrics.name: Government Intervention Concerns
keyMetrics.definition: Do the company’s capital and ownership structures include a “golden share” provision, are there equivalent provisions in national or state laws, or is there a government representative on the board? Flagged if yes. A “golden share” provision allows a single shareholder, usually a national government, to override all other shareholder voting rights on certain decisions.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司的资本和所有权结构是否包含“黄金股”条款、国家或州法律中是否存在同等条款，或董事会中是否有政府代表？若为是则被标记。“黄金股”条款允许单一股东（通常是国家政府）在某些决策上否决所有其他股东的表决权。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.5

keyMetrics.name: Poison Pill
keyMetrics.definition: Has the company adopted a takeover defense such as a poison pill, shareholder rights plan, or equivalent provision? Flagged if yes. A takeover defense may shield management and the board from accountability (board entrenchment). Takeover defenses may include a formal shareholder’s rights plan, poison pill, protective preference shares, or equivalent provision.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司是否采用了收购防御措施，如毒丸计划、股东权益计划或同等条款？若为是则被标记。收购防御可能使管理层和董事会免受问责（董事会固守）。收购防御可包括正式的股东权益计划、毒丸计划、保护性优先股或同等条款。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.5

keyMetrics.name: Bylaws Amendments
keyMetrics.definition: Does the board have the unilateral right to amend the company’s bylaws/Articles of Association without shareholder approval? Flagged if yes. Most U.S. companies grant the board unilateral control over the bylaws, and are flagged accordingly, but in other regions this remains a helpful indicator of governance strength. This metric is derived from a company’s corporate charter and bylaws, or on the basis of applicable corporate regulations.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 董事会是否拥有未经股东批准单方面修订公司细则/公司章程的权力？若为是则被标记。多数美国公司赋予董事会对细则的单方面控制权，并据此被标记，但在其他地区，这仍是治理力度的有用指标。该指标源自公司的公司章程和细则，或基于适用的公司法规。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.1

keyMetrics.name: Shareholder Rights to Convene Meeting
keyMetrics.fullName: Shareholder Rights to Convene Meeting Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Do shareholders lack the right to requisition an extraordinary general meeting (EGM) or does the threshold required to request an EGM exceed 10% of the voting rights? Flagged if yes. Some companies may apply a different threshold to append a resolution to the agenda of an existing meeting – see Shareholder Rights Concerns Key Metric.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 股东是否缺乏要求召开临时股东大会（EGM）的权利，或要求召开 EGM 所需门槛超过 10% 的表决权？若为是则被标记。部分公司可能对在现有会议议程中追加决议适用不同门槛——参见股东权利问题关键指标。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on voting-rights threshold required to requisition a meeting.
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on voting-rights threshold required to requisition a meeting. Range: 0.1 to 0.3

keyMetrics.name: Shareholder Rights Concerns
keyMetrics.definition: Are shareholders limited in their ability to make changes at the company due to the nature of provisions in the governing documents? Flagged if yes. Does a change to the governing documents require a vote in favor of more than 67% of the total capital or more than 75% of the votes cast? Are shareholders both unable to act by written consent in a majority vote AND does the threshold required to request inclusion of a shareholder proposal at the annual general meeting (AGM) exceed 1% (or is not permitted)?
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 由于治理文件条款的性质，股东在公司进行变革的能力是否受到限制？若为是则被标记。治理文件的变更是否需要超过全部资本 67% 的赞成票或超过已投票数 75% 的赞成票？股东是否既无法以多数票通过书面同意行事，又在年度股东大会（AGM）上请求列入股东提案所需的门槛超过 1%（或不被允许）？
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

keyMetrics.name: Say-on-Pay Policy
keyMetrics.definition: Has the company failed to implement regular say-on-pay votes? Flagged if yes. Shareholders should be granted a vote on either the policies themselves, the amounts paid pursuant to these policies, or on the report of the pay committee that sets out these items( i.e., this should be a broad-based vote on policy or total pay, and not just a vote on the policy or total amount of one component of pay). The scope of the say-on-pay vote must include any executive directors on the board of directors, or the most senior executive, if there is no executive director on the board. The vote may be in respect of all the executive directors collectively or by separate votes for each executive director individually. Votes should be held on a regular basis, at intervals of no more than three years. The Key Metric will not be flagged if there are no executives (e.g., for investment trusts).
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司是否未能实施定期的薪酬话语权（say-on-pay）表决？若为是则被标记。应赋予股东就政策本身、依据这些政策支付的金额，或薪酬委员会列明上述事项的报告进行表决的权利（即，这应是对政策或薪酬总额的广泛表决，而不仅仅是对薪酬某一组成部分的政策或总额进行表决）。薪酬话语权表决的范围必须包括董事会中的任何执行董事，若董事会中没有执行董事，则包括最高级别的管理人员。该表决可针对所有执行董事集体进行，或对每位执行董事单独表决。表决应定期举行，间隔不超过三年。若无高管（如投资信托），则该关键指标不会被标记。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.1

keyMetrics.name: Confidential Voting
keyMetrics.definition: Has the company failed to implement confidential voting, barring reasonable exceptions? Flagged if yes. Confidential voting is intended to protect the anonymity of shareholders who wish to vote against management, or against a particular director, but who may be concerned about the possibility of redress. This metric is derived from a company’s corporate charter and bylaws, or on the basis of applicable corporate regulations. For the U.S. and Canada, this metric is flagged unless the required evidence is identified to confirm confidential voting is in place. For other markets, this metric is only flagged if specific evidence is identified to indicate the absence of confidential voting.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司是否未能实施保密投票（在合理例外情形之外）？若为是则被标记。保密投票旨在保护那些希望投票反对管理层或反对某位特定董事、但可能担心遭到报复的股东的匿名性。该指标源自公司的公司章程和细则，或基于适用的公司法规。对于美国和加拿大，除非能确认保密投票已存在的必要证据，否则该指标会被标记。对于其他市场，仅当发现表明不存在保密投票的具体证据时，该指标才会被标记。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.1

keyMetrics.name: Proxy Access
keyMetrics.definition: Does the company not allow qualified shareholders to nominate directors for election at the annual general meeting, such nominees to be included in the meeting agenda circulated by the company to its shareholders? Flagged if yes. Proxy access is a measure of shareholder’s ability to influence the composition of the company’s board. This metric is derived from a company’s corporate charter and bylaws, or on the basis of applicable corporate regulations.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司是否不允许合格股东提名董事在年度股东大会上参选，且将此类被提名人纳入公司向股东分发的会议议程？若为是则被标记。代理提名权是衡量股东影响公司董事会构成能力的指标。该指标源自公司的公司章程和细则，或基于适用的公司法规。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

keyMetrics.name: Annual Director Elections
keyMetrics.definition: Do any shareholder-elected directors stand for re-election at intervals greater than one year? Flagged if yes. This metric captures both classified boards, where director re-election is staggered, and boards where all directors stand simultaneously for re-election albeit less often than annually. Boards undergoing declassification over an extended period are treated as classified until this process has been completed (i.e., until all the board members are re-elected annually). The metric does not refer to employee-appointed directors, only those elected by shareholders.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 是否有任何由股东选举的董事的连任间隔超过一年？若为是则被标记。该指标既涵盖董事连任交错进行的分类董事会，也涵盖所有董事同时连任但频率低于每年一次的董事会。在较长时间内进行去分类化的董事会，在此过程完成之前（即直到所有董事会成员每年均连任）被视为分类董事会。该指标不涉及员工任命的董事，仅涉及由股东选举的董事。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on percentage of board subject to re-election and frequency of re-election:
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on percentage of board subject to re-election and frequency of re-election: Range: 0.1 to 0.2

keyMetrics.name: Strong Classified Board Combination
keyMetrics.fullName: Strong Classified Board Combination Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Does the company have a classified or staggered board, in combination with other limitations on shareholder rights that further limit shareholders ability to affect the make-up of the board? Flagged if yes. A company has a strong classified board combination if, in addition to having a Classified Board, any of the following are true: • Director Removal for Cause Only is Yes, and Shareholder Can Fill Board Vacancies is No and the Bylaw Vote Percent is = 0% or > 51%; • Director Removal for Cause Only is Yes, and Shareholder Can Fill Board Vacancies is No and the Effective Classified Board is Yes; • Director Removal without Cause Vote % > 51%, and Shareholder Can Fill Board Vacancies is No and Bylaw Vote Percent is = 0% or > 51%; or • Director Removal Without Cause Vote % > 51%, and Shareholder Can Fill Board Vacancies is No, and Effective Classified Board is Yes.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司是否设有分类或交错董事会，同时存在其他股东权利限制，进一步限制股东影响董事会构成的能力？若是则被标记。在已有分类董事会的基础上，下列任一组合成立时即符合本指标：①“仅可因故罢免董事”为 Yes，“股东可填补董事会空缺”为 No，且细则表决比例等于 0% 或大于 51%；②“仅可因故罢免董事”为 Yes，“股东可填补董事会空缺”为 No，且“有效分类董事会”为 Yes；③无因罢免董事所需表决比例大于 51%，“股东可填补董事会空缺”为 No，且细则表决比例等于 0% 或大于 51%；④无因罢免董事所需表决比例大于 51%，“股东可填补董事会空缺”为 No，且“有效分类董事会”为 Yes。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

keyMetrics.name: Majority Voting
keyMetrics.definition: Has the company failed to use or adopt binding majority voting in the election of directors (with immediate resignation, if the director does not receive a majority of the votes cast)? Flagged if yes. MSCI S&C uses a strict majority standard for this metric, flagging plurality, plurality plus resignation, and majority plus resignation standards. Where a director fails to achieve a majority of the votes cast, this standard requires the director to immediately depart (unless the company would have below the legal minimum number of directors, in which case they remain only briefly pending a new appointment). Implementation of majority voting is a measure of the shareholder’s ability to influence the composition of the board.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司是否未在董事选举中使用或采用有约束力的多数投票制（若董事未获得已投票数的多数，则立即辞职）？若为是则被标记。MSCI S&C 对该指标采用严格的多数标准，对相对多数（plurality）、相对多数加辞职、多数加辞职标准均予以标记。若某董事未获得已投票数的多数，该标准要求该董事立即离职（除非公司董事会人数将低于法定最低人数，此情况下其仅短暂留任直至新任命）。实施多数投票制是衡量股东影响董事会构成能力的指标。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on voting standard and whether director vote is binding.
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on voting standard and whether director vote is binding. Range: 0.1 to 0.3

keyMetrics.name: Cumulative Voting
keyMetrics.definition: Does the company, which has a controlling shareholder, use a plurality vote standard for director elections, without permitting cumulative voting (whether as the default election standard or at the request of shareholders)? Flagged if yes. Cumulative voting is a method of election of the board of directors whereby a stockholder may cast as many votes for directors as he or she has shares of stock, multiplied by the number of directors to be elected. The purpose of cumulative voting is to facilitate the representation of minority stockholders on the board. The stockholder may cast all his or her votes for one or more, but not all, directors on the ballot, which therefore promotes representation of small shareholders.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 拥有控股股东的公司，是否在董事选举中采用相对多数投票标准，且不允许累积投票（无论作为默认选举标准还是应股东要求）？若为是则被标记。累积投票是一种董事会选举方法，股东可投出的董事票数等于其持有的股份数乘以应选董事人数。累积投票的目的是促进少数股东在董事会中的代表性。股东可将其全部票投给选票上的一名或多名（但非全部）董事，从而促进小股东的代表性。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.1

keyMetrics.name: Director Removal Without Cause
keyMetrics.fullName: Director Removal Without Cause Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Do shareholders lack the right to remove individual directors without cause? Flagged if yes. If director removal without cause is permitted, a bidder that is hostile to current management may seek to remove existing directors and replace them with the bidder’s nominees. Where there is no evidence of this right, from either national or stock exchange regulation or from the company’s documents, the Key Metric will be flagged.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 股东是否缺乏无因罢免个别董事的权利？若为是则被标记。若允许无因罢免董事，对现任管理层怀有敌意的收购方可能寻求罢免现有董事并用其提名人取而代之。若从国家或证券交易所法规或公司文件中均无该权利的证据，则该关键指标会被标记。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.1

keyMetrics.name: Constituency Provision
keyMetrics.definition: Does the company have a constituency provision or is it subject to constituency protection under applicable law? Flagged if yes. Constituency provisions allow a board to consider interests other than those of shareholders in making corporate decisions, including decisions about changes of control. Typical other constituencies would include employees, communities, customers, suppliers and the environment. The Key Metric will be flagged where there is explicit evidence of this provision from either national or stock exchange regulation or from the company’s constitutional documents.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司是否设有利益相关方条款，或是否受适用法律下利益相关方保护条款的约束？若为是则被标记。利益相关方条款允许董事会在作出公司决策（包括有关控制权变更的决策）时考虑股东以外的利益。典型的其他利益相关方包括员工、社区、客户、供应商和环境。若从国家或证券交易所法规或公司的组织文件中发现该条款的明确证据，该关键指标会被标记。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.1

keyMetrics.name: Business Combination Provision
keyMetrics.definition: Does the company have a business combination provision in place or is it subject to business combination protection under applicable law? Flagged if yes. A business combination provision requires that a company not engage in a transaction with a shareholder holding a certain percentage (usually dubbed an “interested shareholder”) for a period of time after the shareholder exceeded this threshold, or that such a transaction be approved by a higher-than-usual percentage of shares. A different variation of a “business combination” may also list a higher-than-usual percentage of shares for approving a merger but not list a time period during which a merger would be prohibited.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司是否设有企业合并条款，或是否受适用法律下企业合并保护条款的约束？若为是则被标记。企业合并条款要求公司在某股东超过一定持股比例（通常称为“利益相关股东”）后的一段时间内不得与该股东进行交易，或要求此类交易须经高于通常比例的股份批准。企业合并的另一种变体也可能规定批准合并须达到高于通常比例的股份，但未规定禁止合并的期限。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.1

keyMetrics.name: Fair Bid Treatment Provisions
keyMetrics.fullName: Fair Bid Treatment Provisions Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Does the company not have a fair price provision (with a mandatory bid requirement which does not exceed 33.3%) in place or is it not subject to fair price protection under applicable law? Flagged if yes. These terms generally involve all shareholders being entitled to receive the same price for their shares, the price being within some range of the average market price over some period of time prior to the offer, the offer remaining open for a minimum amount of time, and similar protections. In the U.S., this is generally presented as an exception to the business combination provision’s prohibition or higher vote requirement that applies when an acquisition offer contains certain terms designed to ensure fairness and eliminate the possibility that shareholders will feel coerced to agree to the offer.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司是否未设立公平价格条款（附有不超过 33.3% 的强制收购要约要求），或是否不受适用法律下公平价格保护条款的约束？若为是则被标记。这些条款通常涉及所有股东有权就其股份获得相同价格、该价格处于要约前一段时间内平均市场价格的某一区间内、要约须在最短时间内保持开放，以及类似的保护措施。在美国，这通常作为企业合并条款的禁止或更高表决要求的例外情形呈现，适用于收购要约包含某些旨在确保公平并消除股东感到被胁迫而同意要约的可能性的条款时。
keyMetrics.deduction: 0.1 Ownership Structure Assessment The ownership structure of a company is evaluated along three axes. The first dimension of ownership assessment is the level of control asserted by the largest owner. Principal-agent concerns are primarily applicable to widely held companies with highly dispersed ownership. For closely held companies, however, governance risk is primarily a function of the identity and degree of control wielded by a company’s dominant shareholder. Where stock pyramids are present or in the case of private companies, our assessment focuses on the ultimate owner.
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.1 Ownership Structure Assessment The ownership structure of a company is evaluated along three axes. The first dimension of ownership assessment is the level of control asserted by the largest owner. Principal-agent concerns are primarily applicable to widely held companies with highly dispersed ownership. For closely held companies, however, governance risk is primarily a function of the identity and degree of control wielded by a company’s dominant shareholder. Where stock pyramids are present or in the case of private companies, our assessment focuses on the ultimate owner.

scoringNote: 治理先从 10 分起扣除相关关键指标的贡献，并按方法论做缩放、主题与支柱汇总。部分指标影响议题得分，但不经公司治理主题进入最终评级；适用范围及贡献以各指标原文和总方法论为准。

name: 薪酬
summary: 评估 CEO 及其他高管薪酬实践，包括已披露的具体薪酬数据；主要基于相对同业的薪酬水平与薪酬方案设计特征评分。
intro: Pay is a Key Issue in the Governance Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on CEO and other executive pay practices, including specific pay figures, where disclosed. Pay is scored primarily based on levels of pay relative to peers, as well as specific features of the pay program design.

keyMetrics.name: CEO Equity Policy
keyMetrics.definition: If the CEO does not hold a significant number of shares, has the company failed to adopt effective stock ownership guidelines or an equity retention policy for the CEO? Flagged if yes. A significant number of shares is defined as either shares worth at least 5 times base salary or USD 5 million or shares representing 1% of outstanding shares. Effective stock ownership guidelines include requirements to hold shares worth at least 5 times base salary. Effective equity retention requirements include requirements to hold at least 50% of vested equity.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 如果 CEO 并未持有大量股份，公司是否未能为 CEO 采纳有效的持股指引或股权保留政策？若是，则被标记。大量股份的定义为：价值至少为基本薪酬 5 倍或 500 万美元的股份，或占已发行股份 1% 的股份。有效的持股指引包括要求持有价值至少为基本薪酬 5 倍的股份。有效的股权保留要求包括要求保留至少 50% 的已归属股权。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

keyMetrics.name: CEO Equity Changes
keyMetrics.definition: Has the number of shares held by the CEO (after adjustment for any corporate actions) decreased year over year by 10% or more? Flagged if yes. This metric excludes CEOs with less than two years’ tenure.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: CEO 持有的股份数量（经任何公司行动调整后）是否同比减少 10% 或以上？若是，则被标记。该指标不包括任期不足两年的 CEO。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

keyMetrics.name: Long-Term Pay Performance
keyMetrics.definition: Does the CEO’s equity pay fail to reflect the company’s total shareholder return (TSR) performance over the last three and five years? Flagged if yes. This metric is flagged if any vested stock and option gains reported for the company’s CEO are greater than zero during a year when the company is showing negative 3-year and 5-year TSR.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: CEO 的股权薪酬是否未能反映公司过去三年和五年的股东总回报（TSR）绩效？若是，则被标记。若在公司 3 年和 5 年 TSR 为负的年份，报告的公司 CEO 任何已归属股票和期权收益大于零，则该指标被标记。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

keyMetrics.name: Long-Term Pay Performance Versus Peers
keyMetrics.nameCn: 长期薪酬绩效与同业对比
keyMetrics.fullName: Long-Term Pay Performance Versus Peers Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Does the CEO’s equity pay fail to reflect the company’s TSR performance over the last three and five years relative to its Pay Peer Group? Flagged if yes. This metric is flagged if any vested stock and option gains reported for the company’s CEO are greater than zero during a year when the company’s 3-year and 5-year TSR fall below the median for its Pay Peer Group (see Pay Peer Groups, below).
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 相对于其薪酬同业组，CEO 的股权薪酬是否未能反映公司过去三年和五年的 TSR 绩效？若是，则被标记。若在公司 3 年和 5 年 TSR 低于其薪酬同业组中位数的年份，报告的公司 CEO 任何已归属股票和期权收益大于零，则该指标被标记（见下文薪酬同业组）。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

keyMetrics.name: Short-Term Pay Performance
keyMetrics.definition: Did the CEO’s annual incentives fail to rise or fall in line with annual performance for the last reported period? Flagged if yes. The four test metrics used are net income, basic normalized earnings per share (EPS), total revenue and total assets. This metric is flagged if: • CEO’s reported total short-term incentives are greater than zero and three or more of the four test metrics listed above have decreased year-on-year; or • Total short-term incentives did not decrease year-on-year, prior year incentives were greater than zero, and two or more metrics decreased year-on-year. “Total short-term incentives” for the purpose of this Key Metric include any bonus (in the U.S. including “Non-Equity Incentive Compensation”), whether delivered in the form of cash, shares, shares subject to a holding period prior to release, bonus waived into pension or other form of delivery.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 在最近报告期，CEO 的年度激励是否未能随年度绩效同步升降？若是，则被标记。所使用的四项测试指标为净利润、基本正常化每股收益（EPS）、总收入和总资产。若出现以下情形，则该指标被标记：• CEO 报告的短期激励总额大于零，且上述四项测试指标中有三项或以上同比减少；或 • 短期激励总额未同比减少，上一年度激励大于零，且两项或以上的指标同比减少。就本关键指标而言，短期激励总额包括任何奖金（在美国包括非股权激励薪酬），无论其以现金、股份、在释放前设有持有期的股份、放弃并转入养老金的奖金或其他交付形式提供。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

keyMetrics.name: Pay Linked to Sustainability
keyMetrics.fullName: Pay Linked to Sustainability Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Has the company failed to incorporate links to sustainability performance in its current executive pay policies? Flagged if yes. This metric is based entirely on the company’s own reporting. It considers whether one or more sustainability metrics are used to determine annual and/or long-term incentive pay policy and does not consider the effectiveness of those metrics. This metric is evaluated for the CEO and/or other executive directors. Companies that do not issue any incentive pay will also be flagged under this Key Metric.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司是否未在其当前的高管薪酬政策中纳入与可持续性绩效的挂钩？若是，则被标记。该指标完全基于公司自身的报告。它考量是否使用一项或多项可持续性指标来确定年度和/或长期激励薪酬政策，而不考量这些指标的有效性。该指标针对 CEO 和/或其他执行董事进行评估。未发放任何激励薪酬的公司也将在本关键指标下被标记。
keyMetrics.scope: All issuers other than externally managed companies.
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers other than externally managed companies. Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

keyMetrics.name: Clawbacks & Malus
keyMetrics.definition: Where the company offers variable or incentive pay, has the company failed to adopt a clawback policy, applicable to both the annual and long-term incentives, that would recoup incentive pay based on accounts that were restated at a later date? Flagged if yes. The absence of a formal clawback policy may weaken the board’s legal standing in cases where senior executives have been granted incentive awards on the basis of fraudulent or erroneous data.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 在公司提供可变或激励薪酬的情况下，公司是否未能采纳适用于年度和长期激励的追回政策，以根据后续重述的账目收回激励薪酬？若是，则被标记。在高级高管基于欺诈性或错误数据获得激励奖励的情况下，缺乏正式的追回政策可能会削弱董事会的法律地位。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

keyMetrics.name: Golden Hellos
keyMetrics.definition: Has there been public criticism from stakeholders of golden hellos provided by the company to its CEO or other senior executives? Flagged if yes. The duration of the flag is dependent on the severity assessment. A golden hello is considered to be any first-year pay award for external hires in excess of one year’s total remuneration in normal circumstances, regardless of form. The scope of this Key Metric extends to any CEO; any member of the management board in a two-tier board structure; any executive member of the board of directors in a unitary board structure or where a board of directors/board of auditors structure is in place; or any of the top five executives (U.S. – named executive officers).
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 是否存在利益相关方对该公司向其 CEO 或其他高级高管提供的入职奖金（golden hellos）的公开批评？若是，则被标记。标记的持续时间取决于严重程度评估。入职奖金指在正常情况下向外聘人员提供的超过一年总薪酬的任何首年薪酬奖励，无论其形式如何。本关键指标的范围涵盖任何 CEO；双层董事会结构中的任何管理董事会成员；单层董事会结构或设有董事会/监事会结构的公司中的任何执行董事；或排名前五的高管中的任何一位（美国——具名高管）。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.3, Severe 0.5, Very Severe 1.0
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.3, Severe 0.5, Very Severe 1.0

keyMetrics.name: Pay Controversy
keyMetrics.definition: Have the company’s pay policies or practices attracted adverse public comment from stakeholders (including shareholders, government, regulators, etc.)? Flagged if yes. The duration of the flag is dependent on the severity assessment.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司的薪酬政策或实践是否招致利益相关方（包括股东、政府、监管机构等）的负面公开评论？若是，则被标记。标记的持续时间取决于严重程度评估。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.5, Severe 1.0, Very Severe 2.0
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring Deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.5, Severe 1.0, Very Severe 2.0

keyMetrics.name: Significant Vote Against Pay Practices
keyMetrics.nameCn: 对薪酬实践的重大反对票
keyMetrics.fullName: Significant Vote Against Pay Practices Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: For the most recently reported period, did the company receive a negative vote in excess of 10% on its pay policies and practices, or were relevant proposals withdrawn or adjourned? Flagged if yes. This metric is intended to measure shareholder dissatisfaction with the company’s executive pay practices. A “negative vote” includes any of against, withhold or abstain votes.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 在最近报告期，公司是否就其薪酬政策与实践收到超过 10% 的反对票，或相关提案被撤回或推迟？若是，则被标记。该指标旨在衡量股东对公司高管薪酬实践的不满。反对票包括任何反对票、保留票或弃权票。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on resolution outcome, vote data and consecutive years:
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on resolution outcome, vote data and consecutive years: Range: 0.05 to 0.5

keyMetrics.name: Executive Pay Disclosure
keyMetrics.definition: Has the company failed to disclose specific pay totals for its top executives, including the CEO? Flagged if yes. This is the most basic test in this area, and as such, carries considerable weight when invoked, as it must serve in the place of several of the other metrics normally applied in this area. Disclosure must include, at a minimum, pay for all executive members of the board of directors (or management board for companies with a two-tier board structure) on an individualized basis or in cases where there are no executive members, the CEO. The individualized disclosure should include separate information on the amount of each of the following (where such a component is provided): salary, short-term incentives, long-term incentives, pensions, benefits and one-off payments (such as recruitment or retention awards).
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司是否未能披露其高管（包括 CEO）的具体薪酬总额？若是，则被标记。这是该领域最基本的测试，因此一旦触发便具有相当大的权重，因为它必须替代该领域通常适用的若干其他指标。披露至少必须包括董事会（或双层董事会结构公司的管理董事会）所有执行成员的薪酬，且按个人逐一披露；若没有执行成员，则包括 CEO 的薪酬。个人化披露应包含以下各项金额的单独信息（在提供该组成部分的情况下）：基本薪酬、短期激励、长期激励、养老金、福利和一次性付款（如招聘或留任奖励）。
keyMetrics.deduction: Variable, based on executive pay disclosure: CEO pay not disclosed 1.2; CEO pay disclosed and other executive pay not disclosed 0.1
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on executive pay disclosure: CEO pay not disclosed 1.2; CEO pay disclosed and other executive pay not disclosed 0.1

keyMetrics.name: CEO Pay Total Realized
keyMetrics.fullName: CEO Pay Total Realized Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Does the most recently reported total realized CEO pay figure fall into an extreme range relative to the company’s pay peer group? Flagged if yes. This metric is flagged if the CEO’s total realized pay falls within the top decile of CEO realized pay values for the company’s pay peer group (see Pay Peer Groups, below). Because companies file their proxy statements at different times throughout the year, a company could see this metric change due to changes in reported figures for its peers.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 最近报告的 CEO 已实现薪酬总额是否相对于公司的薪酬同业组处于极端区间？ 若是，则被标记。若 CEO 的已实现薪酬总额落入公司薪酬同业组 CEO 已实现薪酬值的最高十分位，则该指标被标记（见下文薪酬同业组）。由于各公司在一年中的不同时间提交其委托书，某公司可能会因同业组报告数据的变化而看到该指标发生变化。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

keyMetrics.name: CEO Pay Total Awarded
keyMetrics.fullName: CEO Pay Total Awarded Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Does the most recently reported total awarded CEO pay figure fall into an extreme range relative to the company’s pay peer group? Flagged if yes. This metric is flagged if the CEO’s total awarded pay falls within the top decile of CEO total awarded pay values for the company’s pay peer group (see Pay Peer Groups, below). Because companies file their proxy statements at different times throughout the year, a company could see this metric change due to changes in reported figures for its peers.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 最近报告的 CEO 授予薪酬总额是否相对于公司的薪酬同业组处于极端区间？若是，则被标记。若 CEO 的授予薪酬总额落入公司薪酬同业组 CEO 授予薪酬总额值的最高十分位，则该指标被标记（见下文薪酬同业组）。由于各公司在一年中的不同时间提交其委托书，某公司可能会因同业组报告数据的变化而看到该指标发生变化。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

keyMetrics.name: CEO Pay Total Fixed
keyMetrics.fullName: CEO Pay Total Fixed Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Does the most recently reported total fixed CEO pay figure fall into an extreme range relative to the company’s pay peer group? Flagged if yes. This metric is flagged if the CEO’s total fixed pay falls within the top decile of CEO total fixed pay values for the company’s pay peer group (see Pay Peer Groups, below). Because companies file their proxy statements at different times throughout the year, a company could see this metric change due to changes in reported figures for its peers.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 最近报告的 CEO 固定薪酬总额是否相对于公司的薪酬同业组处于极端区间？若是，则被标记。若 CEO 的固定薪酬总额落入公司薪酬同业组 CEO 固定薪酬总额值的最高十分位，则该指标被标记（见下文薪酬同业组）。由于各公司在一年中的不同时间提交其委托书，某公司可能会因同业组报告数据的变化而看到该指标发生变化。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

keyMetrics.name: CEO Pay Perks & Other Pay
keyMetrics.fullName: CEO Pay Perks & Other Pay Key Metric
keyMetrics.definition: Does the most recently reported CEO perquisites (perks) and other pay figure exceed the stated MSCI S&C thresholds? Flagged if yes. This metric is flagged if the perks reported exceed: • USD 200,000 for companies with market cap exceeding USD 100 billion. • USD 150,000 for companies with market cap between USD 10 billion and USD 100 billion. • USD 120,000 for companies with market cap between USD 4 billion and USD 10 billion. • USD 90,000 for companies with market cap between USD 340 million and USD 4 billion. • USD 75,000 for companies with market cap below USD 340 million.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 最近报告的 CEO 津贴（perks）及其他薪酬金额是否超过规定的 MSCI S&C 门槛值？若是，则被标记。若报告的津贴超过以下数值，则该指标被标记：• 市值超过 1000 亿美元的公司：200,000 美元。• 市值在 100 亿至 1000 亿美元之间的公司：150,000 美元。• 市值在 40 亿至 100 亿美元之间的公司：120,000 美元。• 市值在 3.4 亿至 40 亿美元之间的公司：90,000 美元。• 市值低于 3.4 亿美元的公司：75,000 美元。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

keyMetrics.name: CEO Pay NQDC
keyMetrics.definition: Is the pension contribution rate (defined contribution amount [CEO NQDC] divided by salary) made by the company on behalf of the CEO excessive relative to the company’s pay peer group? Flagged if yes. This metric is flagged if the CEO’s pension contribution rate falls within the top decile of all such values for the company’s pay peer group (see Pay Peer Groups, below). Because companies file their proxy statements at different times throughout the year, a company could see this metric change due to changes in reported figures for its peers.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司代表 CEO 支付的养老金缴款率（定额缴款金额 [CEO NQDC] 除以基本薪酬）是否相对于公司的薪酬同业组过高？若是，则被标记。若 CEO 的养老金缴款率落入公司薪酬同业组所有此类值的最高十分位，则该指标被标记（见下文薪酬同业组）。由于各公司在一年中的不同时间提交其委托书，某公司可能会因同业组报告数据的变化而看到该指标发生变化。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

keyMetrics.name: CEO Pay Pension
keyMetrics.definition: Is the most recently reported CEO accumulated pension figure (divided by the number of years of pensionable service) excessive relative to the company’s pay peer group? Flagged if yes. This metric is flagged if the CEO’s (total accumulated pension divided by number of years served) figure falls within the top decile of all such values for the company’s pay peer group (see Pay Peer Groups, below). Because companies file their proxy statements at different times throughout the year, a company could see this metric change due to changes in reported figures for its peers.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 最近报告的 CEO 累计养老金金额（除以可计养老金的服务年限）是否相对于公司的薪酬同业组过高？若是，则被标记。若 CEO 的（累计养老金总额除以服务年限）数值落入公司薪酬同业组所有此类值的最高十分位，则该指标被标记（见下文薪酬同业组）。由于各公司在一年中的不同时间提交其委托书，某公司可能会因同业组报告数据的变化而看到该指标发生变化。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

keyMetrics.name: Internal Pay Equity
keyMetrics.definition: Does the CEO’s total awarded pay for the last reported period exceed the median pay for the other named executive officers by more than three times? Flagged if yes. Another coarse measure of pay alignment and effectiveness, this metric is used to identify any anomalies in overall executive pay practices that might favor the CEO over the rest of the company's senior management team.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 在最近报告期，CEO 的授予薪酬总额是否超过其他具名高管薪酬中位数的三倍以上？若是，则被标记。作为薪酬一致性和有效性的另一项粗略衡量，该指标用于识别整体高管薪酬实践中可能存在、有利于 CEO 而不利于公司其他高级管理团队的异常情况。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

keyMetrics.name: Golden Parachutes
keyMetrics.categoryCn: 离职补偿与控制权变更
keyMetrics.definition: Does the CEO’s potential cash severance pay exceed five times their annual pay? Flagged if yes.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: CEO 的潜在现金离职补偿是否超过其年度薪酬的五倍？若是，则被标记。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.3

keyMetrics.name: Severance Vesting
keyMetrics.categoryCn: 离职补偿与控制权变更
keyMetrics.definition: Are unvested equity awards still eligible for vesting when the CEO's employment is terminated? Flagged if yes. This metric is designed to help in evaluating the board’s effectiveness in aligning the interests of the CEO and other senior executives with those of the company’s investors.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 当 CEO 的雇佣关系终止时，未归属的股权奖励是否仍符合归属条件？若是，则被标记。该指标旨在帮助评估董事会在使 CEO 和其他高级高管的利益与公司投资者利益保持一致方面的有效性。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.1

keyMetrics.name: Dilution Concerns
keyMetrics.definition: Is the potential dilution in the company’s traded shares 10% or greater? Flagged if yes. Dilution is defined as the percentage of company shares the board has set aside for use in granting incentive awards. The 10% dilution threshold is used regardless of company size.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司已发行股份的潜在稀释是否达到 10% 或以上？若是，则被标记。稀释定义为董事会预留用于授予激励奖励的公司股份百分比。无论公司规模如何，均采用 10% 的稀释门槛。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.1

keyMetrics.name: Run Rate Concerns
keyMetrics.definition: Is the company’s current run rate 2% or more? Flagged if yes. Run rate is defined as the percentage of company shares actually granted as incentive awards during the most recently reported period. The 2% run rate threshold is used regardless of company size.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司的当前消耗率（run rate）是否达到 2% 或以上？若是，则被标记。消耗率定义为在最近报告期实际授予作为激励奖励的公司股份百分比。无论公司规模如何，均采用 2% 的消耗率门槛。
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

keyMetrics.name: Director Equity Policy
keyMetrics.definition: Has the company failed to adopt specific stock ownership guidelines for non-executive directors? Flagged if yes. Another relatively coarse but effective indicator, this metric does not evaluate the effectiveness of such standards, but simply whether the company has formally announced a policy in this area.
keyMetrics.definitionCn: 公司是否未能为非执行董事采纳具体的持股指引？若是，则被标记。作为另一项相对粗略但有效的指标，该指标不评估此类标准的有效性，而仅考量公司是否已正式宣布该领域的政策。
keyMetrics.deduction: 0.1 Total Pay Components
keyMetrics.scoringText: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.1 Total Pay Components

scoringNote: 治理先从 10 分起扣除相关关键指标的贡献，并按方法论做缩放、主题与支柱汇总。部分指标影响议题得分，但不经公司治理主题进入最终评级；适用范围及贡献以各指标原文和总方法论为准。
